And scientists were real freaked out about this. I covered this. You had public comments from Nobel laureates saying this would be disastrous for American scientists. So after the election results come in, it’s gonna be really interesting to see how Congress decides to vote on that.
paras.zh: 但就更短期而言，有一项支出法案被推迟到 12 月，而且，你知道，到那时新国会还不会宣誓就职。因此，看看选举结果实际上如何影响这一悬而未决的资金决定将会很有趣。受到批评的一件事是这项拟议的规则变更，它在科学拨款的管理方式方面极具争议性，这会将决策从同行评审专家小组（你知道，真正了解这些东西的人）转变为政治任命者。科学家们对此感到非常害怕。我介绍了这一点。诺贝尔奖获得者公开评论说这对美国科学家来说将是灾难性的。因此，在选举结果公布后，看看国会如何决定对此进行投票将会非常有趣。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah, definitely something we’ll, we’ll have to keep our eye out for. Adam, thanks so much for coming on to chat with us.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的，我们肯定会，我们必须密切关注。亚当，非常感谢您接受我们的采访。

paras.en: Feltman: That’s all for today’s episode. We’ll be back on Friday to talk about vampires. Which frankly are a little less spooky than politics.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：这就是今天这一集的全部内容。我们将在周五回来讨论吸血鬼。坦率地说，这比政治没那么可怕。

paras.en: For Scientific American, this is Rachel Feltman. See you next time!
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》的这位人物是雷切尔·费尔特曼 (Rachel Feltman)。下次见！

articles.title: 7 spooky bat facts—right in time for Halloween

paras.en: Bats are not the world’s most beloved creatures. Mostly night animals, they’ve become a symbol of Halloween—associated with vampires, death and general ghoulishness. Sure, a few bat species do, in fact, feed on animal blood. Some bats have a face only a biologist could love. And yes, bats can be reservoirs of disease. But in their more than 50 million years on Earth, these maligned creatures have developed some admirable qualities, too.
paras.zh: 蝙蝠并不是世界上最受欢迎的生物。它们大多是夜间动物，已成为万圣节的象征——与吸血鬼、死亡和普遍的残忍联系在一起。当然，事实上，有一些蝙蝠确实以动物血液为食。有些蝙蝠有一张只有生物学家才会喜欢的脸。是的，蝙蝠可能是疾病的宿主。但在地球上超过 5000 万年的时间里，这些饱受诟病的生物也发展出了一些令人钦佩的品质。

paras.en: For one, they’re everywhere: bats live on every continent except Antarctica. They echolocate, using sound to navigate their world—and they are the only mammal to evolve true flight. They also eat insects such as mosquitoes—contributing billions of dollars in value annually for the world’s farmers—and are critical pollinators of tropical plants.
paras.zh: 首先，它们无处不在：蝙蝠生活在除南极洲之外的每个大陆。它们通过回声定位，利用声音来导航它们的世界——它们是唯一进化出真正飞行能力的哺乳动物。它们还吃蚊子等昆虫，每年为世界农民贡献数十亿美元的价值，并且是热带植物的重要传粉者。

paras.en: “We need them,” says Emma Teeling, a professor and founding director of the Center for Irish Bat Research at University College Dublin.
paras.zh: “我们需要它们，”都柏林大学学院爱尔兰蝙蝠研究中心教授兼创始主任艾玛·蒂林说。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: So, in honor of spooky season, here are seven bat facts you may not know:
paras.zh: 因此，为了纪念这个令人毛骨悚然的季节，以下是您可能不知道的七个关于蝙蝠的事实：

paras.en: In nature, larger animals, such as elephants and whales, tend to live longer than smaller animals, such as mice and shrews, Teeling says. Bats are an exception.
paras.zh: 蒂林说，在自然界中，大象和鲸鱼等大型动物往往比较老鼠和鼩鼱等小型动物寿命更长。蝙蝠是一个例外。

paras.en: “Bats are some of the smallest mammals in the entire world and can live for this extraordinary long time,” she says. Some of the oldest bats have been known to live for decades.
paras.zh: “蝙蝠是世界上最小的哺乳动物之一，但却能活这么长的时间，”她说。据了解，一些最古老的蝙蝠可以活几十年。

paras.en: Teeling and other bat researchers are studying aspects of the animals’ longevity, including bats’ ability to repair their DNA and harbor viruses without getting sick, for clues in order to enhance our own lives.
paras.zh: Teeling 和其他蝙蝠研究人员正在研究这些动物长寿的各个方面，包括蝙蝠修复 DNA 和携带病毒而不生病的能力，以寻找改善我们生活的线索。

paras.en: Vampire bats could help us treat stroke victims.
paras.zh: 吸血蝙蝠可以帮助我们治疗中风患者。

paras.en: When vampire bats such as Desmodus rotundus, also known as the common vampire bat, feed on birds and other mammals, they bite their prey and lick the wounds, Teeling says. An anticoagulant in their saliva prevents the blood from clotting up.
paras.zh: 提林说，当吸血蝙蝠（例如圆形吸血蝙蝠）以鸟类和其他哺乳动物为食时，它们会咬住猎物并舔舐伤口。他们唾液中的抗凝剂可以防止血液凝结。

paras.en: Researchers have studied this protein in the hope that it may offer a way to treat blood clots in stroke victims—while lowering the risk of causing brain bleeds. Although drug development stalled a decade ago after lackluster results, the treatment may still have potential, according to a recent review.
paras.zh: 研究人员对这种蛋白质进行了研究，希望它能提供一种治疗中风患者血栓的方法，同时降低导致脑出血的风险。根据最近的一篇评论，尽管药物开发在十年前因效果不佳而陷入停滞，但这种治疗方法可能仍然具有潜力。

paras.en: There are about 1,500 bat species—and counting.
paras.zh: 蝙蝠约有 1,500 种，而且还在不断增加。

paras.en: Bats are incredibly diverse—across all mammals, bats include more species than all but one other group, rodents, says Rachel Page, a scientist at the Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute. In fact, there are about 1,500 known bat species worldwide.
paras.zh: 史密森尼热带研究所的科学家雷切尔·佩奇说，蝙蝠的多样性令人难以置信，在所有哺乳动物中，蝙蝠的种类比除了啮齿类动物以外的所有类群都要多。事实上，全世界已知的蝙蝠种类约有 1,500 种。

paras.en: Some, such as the vampire bats, drink blood. Others eat nectar, while others still eat insects, fish and even frogs.
paras.zh: 有些蝙蝠，例如吸血蝙蝠，会喝血。有些吃花蜜，有些则仍然吃昆虫、鱼甚至青蛙。

paras.en: Some bats “eavesdrop” on their prey’s mating calls.
paras.zh: 有些蝙蝠会“偷听”猎物的交配叫声。

paras.en: For the frog-eating bats, meals can be treacherous. Some frogs are poisonous. Others are so big they could pose a danger. To meet this challenge, the fringe-lipped bat, Trachops cirrhosus, “eavesdrops:” the bats listen for the loud, “conspicuous” nighttime mating calls of their prey and then attack, Page says.
paras.zh: 对于以青蛙为食的蝙蝠来说，食物可能很危险。有些青蛙是有毒的。其他的则太大了，可能会造成危险。佩奇说，为了应对这一挑战，流唇蝙蝠（Trachops cithrosus）会“窃听”：蝙蝠会聆听猎物在夜间发出的响亮、“显眼”的交配叫声，然后发起攻击。

paras.en: “They exploit those calls. They use them to detect, to locate, and then also to assess those prey” for size and toxicity, she says.
paras.zh: “它们利用这些叫声。它们用它们来检测、定位，然后评估这些猎物”的大小和毒性，她说。

paras.en: In September, Teeling and more than 130 other scientists across the world published a paper in Nature in which they sequenced genomes across all 21 bat families.
paras.zh: 9 月，Teeling 和世界各地 130 多名其他科学家在《自然》杂志上发表了一篇论文，其中他们对所有 21 个蝙蝠科的基因组进行了测序。

paras.en: By pairing these genetic data with fossil records, they made a breakthrough—bats likely evolved in Europe and then spread to Africa and around the world, they found. Until then, it was thought bats might’ve emerged somewhere in North America, among other theories. “We rewrote evolutionary history,” Teeling says.
paras.zh: 通过将这些遗传数据与化石记录配对，他们取得了突破——他们发现，蝙蝠很可能在欧洲进化，然后传播到非洲和世界各地。在那之前，人们认为蝙蝠可能出现在北美的某个地方，还有其他理论。 “我们改写了进化史，”蒂林说。

paras.en: Across bat species, 9 percent are known so far to have odor-producing glands and other structures, but research on this is sparse, according to a 2021 paper in Mammal Review co-authored by Page. T. cirrhosus males employ a “pungent” golden crust with a “musky” scent on their forearms, likely to attract females, Page says.
paras.zh: 根据佩奇于 2021 年在《哺乳动物评论》上与人合着的一篇论文，迄今为止，已知 9% 的蝙蝠物种具有产生气味的腺体和其他结构，但对此的研究很少。佩奇说，雄性卷毛虫的前臂上有一种“刺鼻的”金色外壳，带有“麝香”气味，可能会吸引雌性。

paras.en: Vampire bats will throw up to feed a friend.
paras.zh: 吸血蝙蝠会呕吐来喂朋友。

paras.en: If a vampire bat doesn’t feed for about two nights in a row, it will die, Page explains. “It doesn’t have the energetic reserves to make it beyond that,” she says. But research shows that if a vampire bat comes back to its colony hungry, other bats will step in and regurgitate blood to share—a costly but lifesaving sacrifice.
paras.zh: 佩奇解释说，如果吸血蝙蝠连续两个晚上不进食，它就会死亡。 “它没有足够的能量储备来超越这个目标，”她说。但研究表明，如果吸血蝙蝠饿着肚子回到栖息地，其他蝙蝠就会介入并吐出血液来分享——这是一种代价高昂但能挽救生命的牺牲。

articles.title: RFK, Jr., loosens restrictions for six popular peptides, bypassing the FDA

paras.en: The Department of Health and Human Services announced a loosening of restrictions on six unproven peptides on Wednesday. These substances have long been touted by biohackers as a means to hack people’s bodies and brains for the better, but they often have had scant scientific evidence behind them. In the past, HHS chief Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., has voiced support for peptides, such as the so-called Wolverine stack, a combination of two such substances—BPC-157 and TB-500—that is meant to promote healing. Both of these peptides are included in the list of those that are now available to dispense.
paras.zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部周三宣布放宽对六种未经证实的肽的限制。长期以来，这些物质一直被生物黑客吹捧为一种改善人们身体和大脑的手段，但它们背后的科学证据往往很少。过去，美国卫生与公众服务部负责人小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾表示支持肽，例如所谓的“金刚狼堆栈”，这是两种此类物质（BPC-157 和 TB-500）的组合，旨在促进愈合。这两种肽都包含在现在可分配的肽列表中。

paras.en: The new policy allows some licensed pharmacists to produce compounds made up of multiple peptides—provided that those peptides are made by registered manufacturers. Users must also have a valid prescription to receive the compounds.
paras.zh: 新政策允许一些持有执照的药剂师生产由多种肽组成的化合物——前提是这些肽是由注册制造商生产的。用户还必须拥有有效的处方才能获得这些化合物。

paras.en: In a document outlining the new policy, the agency acknowledged that compounded drugs carry risks: they are not regulated in the same way as a name-brand or generic medication by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, leading to concerns over their safety and efficacy. But the agency said that the level of public interest and available data had led it to expand access to some combinations of peptides and that doing so would discourage the growing gray and black markets for peptides.
paras.zh: 在一份概述新政策的文件中，该机构承认复合药物存在风险：美国食品和药物管理局对它们的监管方式与名牌药物或仿制药不同，导致人们对其安全性和有效性感到担忧。但该机构表示，公众兴趣程度和现有数据促使其扩大对某些肽组合的获取，这样做将阻止肽的灰色和黑市的不断增长。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Peptides are small chains of amino acids, which are the building blocks of proteins. Humans produce a large number of peptides naturally, but taking them as supplements has become a major trend among health influencers, tech executives and the “Make America Healthy Again” movement. Depending on the peptide, the substances are marketed as helping with everything from extending lifespan to healing from injuries and workouts to improving one’s complexion. Perhaps the best-known peptide products on the market are glucagonlike peptide 1 (GLP-1) drugs, such as Ozempic and Mounjaro.
paras.zh: 肽是氨基酸的小链，是蛋白质的组成部分。人类自然产生大量肽，但将它们作为补充剂已成为健康影响者、科技高管和“让美国再次健康”运动的主要趋势。根据肽的不同，这些物质在市场上被宣传为有助于从延长寿命到治愈受伤和锻炼，再到改善肤色等各个方面。也许市场上最著名的肽产品是胰高血糖素样肽 1 (GLP-1) 药物，例如 Ozempic 和 Mounjaro。

paras.en: The peptides included under the new policy are: BPC-157 and TB-500; Epitalon, which is promoted as a sleep and longevity aid; KPV, which is used as an anti-inflammatory; MOTS-c, which is used for obesity and osteoporosis; and Semax, a supplement for migraine and chronic pain.
paras.zh: 新政策涵盖的多肽有：BPC-157和TB-500； Epitalon，被宣传为睡眠和长寿辅助剂； KPV，用作抗炎药； MOTS-c，用于肥胖和骨质疏松症； Semax，一种治疗偏头痛和慢性疼痛的补充剂。

paras.en: Willie Underwood III, president of the American Medical Association, criticized the policy shift in a statement, saying the peptides have "not undergone the rigorous testing required of FDA-approved drugs."
paras.zh: 美国医学会主席威利·安德伍德三世在一份声明中批评了这一政策转变，称这些肽“没有经过 FDA 批准药物所需的严格测试”。

paras.en: "“Allowing pharmacies to compound unapproved synthetic peptide substances without sufficient evidence of their safety and efficacy puts patients at risk," he said. "Expanding access without adequate safeguards and oversight could expose patients to serious, preventable harm.”
paras.zh: 他说：“在没有充分证据证明其安全性和有效性的情况下，允许药房合成未经批准的合成肽物质，会使患者面临风险。”“在没有充分保障和监督的情况下扩大使用范围可能会使患者面临严重的、可预防的伤害。”

paras.en: The affected peptides are also rarely taken alone, and in some cases, there is very little research as to what so-called stacks of two or more peptides might do to health. Despite that lack of evidence, the loosening of restrictions has come after the FDA began analyzing how to make the substances more accessible and convened a panel to discuss allowing compounding pharmacies to manufacture them.
paras.zh: 受影响的肽也很少单独服用，在某些情况下，关于所谓的两种或多种肽的堆叠可能对健康产生什么影响的研究很少。尽管缺乏证据，但在 FDA 开始分析如何使这些物质更容易获得并召集一个小组讨论允许复合药房生产这些物质之后，限制还是放松了。

paras.en: HHS appeared to acknowledge the lack of data in its announcement, saying it may revisit the issue if safety or product quality issues arise as the compounded peptides become more available.
paras.zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部似乎承认其公告中缺乏数据，并表示，如果随着复合肽变得更容易出现安全或产品质量问题，它可能会重新审视这个问题。

paras.en: Editor’s Note (10/28/26): This is a breaking news story and may be updated.
paras.zh: 编者注（10/28/26）：这是一个突发新闻报道，可能会更新。

articles.title: The human voice
articles.author: Nancy Shute

paras.en: Our voices have superpowers. From a coach firing up a soccer team before a big game to a mother soothing a cranky baby in the middle of the night, the human voice is key to expressing feelings and forging connections. The tone of a person’s voice might even communicate feelings to loved ones better than facial expressions. So what happens to a person when their voice disappears?
paras.zh: 我们的声音有超能力。从教练在一场重大比赛前激励足球队到母亲在半夜安抚脾气暴躁的婴儿，人声是表达感情和建立联系的关键。一个人的语气甚至可能比面部表情更能向亲人传达感情。那么当一个人的声音消失时会发生什么呢？

paras.en: People who have lost the ability to speak due to neurodegenerative disease or brain injury are talking again thanks to groundbreaking technologies that can decode the instructions the brain sends to speech muscles. For this issue’s cover story, senior neuroscience writer Laura Sanders interviewed Casey Harrell, a man who regained his voice — lost to ALS — through a brain-computer interface.
paras.zh: 由于神经退行性疾病或脑损伤而失去说话能力的人可以再次说话，这要归功于能够解码大脑发送到言语肌肉的指令的突破性技术。在本期封面故事中，资深神经科学作家劳拉·桑德斯 (Laura Sanders) 采访了凯西·哈勒尔 (Casey Harrell)，他因肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS) 失去了声音，但通过脑机接口恢复了声音。

paras.en: You can listen to Harrell in his own words in Season Two of The Deep End, our award-winning podcast. Harrell told Sanders: “It was so amazing to be able to be understood right from the get-go and to be able to talk and respond to my daughter, especially because that was lacking completely from my life.”
paras.zh: 您可以在我们屡获殊荣的播客《The Deep End》第二季中聆听哈勒尔的自述。哈雷尔告诉桑德斯：“能够从一开始就被理解，能够与我的女儿交谈并做出回应，真是太棒了，尤其是因为我的生活完全缺乏这些。”

paras.en: In the podcast, Sanders digs into other innovations, including AI voice cloning, as well as the sinister potential of such technology to hijack people’s voices. “It might be used in a way people don’t want to have happen,” she says. Hear more wherever you get your podcasts.
paras.zh: 在播客中，桑德斯深入探讨了其他创新，包括人工智能语音克隆，以及此类技术劫持人们声音的险恶潜力。 “它可能会以人们不希望发生的方式被使用，”她说。无论您在何处获取播客，都能听到更多内容。

paras.en: In this issue, we also report on the progress in developing an effective treatment for stiff person syndrome, a rare autoimmune disorder that makes the body’s muscles freeze without warning. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration hasn’t yet approved any treatments for the disorder, which occurs in roughly 2 in 100,000 people. But that could some day change. Researchers are testing new CAR T cell therapies, senior writer Meghan Rosen reports. The process involves modifying a patient’s white blood cells so they wipe out harmful immune cells. Scientists hope a single treatment could cure the disease.
paras.zh: 在本期中，我们还报道了开发针对僵人综合症的有效治疗方法的进展，僵人综合症是一种罕见的自身免疫性疾病，会导致身体的肌肉在没有警告的情况下冻结。美国食品和药物管理局尚未批准任何治疗这种疾病的方法，这种疾病的发病率约为十万分之二。但有一天这种情况可能会改变。资深作家 Meghan Rosen 报道称，研究人员正在测试新的 CAR T 细胞疗法。该过程涉及修改患者的白细胞，从而消除有害的免疫细胞。科学家希望单一疗法就能治愈这种疾病。

paras.en: And there’s more controversy about using AI in mathematics, senior physics writer Emily Conover reports. OpenAI made waves when the company announced that it had solved one of the most famous puzzles in math — a day after mathematicians reported advances on a similar problem. The development is among a flood of AI-fueled achievements this year and raises big questions about who gets credit when the algorithms are doing the work.
paras.zh: 高级物理学作家艾米丽·科诺弗 (Emily Conover) 报道称，关于在数学中使用人工智能存在更多争议。当 OpenAI 宣布解决了数学界最著名的难题之一时，引起了轰动——一天前，数学家们报告了类似问题的进展。这一进展是今年人工智能推动的众多成就之一，并引发了一个大问题：当算法完成工作时，谁会获得功劳。

articles.title: Claude helped plan risky bird flu research. What did the AI add?
articles.author: Sascha Brodsky

paras.en: Anthropic’s Claude AI chatbot helped a scientist plan potentially risky bird flu experiments.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的 Claude AI 聊天机器人帮助一位科学家计划有潜在风险的禽流感实验。

paras.en: The researcher relied on Claude to plan studies, analyze data and choose experiments involving highly pathogenic avian influenza, the company reported September 10 in a threat intelligence report. The work sought to identify and introduce mutations that could help bird flu viruses adapt to mammals and transmit more easily between them. Anthropic says that, to its knowledge, no private company had previously publicly shared evidence of potential misuse of its platform for biological weapons development. But the company did not provide enough detail to determine whether Claude simply sped up work the researcher could already do or gave the researcher a new capability, experts say.
paras.zh: 该公司 9 月 10 日在一份威胁情报报告中称，研究人员依靠克劳德来规划研究、分析数据并选择涉及高致病性禽流感的实验。这项工作试图识别和引入突变，帮助禽流感病毒适应哺乳动物并更容易在它们之间传播。 Anthropic 表示，据其所知，此前没有任何私营公司公开分享过可能滥用其平台进行生物武器开发的证据。但专家表示，该公司没有提供足够的细节来确定克劳德是否只是加快了研究人员已经可以完成的工作，或者赋予了研究人员新的能力。

paras.en: Learning how avian influenza viruses might pose a pandemic risk “is absolutely a normal part of virology research,” says influenza researcher Thomas Friedrich of the University of Wisconsin–Madison School of Veterinary Medicine. Such research can help scientists assess whether emerging bird flu viruses pose a greater risk to humans.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校兽医学院的流感研究员托马斯·弗里德里希（Thomas Friedrich）表示，了解禽流感病毒如何可能造成大流行风险“绝对是病毒学研究的正常组成部分”。此类研究可以帮助科学家评估新出现的禽流感病毒是否对人类构成更大的风险。

paras.en: But experiments that deliberately aim to boost pathogen traits such as transmissibility or disease severity draw scrutiny, Friedrich says, because of concerns about accidents or misuse.
paras.zh: 但弗里德里希说，出于对事故或滥用的担忧，故意旨在增强病原体特征（例如传播性或疾病严重程度）的实验受到了严格审查。

paras.en: Though the report comes amid broader debates about the security of AI models, arguments over this “gain-of-function” research predate generative AI. In 2012, studies involving H5N1 bird flu and airborne transmission in ferrets prompted an international debate over whether the scientific benefits outweighed the risks. Some H5N1 transmission experiments were put on hold for a year while researchers and officials worked out how to handle the risks.
paras.zh: 尽管该报告是在有关人工智能模型安全性的更广泛辩论中发布的，但有关“功能获得”研究的争论早于生成式人工智能。 2012年，涉及H5N1禽流感和雪貂空气传播的研究引发了一场关于科学效益是否大于风险的国际争论。一些 H5N1 传播实验被搁置一年，研究人员和官员正在研究如何应对风险。

paras.en: In Anthropic’s case, discovered in May 2026, the bird flu researcher accessed Claude from a region where the service was not supported or available. Anthropic says the researcher used workarounds to access Claude anyway. Material shared with Claude suggested the group probably had physical access to relevant virus samples. Anthropic banned the researcher’s account in May for evading restrictions on access.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年 5 月发现的 Anthropic 案例中，禽流感研究人员从不支持或不提供该服务的地区访问了 Claude。 Anthropic 表示，研究人员无论如何都使用了变通办法来访问克劳德。与克劳德分享的材料表明，该组织可能能够实际接触到相关病毒样本。 Anthropic 在 5 月份禁止了该研究人员的账户，因为该账户规避了访问限制。

paras.en: Anthropic says it could not tell whether the researcher intended harm because legitimate and dangerous biological research can look similar. The company did not respond to questions from Science News about why it considered the case significant, how it assessed Claude’s role in the research or whether any proposed experiments had actually been performed.
paras.zh: Anthropic 表示，它无法判断研究人员是否有意造成伤害，因为合法和危险的生物学研究可能看起来很相似。该公司没有回答《科学新闻》关于为何认为此案意义重大、如何评估克劳德在研究中的作用以及是否实际进行了任何拟议实验的问题。

paras.en: Anthropic released too little information to determine the purpose of the work, says biodefense researcher Gregory Koblentz. “There is no evidence that any of this research was connected to the development of biological weapons,” says Koblentz of George Mason University in Fairfax, Va.
paras.zh: 生物防御研究员格雷戈里·科布伦茨 (Gregory Koblentz) 表示，人类发布的信息太少，无法确定这项工作的目的。 “没有证据表明任何这项研究与生物武器的开发有关，”弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯乔治梅森大学的科布伦茨说。

paras.en: The same kind of biological research can serve very different purposes, from civilian science to military defense. Even work done at a military-affiliated institution does not, on its own, show that researchers are developing a biological weapon, Koblentz says.
paras.zh: 同一种生物研究可以服务于从民用科学到军事防御等截然不同的目的。科布伦茨说，即使是在军事附属机构完成的工作本身也不能表明研究人员正在开发生物武器。

paras.en: Anthropic also did not provide enough detail to show exactly how much Claude helped, Friedrich says. The company’s own account suggests the AI model “did not meaningfully add scientific capability,” he says. In other words, it may simply have sped up the researcher’s work, rather than enabling something they could not have done otherwise.
paras.zh: 弗里德里希说，人性化也没有提供足够的细节来显示克劳德到底提供了多少帮助。他说，该公司自己的说法表明人工智能模型“并没有有意义地增加科学能力”。换句话说，它可能只是加快了研究人员的工作速度，而不是实现了他们本来无法完成的事情。

paras.en: Even if Claude’s role was only to speed up the work, that can make a big difference in a scientist’s workflow, says virologist David O’Connor of the University of Wisconsin–Madison. Systems such as Claude can help researchers find papers, synthesize results and parse data more quickly, he says. “Work or analyses that would have taken me months can now be done in an afternoon.”
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的病毒学家大卫·奥康纳说，即使克劳德的作用只是加快工作速度，这也可以对科学家的工作流程产生很大的影响。他说，像克劳德这样的系统可以帮助研究人员更快地找到论文、综合结果和解析数据。 “原本需要花费几个月时间的工作或分析现在可以在一个下午完成。”

paras.en: As a result, existing scientific information, including about avian flu viruses, may become easier to find and use, O’Connor says. O’Connor says frontier AI models could let scientists tackle questions they might not have attempted before. “The frontier models will change the ambition of research questions that are asked,” he says.
paras.zh: 奥康纳说，因此，现有的科学信息，包括有关禽流感病毒的信息，可能会变得更容易查找和使用。奥康纳表示，前沿人工智能模型可以让科学家解决他们以前可能没有尝试过的问题。 “前沿模型将改变所提出的研究问题的雄心，”他说。

paras.en: The bird flu research was one of five instances in Anthropic’s report involving uses of Claude that the company says could support biological weapons development. None of the five look technically sophisticated or particularly concerning to biologist Kevin Esvelt of the MIT Media Lab. Esvelt is more suspicious of the researchers’ motives; he says the five cases showed signs of ill intent. But none “represented a competent attempt at weaponization.”
paras.zh: 禽流感研究是 Anthropic 报告中涉及使用克劳德的五个实例之一，该公司称这些实例可以支持生物武器的开发。对于麻省理工学院媒体实验室的生物学家凯文·埃斯维尔特来说，这五者中没有一个看起来技术复杂或特别令人担忧。艾斯维特对研究人员的动机更加怀疑。他说，这五起案件显示出恶意的迹象。但没有一个“代表了武器化的有力尝试”。

paras.en: The poor quality of these particular attempts does not show what a more capable user might be able to do with AI-assisted biology, Esvelt says. AI can help with research and analysis, but turning an idea into a biological threat takes additional work, Koblentz says. “Even if AI is used to design a potentially dangerous pathogen, it is not a threat until the organism can be modified in a lab or synthesized.”
paras.zh: Esvelt 说，这些特定尝试的质量较差，并不能表明更有能力的用户可以利用人工智能辅助生物学做些什么。科布伦茨说，人工智能可以帮助研究和分析，但将一个想法转化为生物威胁需要额外的工作。 “即使人工智能被用来设计一种潜在危险的病原体，它也不会构成威胁，除非该生物体可以在实验室中进行修改或合成。”

paras.en: That requires facilities, measures for keeping viruses contained, funding, trained personnel and hands-on experience. Those barriers vary depending on who is doing the work, O’Connor says. They would be a major obstacle for an inexperienced person working alone, but less so for scientists with specialized training and access to a well-equipped laboratory.
paras.zh: 这需要控制病毒的设施、措施、资金、训练有素的人员和实践经验。奥康纳说，这些障碍取决于谁在做这项工作。对于缺乏经验的单独工作的人来说，它们将是一个主要障碍，但对于接受过专门培训并可以进入设备齐全的实验室的科学家来说，情况就不那么严重了。

paras.en: Regardless, the remaining laboratory steps are substantial, Friedrich writes in an email. “There is a big gap between identifying mutations that could potentially adapt an avian influenza virus to humans and a ‘harmful biological outcome’.”
paras.zh: 无论如何，剩下的实验室步骤是实质性的，弗里德里希在一封电子邮件中写道。 “识别可能使禽流感病毒适应人类的突变与‘有害的生物学结果’之间存在很大差距。”

articles.title: Volcanoes lurk behind the scenes of human history
articles.author: Carolyn Wilke

paras.en: “The bright sun was extinguish’d … and the icy earth swung blind and blackening in the moonless air.” These words from Lord Byron’s 1816 poem Darkness evoke a hellish apocalypse. But Byron may have been inspired by the fallout of a real cataclysm — one that happened half a world away.
paras.zh: “明亮的太阳熄灭了……冰冷的大地在无月的空气中变得盲目、变黑。”拜伦勋爵 1816 年的诗《黑暗》中的这些话唤起了地狱般的启示录。但拜伦的灵感可能是来自一场真正的灾难——一场发生在半个世界之外的灾难。

paras.en: Mount Tambora, in present-day Indonesia, blew its top in 1815. More than 71,000 people in the vicinity died. And climate-cooling aerosols from the eruption ushered in extreme weather the following years in far-flung places. Cold weather in the summer of 1816, sometimes with frosts and snow, destroyed corn in New England, rice and buckwheat in China and wheat, oats and potatoes in Ireland. In some places, the rising cost of bread sparked protests and riots. The circumstances may have helped spread typhus. Some called 1816 “the year without a summer,” others “the year of the beggars.”
paras.zh: 坦博拉山（位于今印度尼西亚）于 1815 年发生火山喷发，导致附近地区 71,000 多人死亡。火山喷发产生的气候冷却气溶胶在接下来的几年里在偏远地区迎来了极端天气。 1816 年夏季的寒冷天气，有时还伴有霜冻和降雪，毁坏了新英格兰的玉米、中国的稻米和荞麦以及爱尔兰的小麦、燕麦和土豆。在一些地方，面包价格上涨引发了抗议和骚乱。这种情况可能有助于斑疹伤寒的传播。有人称 1816 年为“没有夏天的一年”，也有人称 1816 年为“乞丐之年”。

paras.en: Like Tambora, volcanoes, and the cooling they cause, may be an underappreciated geologic force at times moving behind the scenes of human history.
paras.zh: 与坦博拉一样，火山及其引起的降温有时可能是一种未被充分认识的地质力量，在人类历史的幕后活动。

paras.en: “These climatic impacts of the Tambora eruption were recorded without any knowledge that this had anything to do with an eruption,” says Clive Oppenheimer, a volcanologist at the University of Cambridge.
paras.zh: 剑桥大学火山学家克莱夫·奥本海默 (Clive Oppenheimer) 表示：“记录坦博拉火山喷发对气候的影响时，我们并不知道这与火山喷发有关。”

paras.en: While Tambora is the most well-studied eruption in history, others have also rattled the planet. Oppenheimer and his colleagues analyzed 38 large eruptions in the 2026 Annual Review of Earth and Planetary Sciences. Their work pulled together studies linking the geologic events and their effects on climate with their potential societal fallout in food systems, the economy, unrest, culture and religion. The locations and exact timing of the eruptions that spurred some notable cold spurts aren’t known. But understanding how the events impacted the climate, environment and society can offer clues to the past, including how people coped with climate stress.
paras.zh: 虽然坦博拉火山喷发是历史上研究最深入的一次，但其他火山喷发也曾让地球感到不安。奥本海默和他的同事在《2026 年地球与行星科学年度评论》中分析了 38 次大型火山喷发。他们的工作汇集了将地质事件及其对气候的影响与粮食系统、经济、动乱、文化和宗教等潜在社会影响联系起来的研究。引发一些明显冷喷发的火山喷发的地点和确切时间尚不清楚。但了解这些事件如何影响气候、环境和社会可以为过去提供线索，包括人们如何应对气候压力。

paras.en: “Volcanic eruptions, they are kind of this like hammer blow to the climate system,” says Heli Huhtamaa, a climate and environmental historian at the University of Bern in Switzerland. Volcanoes may offer lessons about resilience for modern societies in a warming world, she says.
paras.zh: 瑞士伯尔尼大学气候和环境历史学家赫利·胡塔玛 (Heli Huhtamaa) 表示：“火山喷发就像是对气候系统的重击。”她说，火山可能为现代社会在变暖的世界中的恢复能力提供教训。

paras.en: Volcanoes spew sulfur-containing gases. Over weeks, those gases react in the atmosphere to form particles that block sunlight. The particles can stay aloft for many months, riding jet streams to encircle the globe. Paintings from years after eruptions show bloodred sunsets or landscapes shrouded by hazy skies.
paras.zh: 火山喷出含硫气体。几周后，这些气体在大气中发生反应，形成阻挡阳光的颗粒。这些粒子可以在高空停留数月，乘着急流环绕地球。火山喷发多年后的画作展示了血红色的日落或被朦胧的天空笼罩的风景。

paras.en: Because no two eruptions are exactly alike, it takes work to grasp each one’s impacts on weather and climate. “If we understand the climate response of one [eruption], that does not mean that we understand the climate response of another,” says Ulf Büntgen, a paleoclimatologist at the University of Cambridge.
paras.zh: 由于没有两次喷发是完全相同的，因此需要努力了解每次喷发对天气和气候的影响。剑桥大学古气候学家 Ulf Büntgen 表示：“如果我们了解一次[喷发]的气候反应，并不意味着我们了解另一次喷发的气候反应。”

paras.en: A volcano’s explosivity impacts how high it shoots its gases and where they travel. Over time, those gases form particles that block sunlight. The particles can stay aloft for many months, riding jet streams to encircle the globe. In this computer model of a 1991 eruption, colors represent how high particles are in the atmosphere. Red is high and blue is closer to Earth’s surface.
paras.zh: 火山的爆发力会影响其喷出气体的高度以及气体的传播位置。随着时间的推移，这些气体会形成阻挡阳光的颗粒。这些粒子可以在高空停留数月，乘着急流环绕地球。在这个 1991 年火山喷发的计算机模型中，颜色代表了大气中粒子的高度。红色较高，蓝色较接近地球表面。

paras.en: Researchers find the traces of past eruptions in ice cores from Greenland and Antarctica. Scientists try to nail down the date on a sulfur-loaded ice core layer and compare it with tree ring data, a logbook of sorts for summer growing conditions since temperatures impact how trees lay down their wood each year. Scientists can pull together tree ring records from far-flung places and use statistics to work out annual temperatures in a hemisphere.
paras.zh: 研究人员在格陵兰岛和南极洲的冰芯中发现了过去喷发的痕迹。科学家们试图确定含硫冰芯层上的日期，并将其与树木年轮数据进行比较，树木年轮数据是夏季生长条件的日志，因为温度会影响树木每年放下木材的方式。科学家可以收集遥远地方的树木年轮记录，并利用统计数据计算出半球的年气温。

paras.en: Cold spells sometimes jump out from tree ring records. For years when cool summers impeded the final stages of wood formation, a chemical method used to estimate temperatures turns wood layers blue. Büntgen and colleagues saw two blue rings around 1345. “And that is very rare. We never saw that two years in a row,” he says. The rings coincided with the timing of the Black Death’s spread in Europe, the team reported in 2025 in Communications Earth & Environment. The researchers traced the connections between chilly summers, poor grain harvests in the Mediterranean and shipping records showing how Italian city states imported flea-ridden grain from the Caucasus.
paras.zh: 寒潮有时会从树木年轮记录中跳出来。多年来，凉爽的夏季阻碍了木材形成的最后阶段，用于估算温度的化学方法使木层变成蓝色。 Büntgen 和同事在 1345 年左右看到了两个蓝色环。“这非常罕见。我们从未连续两年看到过这种情况，”他说。研究小组于 2025 年在《通信地球与环境》杂志上报告称，这些光环与黑死病在欧洲传播的时间一致。研究人员追踪了寒冷的夏季、地中海粮食歉收和意大利城邦如何从高加索地区进口跳蚤肆虐的谷物的航运记录之间的联系。

paras.en: Oppenheimer, Büntgen and their colleagues broadened the detective work for their 2026 review. The team studied Northern Hemisphere temperature responses to the 38 largest eruptions between A.D. 1 and 1900. On average, each volcano caused about 0.5 degrees Celsius of cooling in the year after the eruption. Recovery to normal temperatures was slower for eruptions that occurred in times that were already colder on average, Büntgen says. In some periods, large or successive eruptions may lead to an elevated amounts of particles in the atmosphere for a long time. The team’s calculations show that high aerosol levels concur with some of the past two millennia’s coldest spells, such as the one preceding the Black Death.
paras.zh: 奥本海默、邦特根和他们的同事扩大了 2026 年审查的侦探工作范围。研究小组研究了北半球对公元 1 年至 1900 年间 38 次最大火山喷发的温度反应。平均而言，每座火山在喷发后的一年内造成约 0.5 摄氏度的降温。宾根说，对于平均已经较冷的时期发生的火山喷发，恢复到正常温度的速度较慢。在某些时期，大规模或连续的喷发可能会导致大气中颗粒物的数量长期增加。研究小组的计算表明，高气溶胶水平与过去两千年来一些最冷的时期一致，例如黑死病之前的那一次。

paras.en: Human agency factors into eruptions’ outcomes
paras.zh: 人类因素影响火山喷发的结果

paras.en: Those cold snaps often had dire consequences. Out of 17 large-scale famines in Europe from 1300 to 1800, 11 followed major eruptions. In addition to faltering crops and famines, the most frequently societal responses described in studies collected by the review authors were disease outbreaks, political turmoil and migration.
paras.zh: 这些寒潮往往会带来可怕的后果。 1300年至1800年间，欧洲发生了17次大规模饥荒，其中11次是在大规模火山爆发之后发生的。除了农作物歉收和饥荒之外，该综述作者收集的研究中描述的最常见的社会反应是疾病爆发、政治动荡和移民。

paras.en: The societal circumstances surrounding eruptions are as important as the amount of cooling, Huhtamaa says. She and her colleagues studied crop failures and farmstead desertion in three different volcanic eruptions that impacted Ostrobothnia, in what is now Finland. During the 17th century, Ostrobothnia experienced cooling from three sets of eruptions at different time periods.
paras.zh: 胡塔玛说，围绕火山喷发的社会环境与降温程度同样重要。 She and her colleagues studied crop failures and farmstead desertion in three different volcanic eruptions that impacted Ostrobothnia, in what is now Finland. 17 世纪，博滕区经历了不同时期的三轮喷发导致的降温。

paras.en: Although the latest eruption event, in 1695, was the coldest of all, peasants fared better than they had after eruptions earlier in the century, Huhtamaa and colleagues reported in 2022 in Climate of the Past. Though people still starved, only around 7 percent of peasants lost their farmland, compared with 20 percent in the other periods. This was because the crown provided tax relief, Huhtamaa says. This wasn’t humanitarian aid, as it was meant to preserve the tax base and prevent possibly decades of lost revenue.
paras.zh: Huhtamaa 及其同事在 2022 年的《过去的气候》中报告说，尽管 1695 年的最近一次火山喷发是所有火山中最冷的一次，但农民的情况比本世纪初火山喷发后的情况要好。尽管人们仍然在挨饿，但只有约 7% 的农民失去了耕地，而其他时期这一比例为 20%。胡塔玛说，这是因为政府提供税收减免。这不是人道主义援助，因为它的目的是保护税基并防止可能数十年的收入损失。

paras.en: “When there is a climatic shock, it doesn’t matter if it’s 0.5 or 1.5 degrees cooler, because what really matters is the societal vulnerability,” Huhtamaa says.
paras.zh: “当发生气候冲击时，气温降低 0.5 度还是 1.5 度并不重要，因为真正重要的是社会脆弱性，”Huhtamaa 说。

paras.en: Studies like Huhtamaa’s reveal how societies can tick on in spite of climate disasters. But historians haven’t always been keen to look to climate for clues to explain history. Human agency has often been considered the only reasonable explanation for human affairs, Huhtamaa says. “And climate explanations sounded lazy.”
paras.zh: 像胡塔玛这样的研究揭示了社会如何在气候灾难的影响下继续发展。但历史学家并不总是热衷于从气候中寻找解释历史的线索。胡塔玛说，人类能动性通常被认为是对人类事务的唯一合理解释。 “气候解释听起来很懒。”

paras.en: Investigating societies’ preconditions and responses to the climate change caused by volcanoes could help people prepare for a now warming world. A recent report from the United Nations’ Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, noted that not enough research had been done on responses, Huhtamaa says. Researchers could examine one place’s response to different events, as in Huhtamaa’s work on Ostrobothnia, or parse different locales’ responses to the same event. Meanwhile, greater use of insights from ecology, agronomy and economics, for instance, can help with this detective work that reveals how humans respond to climatic events beyond their control.
paras.zh: 研究社会对火山引起的气候变化的先决条件和应对措施可以帮助人们为现在变暖的世界做好准备。胡塔玛说，联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会最近的一份报告指出，尚未对应对措施进行足够的研究。研究人员可以检查一个地方对不同事件的反应，就像 Huhtamaa 对 Ostrobothnia 的研究一样，或者解析不同地区对同一事件的反应。与此同时，更多地利用生态学、农学和经济学等领域的见解，可以帮助开展这项侦探工作，揭示人类如何应对超出其控制的气候事件。

paras.en: Those responses appear in religion, too. For instance, lines in the famed 10th century poem Vǫluspá seem to reference the 939 eruption of Iceland’s Eldgjá volcano, with high-flying flames and blackened sun beams. “It’s like an eyewitness description of a phenomenal lava flood,” Oppenheimer says. The poem foretells a fiery end to pagan gods, such as Odin, who are replaced by one god. Vǫluspá, which explained the eruption in terms of divine displeasure,may have contributed to the island’s Christianization around 1000, Oppenheimer and colleagues suggest.
paras.zh: 这些反应也出现在宗教中。例如，著名的 10 世纪诗歌《Vǫluspá》中的诗句似乎参考了 939 年冰岛 Eldgja 火山的喷发，当时喷发的火焰高高飘扬，太阳光线变黑。 “这就像目击者对一场惊人的熔岩洪水的描述，”奥本海默说。这首诗预言了奥丁等异教诸神将迎来火热的结局，他们将被一位神所取代。奥本海默及其同事认为，Vǫluspá 将火山喷发解释为神圣的不满，这可能促成了公元 1000 年左右该岛的基督教化。

paras.en: Famines, riots, disease, migration. The widespread climatic effects of volcanoes across the ages may be subtler than the hellscapes conjured by poets but more tangible in the marks they’ve left on history.
paras.zh: 饥荒、骚乱、疾病、移民。各个时代火山对气候的广泛影响可能比诗人想象中的地狱景象更微妙，但它们在历史上留下的印记却更为明显。

articles.title: Exercise 'Snacking' Can Build Similar Strength to One Big Training Session, Study Finds
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Exercise doesn't have to be a long, hard slog.
paras.zh: 锻炼不一定是一个漫长而艰苦的过程。

paras.en: A small new study has now found that bite-sized 'snacks' of physical activity throughout the day can build comparable strength to one big workout.
paras.zh: 一项小型新研究发现，全天进行一口大小的身体活动“零食”可以增强与一次大型锻炼相当的力量。

paras.en: In the experiment, 45 young male students aged 18 to 25 who already lifted weights regularly took part in an eight-week squatting program.
paras.zh: 在实验中，45名年龄在18岁至25岁之间、已经定期举重的年轻男学生参加了为期八周的深蹲计划。

paras.en: Three times a week, participants either completed three 1-minute bouts of resistance training, each including just 20 weighted squats, or a single continuous session of 60 weighted squats.
paras.zh: 参与者每周 3 次，要么完成 3 轮 1 分钟的阻力训练，每次仅包括 20 次负重深蹲，要么完成一次连续 60 次负重深蹲。

paras.en: The squats were performed using a Smith machine under expert supervision, and the weight squatted became progressively heavier for each individual over the course of two months.
paras.zh: 深蹲是在专家监督下使用史密斯机进行的，在两个月的过程中，每个人深蹲的重量逐渐增加。

paras.en: By the end of the trial, researchers found no significant differences between the fragmented resistance training and traditional training in terms of relative muscular endurance or strength.
paras.zh: 试验结束时，研究人员发现分段阻力训练与传统训练在相对肌肉耐力或力量方面没有显着差异。

paras.en: Participants who 'snacked' on their squats throughout the day reported having more fun than those who completed one big squatting session.
paras.zh: 全天在深蹲中“吃零食”的参与者报告说，比完成一次大型深蹲训练的参与者更有趣。

paras.en: "Dividing the same training volume into several brief sessions may reduce the perceived burden associated with prolonged exercise while allowing individuals greater flexibility to integrate exercise into their daily schedules," the study authors hypothesize.
paras.zh: 研究作者假设：“将相同的训练量分成几个简短的训练课程可以减少与长时间锻炼相关的感知负担，同时允许个人更灵活地将锻炼融入他们的日常安排中。”

paras.en: The research was led by scientists at Tongji University in China, and the results have been published in the Journal of Exercise Science & Fitness.
paras.zh: 该研究由中国同济大学的科学家领导，研究结果发表在《运动科学与健身杂志》上。

paras.en: "The present findings do not support the conclusion that traditional continuous resistance training is superior," the authors conclude.
paras.zh: “目前的研究结果并不支持传统的持续阻力训练更优越的结论，”作者总结道。

paras.en: "Instead, they indicate that distributing resistance training across multiple short bouts throughout the day provides neuromuscular adaptations comparable to those achieved through conventional continuous training."
paras.zh: “相反，他们表明，在一天中多次进行短时间的阻力训练可以提供与传统持续训练相当的神经肌肉适应。”

paras.en: Further research is now needed to investigate how these exercises compare over longer training periods and across more diverse cohorts.
paras.zh: 现在需要进一步的研究来调查这些练习在更长的训练时间和更多样化的群体中如何进行比较。

paras.en: According to these preliminary results, however, fragmented exercise could be a practical alternative for people who are time-constrained.
paras.zh: 然而，根据这些初步结果，对于时间有限的人来说，分散锻炼可能是一种实用的选择。

paras.en: Recently, the concept of 'exercise snacking' has gained popularity.
paras.zh: 最近，“运动零食”的概念开始流行。

paras.en: Emerging evidence suggests that even small bouts of physical activity throughout the day can improve cardiorespiratory fitness, glycemic regulation, and several markers of health.
paras.zh: 新的证据表明，即使全天进行少量的体力活动也可以改善心肺健康、血糖调节和多项健康指标。

paras.en: Most of these studies, however, are limited to aerobic activities such as climbing stairs or brisk walking.
paras.zh: 然而，这些研究大多数仅限于有氧活动，例如爬楼梯或快走。

paras.en: A large study suggests that putting in 90 to 119 minutes per week of resistance training is the sweet spot for lower mortality risk, but that doesn't necessarily mean all that exercise has to occur in one big gym session.
paras.zh: 一项大型研究表明，每周进行 90 至 119 分钟的阻力训练是降低死亡风险的最佳选择，但这并不一定意味着所有锻炼都必须在一次大型健身课程中进行。

paras.en: Breaking these minutes of physical activity into bite-sized chunks may stop fatigue from setting in, allowing for better-quality reps.
paras.zh: 将这些分钟的身体活动分成小块可以防止疲劳，从而实现更好质量的重复次数。

paras.en: A recent study, for instance, found that holding a squat or plank pose a few times a week can help lower blood pressure, "providing a pragmatic option for individuals with limited time or adherence challenges."
paras.zh: 例如，最近的一项研究发现，每周保持几次深蹲或平板支撑姿势有助于降低血压，“为时间有限或难以坚持的人提供了一个务实的选择。”

paras.en: On the flip side, however, continuous training may help build better endurance than smaller 'snacks'.
paras.zh: 然而，另一方面，持续训练可能比小“零食”更有助于增强耐力。

paras.en: To test these possible outcomes, researchers in China randomized a small cohort of young male students to either partake in fragmented resistance training, continuous training, or no supervised training at all.
paras.zh: 为了测试这些可能的结果，中国的研究人员随机抽取了一小群年轻男学生，让他们要么参加零散的阻力训练，要么参加持续训练，要么根本不参加监督训练。

paras.en: Participants had their strength and endurance tested at the start and end of the trial.
paras.zh: 参与者在试验开始和结束时接受了力量和耐力测试。

paras.en: For endurance, participants were asked to squat as many times as possible at 40 percent of their maximum squat weight.
paras.zh: 为了提高耐力，参与者被要求以最大深蹲重量的 40% 进行尽可能多次的深蹲。

paras.en: Beforehand, participants were asked to refrain from alcohol, as well as strenuous physical activity, for at least 24 hours.
paras.zh: 事先，参与者被要求至少 24 小时内不要饮酒，也不要进行剧烈的体力活动。

paras.en: They were also asked to get enough sleep prior to their testing sessions.
paras.zh: 他们还被要求在测试前保证充足的睡眠。

paras.en: In the end, muscular strength, isometric squat force, and relative muscular endurance improved in both exercise cohorts compared to the control group.
paras.zh: 最终，与对照组相比，两个运动组的肌肉力量、等长蹲力和相对肌肉耐力都有所改善。

paras.en: Even though traditional training yielded greater gains in strength and endurance than exercise snacking, the differences were not statistically significant.
paras.zh: 尽管传统训练比运动零食更能提高力量和耐力，但差异在统计上并不显着。

paras.en: "Our hypothesis that traditional resistance training would produce greater improvements in muscular strength and relative muscular endurance than fragmented resistance training was not supported," the authors conclude.
paras.zh: 作者总结道：“我们的假设是，传统的阻力训练会比碎片化的阻力训练更能提高肌肉力量和相对肌肉耐力，但这一假设并未得到支持。”

paras.en: These findings will need to be verified in follow-up trials, but it's possible that exercise snacking could make workouts feel easier to complete.
paras.zh: 这些发现需要在后续试验中得到验证，但运动零食可能会让锻炼感觉更容易完成。

paras.en: This, in turn, could enhance feelings of autonomy and achievement, making exercise more enjoyable.
paras.zh: 反过来，这可以增强自主感和成就感，使锻炼变得更加愉快。

paras.en: The barrier to exercise can sometimes feel insurmountable.
paras.zh: 锻炼的障碍有时会让人感觉难以克服。

paras.en: Biting off a small chunk at a time could make healthy tasks much more digestible.
paras.zh: 一次咬掉一小块可以让健康的任务更容易消化。

paras.en: The research has been published in the Journal of Exercise Science & Fitness.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《运动科学与健身杂志》上。

articles.title: These 1970s Kids Had to Stay in School For 1 Year Longer. Decades Later, The Results Are Dramatic.
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: There's a lot of research showing that higher education levels are linked to a lower risk of Alzheimer's disease, and staying in school for longer is associated with benefits to health and longevity too.
paras.zh: 大量研究表明，较高的教育水平与较低的阿尔茨海默氏病风险有关，并且在校时间较长也与健康和长寿的益处相关。

paras.en: But because virtually all the evidence for this comes from observational studies, it's hard to know for sure whether education causes the positive health effects we see, or if other explanations drive the changes – like genetics, childhood circumstances, or socioeconomic factors.
paras.zh: 但由于几乎所有证据都来自观察性研究，因此很难确定教育是否会带来我们所看到的积极健康影响，或者其他解释是否会推动这些变化——例如遗传、童年环境或社会经济因素。

paras.en: "We have known for a long time that people with more education are less likely to develop dementia, but it has been difficult to know whether education itself is responsible," explains health economist Silvia Barcellos from the University of Wisconsin-Madison.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的健康经济学家西尔维娅·巴塞洛斯（Silvia Barcellos）解释说：“我们很早就知道，受教育程度较高的人患痴呆症的可能性较小，但很难知道教育本身是否是造成这种情况的原因。”

paras.en: Now, however, thanks to a landmark legal reform that took place in the UK in the 1970s, researchers have identified what they believe is the first evidence of its kind demonstrating a causal link between education and reduced dementia incidence.
paras.zh: 然而现在，由于 20 世纪 70 年代英国进行了一项具有里程碑意义的法律改革，研究人员发现了他们认为的第一个此类证据，证明教育与降低痴呆症发病率之间存在因果关系。

paras.en: In a new study published in PNAS, Barcellos and fellow researchers investigated the long-term effects of the 1972 Raising of School-Leaving Age Act (ROSLA), which increased the minimum age at which students could drop out of school in England, Scotland, and Wales, raising it from 15 to 16 years of age.
paras.zh: 在《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一项新研究中，巴塞洛斯和其他研究人员调查了 1972 年《提高离校年龄法案》(ROSLA) 的长期影响，该法案提高了英格兰、苏格兰和威尔士学生辍学的最低年龄，从 15 岁提高到 16 岁。

paras.en: "The reform affected only students born after September 1, 1957, generating a discontinuity in the relationship between education and date of birth," the researchers explain in their paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中解释道：“这项改革只影响 1957 年 9 月 1 日之后出生的学生，导致教育与出生日期之间的关系出现中断。”

paras.en: That strict cut-off date created the conditions for a "natural experiment", enabling the researchers to compare the subsequent health in later life of students who had to stay in school until 16 (the "treated" students, who are now in their late sixties) with that of their peers from directly before the change took effect, who could leave school at 15 (the "control" group).
paras.zh: 这一严格的截止日期为“自然实验”创造了条件，使研究人员能够将必须留在学校直到 16 岁的学生（“接受治疗的”学生，现在已经 60 多岁了）与改变生效之前的同龄人（“对照组”）的晚年健康状况进行比较，这些学生可以在 15 岁时离开学校（“对照组”）。

paras.en: "This setting provided a unique opportunity to study the causal effects of education on Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) incidence," the researchers explain.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说：“这种环境提供了一个独特的机会来研究教育对阿尔茨海默病和相关痴呆症（ADRD）发病率的因果影响。”

paras.en: "If, as hypothesized, there is a causal relationship between education and ADRD, then one would expect to observe a corresponding discontinuity in the relationship between ADRD and date of birth at September 1, 1957.
paras.zh: “如果正如假设的那样，教育与 ADRD 之间存在因果关系，那么人们就会期望观察到 ADRD 与 1957 年 9 月 1 日出生日期之间的关系相应的不连续性。

paras.en: "Because individuals born right before and right after this date would have had similar ADRD incidence in the absence of the policy, any observed discontinuity could be attributed to the difference in schooling engendered by the policy."
paras.zh: “因为在没有这项政策的情况下，在此日期之前和之后出生的人会出现类似的 ADRD 发病率，因此任何观察到的不连续性都可以归因于该政策造成的学校教育差异。”

paras.en: In another study published earlier this year, researchers drew upon a similar kind of historical 'experiment', examining the effects of strict sugar rationing on babies in the UK during World War II.
paras.zh: 在今年早些时候发表的另一项研究中，研究人员利用了类似的历史“实验”，研究了二战期间英国严格的糖配给对婴儿的影响。

paras.en: In that research, scientists used data from the huge UK Biobank study to see how the WWII children's health developed as they grew into adults, and how their health differed from contemporaneous children who didn't experience sugar limits.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，科学家们利用英国生物银行的大型研究数据来了解二战儿童在成长过程中的健康状况如何发展，以及他们的健康状况与同期没有经历过糖限制的儿童有何不同。

paras.en: In their own research, Barcellos' team also sourced their information from the UK Biobank data, and it appears to have confirmed their hypothesis about education and dementia.
paras.zh: 在他们自己的研究中，巴塞洛斯的团队还从英国生物银行的数据中获取了信息，这似乎证实了他们关于教育和痴呆症的假设。

paras.en: "Our findings indicate that education has a negative causal effect on ADRD incidence," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“我们的研究结果表明，教育对 ADRD 的发生率具有负面因果影响。”

paras.en: "There is a sharp decline in ADRD cumulative incidence among those born after September 1, 1957."
paras.zh: “1957 年 9 月 1 日之后出生的人中 ADRD 累积发病率急剧下降。”

paras.en: In the researchers' calculations, the effects of staying in school for one year longer reduced ADRD cumulative incidence in the cohort by approximately 0.88 percentage points – an effect that the team acknowledges is implausibly large, given that the prevalence of ADRD in the sample was lower than 1 percent overall.
paras.zh: 在研究人员的计算中，在学校多呆一年的影响使队列中 ADRD 的累积发生率降低了约 0.88 个百分点——研究小组承认，考虑到样本中 ADRD 的患病率总体低于 1%，这一效应大得令人难以置信。

paras.en: The team suggests the anomalous result might be due to statistical factors, but while they say they can't provide an entirely accurate estimate of the extent of the reduction in dementia cases, they say the evidence supports a causal effect.
paras.zh: 研究小组认为，异常结果可能是由于统计因素造成的，但尽管他们表示无法对痴呆症病例的减少程度提供完全准确的估计，但他们表示证据支持因果效应。

paras.en: "Although our sample is large, ADRD remains a rare outcome in these relatively young cohorts, and regression discontinuity designs require very large samples to achieve precise estimates," they write.
paras.zh: 他们写道：“尽管我们的样本量很大，但 ADRD 在这些相对年轻的人群中仍然是一种罕见的结果，并且回归不连续性设计需要非常大的样本才能实现精确的估计。”

paras.en: "We can credibly estimate the direction of the causal effect of education, but not its precise magnitude."
paras.zh: “我们可以可靠地估计教育因果效应的方向，但不能准确估计其大小。”

paras.en: In addition to measuring the reduced incidence of dementia in children who were born after 1 September 1957, the researchers also examined DNA from the study participants, sorting them into high risk or low risk for ADRD based on whether they had certain genetic variations, including the Alzheimer's risk gene APOE4.
paras.zh: 除了测量 1957 年 9 月 1 日之后出生的儿童痴呆症发病率降低的情况外，研究人员还检查了研究参与者的 DNA，根据他们是否具有某些遗传变异（包括阿尔茨海默病风险基因 APOE4），将他们分为 ADRD 高风险或低风险。

paras.en: For children born before the school dropout age changed, individuals with high genetic risk experienced significantly greater incidence of ADRD, but among those born after the change, the extra year of schooling was associated with a significant reduction in dementia incidence in the high-risk group.
paras.zh: 对于在辍学年龄改变之前出生的儿童，具有高遗传风险的个体的 ADRD 发病率显着更高，但在改变之后出生的儿童中，多学一年与高风险群体的痴呆发病率显着降低相关。

paras.en: "For people who know they have a higher genetic risk of dementia, this is a hopeful finding," says study co-author Leandro Carvalho, a health economist at the University of Southern California.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、南加州大学健康经济学家莱安德罗·卡瓦略 (Leandro Carvalho) 表示：“对于那些知道自己患痴呆症的遗传风险较高的人来说，这是一个充满希望的发现。”

paras.en: "Genes help shape disease risk, but they do not necessarily determine the outcome."
paras.zh: “基因有助于塑造疾病风险，但不一定决定结果。”

paras.en: While we can't know for sure what it was about that extra year of education that delivered the health benefits, the researchers suggest it could have been due to socioeconomic advantages produced by additional schooling, which may have elevated their school qualifications, income, and occupational status.
paras.zh: 虽然我们不能确定额外一年的教育对健康带来的好处是什么，但研究人员认为，这可能是由于额外的学校教育带来的社会经济优势，这可能提高了他们的学历、收入和职业地位。

paras.en: Compounded over a half-century, those advantages might have added up considerably, conferring protection against neurodegeneration, even in some high-risk individuals.
paras.zh: 经过半个世纪的积累，这些优势可能会显着增加，从而提供针对神经退行性疾病的保护，即使对于一些高风险个体也是如此。

paras.en: Related: Scientists Found a Blood Signature Linked to 23% Lower Risk of Death
paras.zh: 相关：科学家发现血液特征可将死亡风险降低 23%

paras.en: There's still a lot we don't fully understand, and it's worth noting that the findings here stem from unique historical circumstances.
paras.zh: 还有很多东西我们还没有完全理解，值得注意的是，这里的发现源于独特的历史环境。

paras.en: But if it happened once, maybe it can happen again.
paras.zh: 但如果它发生过一次，也许它会再次发生。

paras.en: "Our results suggest that experiences and circumstances that can be changed over the course of life may influence whether inherited susceptibility ultimately translates into disease," Carvalho says.
paras.zh: 卡瓦略说：“我们的研究结果表明，在生命过程中可以改变的经历和环境可能会影响遗传易感性是否最终转化为疾病。”

paras.en: "Understanding which interventions can produce these protective effects is an important direction for future research."
paras.zh: “了解哪些干预措施可以产生这些保护作用是未来研究的一个重要方向。”

articles.title: PFAS Levels in US Drinking Water Could Be Twice as High as Reported
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are often informally referred to as 'forever chemicals' because they've soaked so deeply into the environment and take such a long time to break down.
paras.zh: 全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质 (PFAS) 通常被非正式地称为“永久化学品”，因为它们已深深地渗透到环境中，并且需要很长时间才能分解。

paras.en: There are thousands of these PFAS in circulation, used extensively in manufacturing and product materials, and scientists are busy continuing to assess what exactly the health risks of all of them are – and to what extent we're exposed to them every day.
paras.zh: 此类 PFAS 有数千种在流通，广泛用于制造和产品材料，科学家们正忙于继续评估所有这些 PFAS 的健康风险究竟是什么，以及我们每天接触它们的程度。

paras.en: In a new study in Cell Reports Sustainability, researchers from the US estimate that levels of PFAS in the drinking water of Americans could be twice as high as standard reporting suggests.
paras.zh: 在《Cell Reports Sustainability》的一项新研究中，美国研究人员估计，美国人饮用水中的 PFAS 含量可能是标准报告显示的两倍。

paras.en: The reason for the discrepancy is a matter of rounding. When the numbers have been crunched previously, there's usually a threshold below which PFAS levels are rounded down – and that's not what the study authors did here.
paras.zh: 差异的原因是四舍五入的问题。当之前对数字进行处理时，通常会存在一个阈值，低于该阈值，PFAS 水平会向下舍入 - 而这并不是研究作者在此所做的。

paras.en: "When the levels of these chemicals are below our reporting limit, it's often treated as zero when we calculate how widespread they are," says environmental scientist Gehendra Kharel, from Texas Christian University.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯基督教大学的环境科学家 Gehendra Kharel 表示：“当这些化学物质的含量低于我们的报告限值时，我们在计算它们的分布范围时通常将其视为零。”

paras.en: "We set out to understand how treating those results as zero changes the picture of PFAS occurrence in drinking water."
paras.zh: “我们着手了解将这些结果视为零如何改变饮用水中 PFAS 的出现情况。”

paras.en: The researchers analyzed 1.86 million drinking water data points supplied by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) in the US. They found 98 percent of the readings were below the minimum reporting level (MRL).
paras.zh: 研究人员分析了美国环境保护署 (EPA) 提供的 186 万个饮用水数据点。他们发现 98% 的读数低于最低报告水平 (MRL)。

paras.en: That means the traces of PFAS aren't high enough to be measured reliably by a lab, the study team says – but it doesn't mean there aren't any of the chemicals there, or that the water is guaranteed to be safe.
paras.zh: 研究小组表示，这意味着 PFAS 的含量不够高，无法由实验室进行可靠测量，但这并不意味着那里没有任何化学物质，也不意味着水可以保证是安全的。

paras.en: Computer models were then used to predict what the values below the MRL might be, based on the figures that had been registered in the drinking water for 25 different PFAS.
paras.zh: 然后，根据饮用水中 25 种不同 PFAS 的记录数据，使用计算机模型来预测低于 MRL 的值。

paras.en: Using the statistics produced by the models, the researchers suggest standard reports may be giving an average level of these chemicals that's 56 percent lower than the models estimate.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用模型生成的统计数据表明，标准报告给出的这些化学物质的平均水平可能比模型估计的低 56%。

paras.en: For the six PFAS that the EPA specifically sets legal limits for in drinking water, the researchers came up with an average of 5.2 nanograms per liter, compared to 2.6 nanograms per liter when below-limit results are counted as zero.
paras.zh: 对于 EPA 在饮用水中专门设定的六种 PFAS 的法定限值，研究人员得出的平均含量为每升 5.2 纳克，而低于限值的结果被视为零时，每升为 2.6 纳克。

paras.en: Overall, these hidden chemical levels pushed only a few dozen extra sampling locations over the EPA's benchmarks for PFOA and PFOS, but the researchers stress they're essential to getting a full picture of the problem.
paras.zh: 总体而言，这些隐藏的化学物质含量仅比 EPA 的 PFOA 和 PFOS 基准增加了几十个额外的采样点，但研究人员强调，它们对于全面了解问题至关重要。

paras.en: "Our study only examines how PFAS measurements are summarized," says Kharel. "It does not establish that every below-limit result poses a health risk."
paras.zh: “我们的研究仅研究如何总结 PFAS 测量值，”Kharel 说。 “它并不能证明每一个低于限制的结果都会带来健康风险。”

paras.en: The researchers would like to see more sensitive testing measures introduced, to remove the need to round down, as well as more extensive water system monitoring. They're also making the PFAS Censoring-Aware Screening Tool (PFAS-CAST) used here available for other teams and agencies to use.
paras.zh: 研究人员希望看到引入更敏感的测试措施，以消除向下舍入的需要，以及更广泛的水系统监测。他们还使此处使用的 PFAS 审查感知筛选工具 (PFAS-CAST) 可供其他团队和机构使用。

paras.en: "Future work combining this framework and PFAS-CAST with improved laboratory sensitivity, treatment engineering, exposure science, public health, and equity research could strengthen contaminant monitoring and help direct limited resources to places where better evidence would have the greatest benefit," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“未来的工作将这一框架和 PFAS-CAST 与改进的实验室灵敏度、处理工程、暴露科学、公共卫生和公平研究相结合，可以加强污染物监测，并有助于将有限的资源引导到有更好证据的地方，从而获得最大效益。”

paras.en: As for how dangerous these PFAS actually are, we're still not entirely sure. They've been linked to faster aging, the spread of cancer, weaker bones, and multiple sclerosis in the past, though it's difficult to prove direct cause and effect.
paras.zh: 至于这些 PFAS 实际上有多危险，我们仍然不完全确定。过去，它们与加速衰老、癌症扩散、骨骼脆弱和多发性硬化症有关，尽管很难证明直接的因果关系。

paras.en: Unfortunately, by the time their potential health complications started to come to light – not thanks to the businesses making them – PFAS were already well established.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，当它们潜在的健康并发症开始被发现时——这并不是制造它们的企业——PFAS 已经很成熟了。

paras.en: There's growing momentum behind greater regulation for forever chemicals, but a lot of the damage may have already been done.
paras.zh: 对永久化学品进行更严格监管的势头不断增强，但许多损害可能已经造成。

paras.en: A significant step towards a better understanding of PFAS exposure levels and health risks is knowing precisely just how much of these chemicals are out there, including in our drinking water – and the difference between 'zero' and 'less than MRL' is important.
paras.zh: 更好地了解 PFAS 暴露水平和健康风险的一个重要步骤是准确了解这些化学物质的含量，包括我们的饮用水中的含量，并且“零”和“低于最大残留限量”之间的区别非常重要。

paras.en: "Our method gives water agencies and utilities a way to account for that difference, so they can see where more testing would help and be clearer about what they do and do not know," says Kharel.
paras.zh: “我们的方法为水务机构和公用事业公司提供了一种解释这种差异的方法，这样他们就可以看到更多的测试会在哪些方面有所帮助，并更清楚地了解他们知道什么和不知道什么，”卡雷尔说。

paras.en: The research has been published in Cell Reports Sustainability.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《细胞可持续发展报告》上。

articles.title: Meteors don't just burn up. What really happens is far more violent

paras.en: Meteors don't just burn up. What really happens is far more violent
paras.zh: 流星不仅会燃烧。真正发生的事情要暴力得多

paras.en: - Scientists have uncovered seven surprising stages that space rocks go through as they hurtle toward Earth, revealing that melting and violent fragmentation, rather than simple evaporation, determine their fate. The discovery could help explain why meteorites scatter across the ground and how dangerous asteroids explode in Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了太空岩石在冲向地球时所经历的七个令人惊讶的阶段，揭示了它们的命运是由融化和剧烈的破碎而不是简单的蒸发决定的。这一发现可能有助于解释为什么陨石会散布在地面上，以及危险的小行星在地球大气层中如何爆炸。

paras.en: Scientists have gained a clearer understanding of what happens when rocks from space plunge into Earth's atmosphere and survive the journey to the ground. After examining video recordings and photographs of 75 meteorite falls, researchers identified seven stages that describe how these objects transform into meteorites. Their analysis reveals that melting and breaking apart play a much greater role than previously believed in determining how much material a rock loses, how quickly it slows down, and where its fragments eventually land. The findings were published in the journal Meteoritics & Planetary Science.
paras.zh: 科学家们对当来自太空的岩石坠入地球大气层并在到达地面的旅程中幸存下来时会发生什么有了更清晰的了解。在检查了 75 个陨石坠落的视频记录和照片后，研究人员确定了描述这些物体如何转变为陨石的七个阶段。他们的分析表明，熔化和分裂在决定岩石材料损失量、减速速度以及碎片最终落在何处方面所起的作用比之前认为的要大得多。研究结果发表在《Meteoritics & Planetary Science》杂志上。

paras.en: "We used to think that solid rocks would evaporate from the enormous heat and brilliant light generated in the air collision," said meteor astronomer and lead author Dr. Peter Jenniskens of the SETI Institute and NASA Ames Research Center. "We found instead that first melting and then fragmentation controls how a rock loses mass."
paras.zh: “我们过去认为固体岩石会因空气碰撞中产生的巨大热量和明亮光线而蒸发，”流星天文学家、SETI 研究所和 NASA 艾姆斯研究中心的主要作者彼得·詹尼斯肯斯 (Peter Jenniskens) 博士说。 “我们发现，首先熔化然后破碎控制了岩石失去质量的方式。”

paras.en: The researchers determined that incoming space rocks pass through seven distinct phases as they travel through the atmosphere. Different physical processes dominate each phase, influencing the rock's appearance, behavior, and eventual fate.
paras.zh: 研究人员确定，进入的太空岩石在穿过大气层时会经历七个不同的阶段。不同的物理过程主导着每个阶段，影响着岩石的外观、行为和最终的命运。

paras.en: How Space Rocks Become Bright Meteor Fireballs
paras.zh: 太空岩石如何变成明亮的流星火球

paras.en: The journey begins in Phase 1, high above Earth, where the atmosphere becomes dense enough for the incoming rock to generate a shock wave ahead of it. As the rock collides with air molecules, both its surface and the surrounding gas heat up and begin to glow. This produces the streak of light commonly known as a meteor or "shooting star."
paras.zh: 旅程从第一阶段开始，位于地球上方，大气层变得足够稠密，足以让传入的岩石在其前方产生冲击波。当岩石与空气分子碰撞时，其表面和周围的气体都会升温并开始发光。这会产生通常被称为流星或“流星”的光条纹。

paras.en: During Phase 2, the meteor travels into increasingly dense air, causing its brightness to intensify. Some meteors also display repeating changes in brightness, which can reveal how quickly they are spinning. Among the fastest rotating objects examined, a complete rotation took between 0.5 and 5 seconds.
paras.zh: 在第二阶段，流星进入密度越来越大的空气中，导致其亮度增强。有些流星的亮度也会出现重复的变化，这可以揭示它们旋转的速度。在所检查的旋转速度最快的物体中，完整旋转一次需要 0.5 至 5 秒。

paras.en: One of the documented meteorite falls investigated in this study. Fireball produced by asteroid 2023 CX1 over Normandy, France, on February 13, 2023. Meteorites known as Saint-Pierre-le-Viger reached the ground that day and were subsequently recovered. Credit: Image courtesy of G. de Reijke.
paras.zh: 本研究调查了有记录的陨石坠落之一。 2023 年 2 月 13 日，法国诺曼底上空小行星 2023 CX1 产生的火球。名为圣皮埃尔勒维热的陨石当天抵达地面，随后被回收。图片来源：图片由 G. de Reijke 提供。

paras.en: By Phase 3, the meteor has become much brighter, developing into a fireball. At this point, melting becomes the primary process responsible for removing material from the rock. The intense airflow strips molten material from its surface, producing droplets that continue to evaporate after separating from the main body.
paras.zh: 到了第三阶段，流星变得更加明亮，发展成为火球。此时，熔化成为从岩石中去除材料的主要过程。强烈的气流将熔融材料从其表面剥离，产生液滴，与主体分离后继续蒸发。

paras.en: "In the laboratory, we cannot generate the amount of radiation that occurs in a natural atmospheric entry at those speeds," said Eric Stern, formerly at NASA Ames and now chief scientist at Hyperspace Technologies, Inc. "Rock could aggressively fragment and erode instead, but then we would not expect the observed systematics in how fireballs brighten."
paras.zh: “在实验室里，我们无法以这样的速度产生自然进入大气层时产生的辐射量，”前美国宇航局艾姆斯航空航天局艾姆斯航空航天局埃姆斯、现超空间技术公司首席科学家埃里克·斯特恩说。“相反，岩石可能会剧烈破碎和侵蚀，但我们不会期望观察到火球如何变亮的系统学。”

paras.en: The fireball enters Phase 4 at an altitude of approximately 60 kilometers (around 40 miles), when melting reaches a relatively stable balance. During this stage, the fireball's brightness either remains nearly constant or increases at a steady rate. According to the researchers, melting alone can ultimately remove as much as 40 percent of the original rock's mass.
paras.zh: 火球在大约60公里（约40英里）的高度进入第四阶段，此时融化达到相对稳定的平衡。在此阶段，火球的亮度要么几乎保持恒定，要么以稳定的速度增加。据研究人员称，仅熔化一项就可以最终去除多达 40% 的原始岩石质量。

paras.en: Why Meteors Shatter as They Approach Earth
paras.zh: 为什么流星接近地球时会破碎

paras.en: As the fireball descends into denser layers of the atmosphere, increasing air pressure begins to fracture the rock. This marks the beginning of Phase 5, when pieces separate from the main body and can produce repeated bursts of light.
paras.zh: 当火球下降到更致密的大气层时，不断增加的气压开始使岩石破裂。这标志着第五阶段的开始，此时碎片与主体分离，并能产生重复的光爆发。

paras.en: One particularly surprising finding was how early this breakup begins. The researchers found that rocks can start fragmenting when the air pressure acting on their leading surfaces reaches only about one-fifth of the strength measured in meteorites recovered on Earth. They suggest that heating during atmospheric entry, along with cracks left by previous collisions in space, may weaken the rocks enough to explain this unexpected behavior.
paras.zh: 一个特别令人惊讶的发现是这种分手开始得有多早。研究人员发现，当作用在岩石前表面的气压仅达到地球上回收的陨石测量强度的五分之一左右时，岩石就会开始破碎。他们认为，进入大气层期间的加热，以及之前太空碰撞留下的裂缝，可能会削弱岩石的强度，足以解释这种意想不到的行为。

paras.en: It is during this stage that the remaining rock begins shrinking rapidly and experiences substantial deceleration. The more extensively it fragments, the faster it loses speed.
paras.zh: 正是在这个阶段，剩余的岩石开始迅速收缩并经历大幅减速。它的碎片越广泛，速度损失得越快。

paras.en: "We were able to tie that slow-down from fragmentation to the previous mathematical descriptions based on ablation," said co-author Stu Pilorz of the SETI Institute.
paras.zh: SETI 研究所的合著者斯图·皮洛兹 (Stu Pilorz) 表示：“我们能够将碎片化造成的减速与之前基于消融的数学描述联系起来。”

paras.en: The researchers also discovered that the shape of the surviving rock can influence where smaller fragments eventually land. If its rear section remains intact, the main body creates an area of reduced pressure in its wake, drawing smaller pieces along behind it.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，幸存岩石的形状会影响较小碎片最终落地的位置。如果它的后部保持完整，主体会在其尾流中产生一个减压区域，将较小的碎片拖到后面。

paras.en: "Our modeling shows that as long as the back of the space rock remains intact, that rock pulls a vacuum in its wake into which fragments tend to flow," says co-author Darrel Robertson of NASA Ames Research Center. "Those small meteorites fall in a narrow strip on the ground."
paras.zh: 美国宇航局艾姆斯研究中心的合著者达雷尔·罗伯逊说：“我们的模型表明，只要太空岩石的背面保持完整，岩石就会在其尾迹中形成真空，碎片往往会流入其中。” “那些小陨石在地面上呈一条窄带落下。”

paras.en: The Final Explosion and Journey to the Ground
paras.zh: 最后的爆炸和地面之旅

paras.en: Phase 6 begins when the rear portion of the main rock finally breaks apart. This last major disruption produces a bright flare and sends fragments scattering at greater relative speeds. Because the meteor has already slowed considerably, these final flashes generally appear red, unlike the bright green colors often observed earlier in its descent.
paras.zh: 当主岩后部最终破裂时，第六阶段开始。最后一次重大破坏会产生明亮的耀斑，并使碎片以更大的相对速度散射。由于流星的速度已经大大减慢，因此最后的闪光通常呈红色，这与在其下降早期经常观察到的亮绿色不同。

paras.en: "That final disruption sends fragments flying at higher relative speeds," said Jenniskens. "In past falls, we noticed that meteorites larger than about 20g tended to be scattered wider and many came from close to the surface of the original space rock, which must have been its backside."
paras.zh: 詹尼斯肯斯说：“最后的破坏使碎片以更高的相对速度飞行。” “在过去的坠落中，我们注意到大于约 20 克的陨石往往散布得更广泛，而且许多陨石来自靠近原始太空岩石的表面，这肯定是它的背面。”

paras.en: The pieces that ultimately survive to reach Earth's surface began as relatively large fragments. Before landing, however, they experienced additional melting and fragmentation while continuing to lose speed.
paras.zh: 最终幸存并到达地球表面的碎片最初是相对较大的碎片。然而，在着陆之前，它们经历了额外的融化和破碎，同时继续失去速度。

paras.en: During Phase 7, these processes continue until the remaining pieces have slowed enough that they no longer produce visible light. Once melting stops, a thin outer coating known as a fusion crust remains on their surfaces. The darkened fragments then complete their descent, with atmospheric winds potentially pushing them away from their original trajectories before they land as meteorites.
paras.zh: 在第七阶段，这些过程持续进行，直到剩余的碎片减慢到不再产生可见光为止。一旦熔化停止，其表面就会残留一层薄薄的外层，称为熔壳。然后，变暗的碎片完成下降，大气风可能会将它们推离原来的轨迹，然后再以陨石的形式着陆。

paras.en: What Meteorite Falls Reveal About Dangerous Asteroids
paras.zh: 陨石坠落揭示了危险小行星的哪些信息

paras.en: The researchers examined 75 documented meteorite falls involving several different types of space rock. By comparing their behavior, they were able to determine the altitudes at which different materials entered each of the seven phases.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查了 75 个有记录的陨石坠落，涉及几种不同类型的太空岩石。通过比较它们的行为，他们能够确定不同材料进入七个阶段中每个阶段的高度。

paras.en: These observations offer more than an explanation of how small meteorites reach the ground. They also provide valuable clues about the behavior of much larger asteroids, including objects ranging from the size of cars to entire city blocks that can produce powerful explosions in the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 这些观测结果不仅仅解释了小陨石如何到达地面。它们还提供了有关更大小行星行为的宝贵线索，这些小行星包括从汽车大小到整个城市街区的物体，这些物体可以在大气中产生强大的爆炸。

paras.en: By measuring how different solid rocks slow down and fragment during atmospheric entry, scientists can better understand the processes that govern these potentially dangerous asteroid airbursts.
paras.zh: 通过测量不同的固体岩石在进入大气层时如何减速和破碎，科学家可以更好地了解控制这些潜在危险的小行星空中爆炸的过程。

paras.en: "Asteroids up to tens of meters in size are also solid rocks because they tend to spin faster than do the larger rubble pile asteroids," said Jenniskens. "The 20-m diameter asteroid that caused the airburst over Chelyabinsk, Russia, in 2013 went through the same phases."
paras.zh: 詹尼斯肯斯说：“数十米大小的小行星也是固体岩石，因为它们的自转速度往往比较大的碎石堆小行星快。” “2013 年在俄罗斯车里雅宾斯克上空引发空爆的直径 20 米的小行星也经历了相同的阶段。”

paras.en: Materials provided by SETI Institute. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 SETI 研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Peter Jenniskens, Stuart Pilorz, Darrel Robertson, Eric C. Stern. Bolide light curve systematics from 75 recovered meteorites. Meteoritics, 2026; 61 (9): 2351 DOI: 10.1111/maps.70203
paras.zh: - 彼得·詹尼斯肯斯、斯图尔特·皮洛兹、达雷尔·罗伯逊、埃里克·C·斯特恩。对 75 块回收的陨石进行的火流星光曲线系统分析。流星学，2026； 61 (9): 2351 DOI: 10.1111/maps.70203

articles.title: Scientists just broke a textbook rule of physics

paras.en: Scientists just broke a textbook rule of physics
paras.zh: 科学家刚刚打破了物理学教科书的规则

paras.en: - Scientists have defied a long-standing rule of laser physics by generating X-rays with much higher energies than conventional theory predicts. The surprising discovery reveals how two electrons working together can overcome a previously accepted limit, opening new possibilities for quantum research.
paras.zh: - 科学家们通过产生比传统理论预测的能量高得多的 X 射线来挑战激光物理学的长期规则。这一令人惊讶的发现揭示了两个电子如何协同工作可以克服先前公认的极限，为量子研究开辟新的可能性。

paras.en: Scientists have pushed X-ray generation beyond a long-accepted limit in laser physics, revealing a surprising quantum effect that conventional theory does not account for. By directing powerful ultraviolet lasers at helium atoms, researchers produced X-rays with substantially higher energies than the standard model predicts. The breakthrough depends on an unusual interaction between two electrons that allows them to release their energy together.
paras.zh: 科学家们将 X 射线的产生推向了激光物理学长期接受的极限，揭示了传统理论无法解释的令人惊讶的量子效应。通过将强大的紫外线激光对准氦原子，研究人员产生的 X 射线能量远高于标准模型预测的能量。这一突破取决于两个电子之间不寻常的相互作用，这种相互作用使它们能够一起释放能量。

paras.en: The discovery comes from a collaboration between TU Wien and the University of California San Diego and builds on research that helped establish the field of attosecond physics. Laser techniques developed at TU Wien in the 1990s contributed to advances recognized by the 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics.
paras.zh: 这一发现来自维也纳工业大学和加州大学圣地亚哥分校之间的合作，并建立在帮助建立阿秒物理学领域的研究基础上。维也纳工业大学 20 世纪 90 年代开发的激光技术所取得的进步做出了贡献，并获得了 2023 年诺贝尔物理学奖。

paras.en: For decades, scientists have understood that directing laser light at certain atoms can cause them to emit extremely short pulses of much higher-frequency light, including X-rays. However, the established theory predicts a maximum energy for these emissions based on the properties of the incoming laser. Beyond this boundary, known as the energy cutoff, X-ray production becomes extremely weak.
paras.zh: 几十年来，科学家们已经了解到，将激光照射到某些原子可以使它们发射极短的高频光脉冲，包括 X 射线。然而，现有理论根据入射激光的特性预测了这些发射的最大能量。超出这个边界（称为能量截止），X 射线产生变得极其微弱。

paras.en: The new experiment demonstrates that this familiar limit can be exceeded when two electrons interact in a particular way. The findings were published in Nature Photonics.
paras.zh: 新实验表明，当两个电子以特定方式相互作用时，可以突破这个熟悉的极限。研究结果发表在《自然光子学》杂志上。

paras.en: How Lasers Generate Powerful X-Ray Pulses
paras.zh: 激光器如何产生强大的 X 射线脉冲

paras.en: "The mechanism behind short X-ray pulses has been well known for a long time," says Prof. Tenio Popmintchev from the Institute of Photonics at TU Wien. "The laser tears a single electron away from the atom. The electron is then accelerated in the laser's electric field until it eventually collides with the atom again. The energy it loses in the process is emitted in the form of light."
paras.zh: “短 X 射线脉冲背后的机制早已众所周知，”维也纳工业大学光子学研究所的 Tenio Popmintchev 教授说。 “激光将单个电子从原子上撕下来。然后电子在激光电场中加速，直到最终再次与原子碰撞。它在这个过程中损失的能量以光的形式发射出来。”

paras.en: During this process, the laser's electric field drives the freed electron away from its parent atom before bringing it back. When the electron returns and releases its energy, it generates light at frequencies far higher than those of the original laser beam.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，激光电场将释放的电子驱离其母原子，然后再将其带回。当电子返回并释放能量时，它会产生频率远高于原始激光束的光。

paras.en: Nobel laureate Ferenc Krausz used this mechanism in pioneering experiments during the 1990s. Tenio Popmintchev and his colleagues now work at the same TU Wien institute where Krausz conducted his earlier research, but their latest experiment has pushed the process beyond its previously understood boundaries.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔奖获得者 Ferenc Krausz 在 20 世纪 90 年代的开创性实验中使用了这种机制。 Tenio Popmintchev 和他的同事现在在克劳斯进行早期研究的维也纳工业大学研究所工作，但他们的最新实验使这一过程超出了之前理解的界限。

paras.en: "It can be shown that when the electron returns to its atom, it generates a whole range of different frequencies with roughly equal intensity," says Dimitar Popmintchev, postdoc in Tenio Popmintchev's team at TU Wien. "But there is an upper limit. Frequencies above this limit are much weaker; it is simply not possible to exceed a certain maximum frequency."
paras.zh: 维也纳工业大学 Tenio Popmintchev 团队的博士后 Dimitar Popmintchev 表示：“可以证明，当电子返回原子时，它会产生一系列强度大致相等的不同频率。” “但是有一个上限。超过这个上限的频率就会弱得多；根本不可能超过某个最大频率。”

paras.en: That prediction describes the conventional process involving a single electron. The researchers wanted to find out whether the outcome would change if two electrons participated instead.
paras.zh: 该预测描述了涉及单个电子的传统过程。研究人员想知道如果有两个电子参与，结果是否会改变。

paras.en: Two Electrons Break the Expected X-Ray Energy Limit
paras.zh: 两个电子突破预期的 X 射线能量极限

paras.en: To investigate, the team used intense ultraviolet (UV) laser pulses to interact with helium atoms. Unlike the usual process involving one electron, the experiment allowed both of helium's electrons to be removed in succession.
paras.zh: 为了进行研究，该团队使用强紫外线 (UV) 激光脉冲与氦原子相互作用。与涉及一个电子的通常过程不同，该实验允许氦的两个电子连续被移除。

paras.en: The first electron was released and accelerated by the laser field, followed by the second. Although the electrons were freed at different moments, their behavior remained connected through quantum correlations. This relationship means their motions cannot be treated as entirely independent.
paras.zh: 第一个电子被激光场释放并加速，随后是第二个电子。尽管电子在不同时刻被释放，但它们的行为仍然通过量子关联保持联系。这种关系意味着他们的动议不能被视为完全独立。

paras.en: By carefully controlling the ultraviolet laser pulses, the researchers could arrange for both electrons to return to the atom simultaneously.
paras.zh: 通过仔细控制紫外激光脉冲，研究人员可以安排两个电子同时返回原子。

paras.en: "Using UV driving pulses, we can arrange for both electrons to return to the atom at exactly the same time," says Dimitar Popmintchev. "The energy of two electrons is then released all at once. And when more energy is available, a single higher-energy X-ray photon with higher frequency can also be generated."
paras.zh: “使用紫外线驱动脉冲，我们可以安排两个电子完全相同地返回原子，”Dimitar Popmintchev 说。 “然后两个电子的能量立即释放。当有更多能量可用时，也可以产生频率更高的单一高能X射线光子。”

paras.en: This coordinated release of energy makes it possible to produce X-ray photons that exceed the conventional energy cutoff. Rather than relying on the energy of a single returning electron, the process draws on the combined energy of two interacting electrons.
paras.zh: 这种协调的能量释放使得产生超过传统能量截止的 X 射线光子成为可能。该过程不依赖单个返回电子的能量，而是利用两个相互作用电子的组合能量。

paras.en: An Unexpected X-Ray Signal Confirms the Discovery
paras.zh: 意外的 X 射线信号证实了这一发现

paras.en: The researchers found clear experimental evidence that the two-electron process was producing unusually energetic X-rays.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了明确的实验证据，表明双电子过程产生了异常高能的 X 射线。

paras.en: When they examined the spectrum of the emitted coherent radiation, they identified a second region of sustained emission at much higher photon energies than the standard theory predicts. This additional region, known as a plateau, was weaker than the primary emission but extended well beyond the previously established energy range.
paras.zh: 当他们检查发射的相干辐射的光谱时，他们发现了第二个持续发射区域，其光子能量比标准理论预测的要高得多。这个额外的区域被称为平台，比主要发射弱，但远远超出了先前建立的能量范围。

paras.en: The unexpected signal appeared only when the researchers used helium. Similar experiments involving argon and neon did not produce the same behavior in their outer electrons.
paras.zh: 只有当研究人员使用氦气时，意想不到的信号才出现。涉及氩和氖的类似实验并未在其外层电子中产生相同的行为。

paras.en: This difference provides important evidence for the proposed explanation. Helium has particularly strong correlations between its two electrons, allowing them to interact in ways that make the simultaneous release of energy possible. The outer electrons of argon and neon did not demonstrate the same effect under the experimental conditions.
paras.zh: 这种差异为所提出的解释提供了重要证据。氦的两个电子之间具有特别强的相关性，使它们能够以能够同时释放能量的方式相互作用。氩和氖的外层电子在实验条件下没有表现出相同的效果。

paras.en: Beyond producing higher-energy X-rays, the discovery could give scientists a powerful new way to investigate how electrons interact inside atoms and other materials.
paras.zh: 除了产生更高能量的 X 射线之外，这一发现还可以为科学家提供一种强大的新方法来研究电子在原子和其他材料内部如何相互作用。

paras.en: The unusual coherent X-ray emission could serve as a highly sensitive spectroscopic "sensor" for electron-electron correlations. By studying the shape of the emitted spectrum, its maximum energy, and how it changes with the polarization of the laser light, researchers could gain information about the behavior of interacting electrons on extraordinarily short timescales.
paras.zh: 这种不寻常的相干X射线发射可以作为电子-电子相关性的高灵敏度光谱“传感器”。通过研究发射光谱的形状、其最大能量以及它如何随激光偏振而变化，研究人员可以获得有关电子在极短时间尺度上相互作用的行为的信息。

paras.en: These interactions occur over attoseconds, with one attosecond equal to one billionth of a billionth of a second. Observing processes at such speeds is essential for understanding how electrons move and influence one another in quantum systems.
paras.zh: 这些相互作用发生在阿秒内，一阿秒等于十亿分之一秒。以这样的速度观察过程对于理解电子在量子系统中如何移动和相互影响至关重要。

paras.en: Eventually, the same principle might be extended beyond individual helium atoms to molecules and solid materials in which electrons interact strongly.
paras.zh: 最终，同样的原理可能会扩展到单个氦原子之外的电子相互作用强烈的分子和固体材料。

paras.en: The technique behind the discovery, known as high-harmonic generation, originally helped make attosecond physics possible. Now, researchers are finding that it can also reveal the complex behavior of multiple interacting quantum particles.
paras.zh: 这一发现背后的技术被称为高次谐波产生，最初帮助阿秒物理学成为可能。现在，研究人员发现它还可以揭示多个相互作用的量子粒子的复杂行为。

paras.en: These insights could contribute to research on quantum computing and help scientists understand and design advanced nanomaterials with carefully controlled properties.
paras.zh: 这些见解可以有助于量子计算的研究，并帮助科学家理解和设计具有精心控制特性的先进纳米材料。

paras.en: Materials provided by Vienna University of Technology. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由维也纳科技大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Siyang Wang, Jieyu Yan, Alba de las Heras, Sirius Song, Aleksander Prodanov, Zhihan Wu, Luis Plaja, Dimitar Popmintchev, Tenio Popmintchev. Correlated electrons extend X-ray high-harmonic generation beyond the single-electron limit. Nature Photonics, 2026; 20 (9): 1092 DOI: 10.1038/s41566-026-01976-2
paras.zh: - Siyang Wang、Jieyu Yan、Alba de las Heras、Sirius Song、Aleksander Prodanov、Zhihan Wu、Luis Plaja、Dimitar Popmintchev、Tenio Popmintchev。相关电子将 X 射线高次谐波产生扩展到单电子极限之外。自然光子学，2026； 20 (9): 1092 DOI: 10.1038/s41566-026-01976-2

articles.title: Your blood pressure could be dangerous even when your numbers look normal

paras.en: Your blood pressure could be dangerous even when your numbers look normal
paras.zh: 即使您的数字看起来正常，您的血压也可能很危险

paras.en: - Researchers have discovered a small group of brain cells that prevents dangerous blood pressure swings, even when average readings appear normal. The finding reveals a hidden source of cardiovascular risk and could open the door to new treatments that protect the heart and brain.
paras.zh: - 研究人员发现一小群脑细胞可以防止危险的血压波动，即使平均读数看起来正常。这一发现揭示了心血管风险的隐藏来源，并可能为保护心脏和大脑的新疗法打开大门。

paras.en: Blood pressure readings are typically evaluated based on their average values, but growing evidence suggests that fluctuations throughout the day may be equally important. Rapid or excessive changes in blood pressure can independently increase the risk of heart disease, stroke, and brain injury, even when average readings fall within the normal range.
paras.zh: 血压读数通常根据平均值进行评估，但越来越多的证据表明，全天的波动可能同样重要。即使平均读数在正常范围内，血压的快速或过度变化也会独立增加心脏病、中风和脑损伤的风险。
