paras.en: Researchers at the University of Virginia School of Medicine have identified a small population of nerve cells in the brainstem that helps maintain steady blood pressure. The brainstem regulates essential involuntary functions, and these newly studied cells appear to limit blood pressure swings as people move between everyday activities, including sleeping, waking, standing, and exercising.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚大学医学院的研究人员发现，脑干中有一小群神经细胞有助于维持稳定的血压。脑干调节基本的非自愿功能，这些新研究的细胞似乎可以限制人们在日常活动（包括睡眠、醒来、站立和锻炼）之间的血压波动。

paras.en: "What we found is that a loss of just a few hundred nerve cells leads to unstable blood pressure even though the mean blood pressure was normal," said UVA's Stephen Abbott, PhD, the lead investigator of the study. "This shows that the system that keeps blood pressure steady from moment to moment is no longer working."
paras.zh: 该研究的首席研究员、UVA 的 Stephen Abbott 博士说：“我们发现，即使平均血压正常，仅损失几百个神经细胞也会导致血压不稳定。” “这表明保持血压时时刻刻保持稳定的系统不再起作用。”

paras.en: A Hidden Brain Mechanism Behind Blood Pressure Problems
paras.zh: 血压问题背后隐藏的大脑机制

paras.en: The same nerve cells have previously been found to be damaged or missing in people with multiple system atrophy, a rare, fatal neurological disorder related to Parkinson's disease. The condition is often accompanied by severe difficulties regulating blood pressure.
paras.zh: 此前已发现多系统萎缩症患者的相同神经细胞受损或缺失，多系统萎缩症是一种与帕金森病相关的罕见致命神经系统疾病。这种情况通常伴有严重的血压调节困难。

paras.en: The new findings raise the possibility that disruptions involving these brain cells may also contribute to unstable blood pressure in other medical conditions, including cases where standard measurements show normal average levels. Understanding this mechanism could eventually help researchers develop treatments aimed at reducing harmful fluctuations and protecting against their potential consequences.
paras.zh: 新发现提出了一种可能性，即涉及这些脑细胞的破坏也可能导致其他医疗状况下血压不稳定，包括标准测量显示正常平均水平的情况。了解这种机制最终可以帮助研究人员开发旨在减少有害波动并防止其潜在后果的治疗方法。

paras.en: "Our work emphasizes a new appreciation for how we think about blood pressure problems," Abbott said. "It's not just about lowering the numbers - it's about keeping blood pressure stable from moment to moment."
paras.zh: “我们的工作强调对我们如何看待血压问题有新的认识，”阿博特说。 “这不仅仅是降低数字，而是时刻保持血压稳定。”

paras.en: New Research Could Change How Blood Pressure Is Treated
paras.zh: 新研究可能会改变血压的治疗方式

paras.en: The findings were published in the scientific journal Circulation Research. The research team included George M.P.R. Souza, Harsha Thakkalapally, Faye E. Berry, Leah F. Wisniewski, Ulrich M. Atongazi, Daniel S. Stornetta, and Abbott. The researchers reported no financial interests related to the study.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在科学杂志《循环研究》上。研究小组成员包括 George M.P.R. Souza、Harsha Thakkalapally、Faye E. Berry、Leah F. Wisniewski、Ulrich M. Atongazi、Daniel S. Stornetta 和 Abbott。研究人员报告没有与该研究相关的经济利益。

paras.en: Funding was provided by the National Institutes of Health through grant HL148004.
paras.zh: 美国国立卫生研究院通过 HL148004 拨款提供资金。

paras.en: The discovery also reflects the broader goals of UVA's newly established Paul and Diane Manning Institute of Biotechnology. The institute focuses on advancing research into difficult and complex diseases while helping promising laboratory findings move more quickly toward potentially lifesaving treatments for patients.
paras.zh: 这一发现也反映了 UVA 新成立的保罗和黛安·曼宁生物技术研究所的更广泛目标。该研究所致力于推进疑难和复杂疾病的研究，同时帮助有希望的实验室研究结果更快地转向可能挽救患者生命的治疗方法。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Virginia Health System. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由弗吉尼亚大学卫生系统提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - George M.P.R. Souza, Harsha Thakkalapally, Faye E. Berry, Leah F. Wisniewski, Ulrich M. Atongazi, Daniel S. Stornetta, Stephen B.G. Abbott. Control of Blood Pressure Variability Across Behavioral States by Brainstem Adrenergic Neurons. Circulation Research, 2026; 138 (4) DOI: 10.1161/CIRCRESAHA.125.326792
paras.zh: - 乔治·M.P.R. Souza、Harsha Thakkalapally、Faye E. Berry、Leah F. Wisniewski、Ulrich M. Atongazi、Daniel S. Stornetta、Stephen B.G.雅培。脑干肾上腺素能神经元控制不同行为状态下的血压变异性。流通研究，2026； 138 (4) DOI：10.1161/CIRCRESAHA.125.326792

articles.title: ISS astronaut will conduct Canada's 1st spacewalk in 7 years on Oct. 29: Watch it live
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: The next International Space Station (ISS) spacewalk will have more maple-leaf flavor than usual, as a Canadian astronaut will become the first to go outside the orbiting complex in seven years.
paras.zh: 下一次国际空间站（ISS）太空行走将比平常更具枫叶风味，因为加拿大宇航员将成为七年来第一个走出轨道综合体的宇航员。

paras.en: Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Joshua Kutryk, who's also a colonel in the Royal Canadian Air Force, will help the ISS boost its power supply during his first-ever spacewalk on Thursday (Oct. 29). Kutryk will be joined by NASA astronaut Anil Menon, who has done three spacewalks already and also serves as a colonel with the U.S. Space Force.
paras.zh: 加拿大航天局 (CSA) 宇航员、加拿大皇家空军上校约书亚·库特里克 (Joshua Kutryk) 将在周四（10 月 29 日）的首次太空行走中帮助国际空间站增强电力供应。库特里克将与美国宇航局宇航员阿尼尔·梅农 (Anil Menon) 一起，后者已经完成了 3 次太空行走，并且还担任美国太空部队的上校。

paras.en: The duo are scheduled to venture outside the orbiting lab at 8 a.m. EDT (1200 GMT), kicking off a spacewalk that will last roughly 6 hours and 45 minutes. You can watch it live here at Space.com, courtesy of NASA, beginning at 6:30 a.m. EDT (1030 GMT).
paras.zh: 两人计划于美国东部时间上午 8 点（格林威治标准时间 1200）走出轨道实验室，开始为期约 6 小时 45 分钟的太空行走。您可以在 Space.com 上观看直播，由 NASA 提供，时间为美国东部时间上午 6:30（格林尼治标准时间 1030）。

paras.en: It will be the first of two extravehicular activities (EVAs) for Menon and Kutryk, with the second expected to occur no sooner than Nov. 5. During the two spacewalks, the astronauts will deploy the seventh and eighth International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays (iROSAs).
paras.zh: 这将是梅农和库特里克两次舱外活动 (EVA) 中的第一次，第二次预计将在 11 月 5 日之前进行。在两次太空行走期间，宇航员将部署第七和第八个国际空间站滚出式太阳能电池阵列 (iROSA)。

paras.en: iROSAs lie on top of the existing, decades-old arrays on ISS, which are naturally degrading with age. The first iROSA rolled out in 2021. Once all eight are installed and running, the station will see its power supply rise from 160 kilowatts to about 215 kilowatts — a boost of roughly 30%.
paras.zh: iROSA 位于国际空间站已有数十年历史的现有阵列之上，这些阵列会随着时间的推移而自然退化。第一个 iROSA 于 2021 年推出。一旦所有 8 个都安装并运行，该站的电力供应将从 160 千瓦增加到约 215 千瓦，增幅约为 30%。

paras.en: The capcom (capsule communicator) for both spacewalks will be CSA astronaut Jenni Gibbons. She has experience in this role already, serving as a capcom on NASA's Artemis II mission around the moon this past April. And she'll serve as lead capcom for Artemis III, which will test crewed lunar landers in Earth orbit next summer, if all goes to plan.
paras.zh: 两次太空行走的 capcom（太空舱通讯器）将由 CSA 宇航员 Jenni Gibbons 担任。她已经具备了担任这一角色的经验，去年四月，她曾在 NASA 的阿耳忒弥斯二号绕月任务中担任卡普空。她还将担任阿耳忒弥斯三号的首席卡普空，如果一切按计划进行的话，阿耳忒弥斯三号将于明年夏天在地球轨道上测试载人月球着陆器。

paras.en: Also helping Kutryk and Menon will be Canadian space technology, specifically Canadarm2 — the ISS robotic arm tasked for spacewalk support, among other maintenance duties.
paras.zh: 加拿大太空技术也能帮助 Kutryk 和 Menon，特别是 Canadaarm2——国际空间站机械臂，负责太空行走支持以及其他维护任务。

paras.en: "It's been busy preparing for the upcoming spacewalks," Menon said about Canadarm2 in a Saturday (Oct. 24) X post. Ground controllers recently moved the arm over to the "trunk" or storage area of a SpaceX Dragon cargo spacecraft, which brought the two iROSA arrays up earlier this month.Canadarm2 picked up the IROSAs and moved them to a transporter for the astronauts. "It even loosened bolts for us before the spacewalks … I'm grateful for the help," Menon added.
paras.zh: “它一直忙着为即将到来的太空行走做准备，”梅农在周六（10 月 24 日）的 X 帖子中谈到 Canadaarm2 时说道。地面控制人员最近将手臂移至 SpaceX Dragon 货运飞船的“行李箱”或存储区域，本月早些时候，这艘飞船将两个 iROSA 阵列带上来。Canadarm2 拾起 IROSA 并将它们转移到宇航员的运输车上。 “它甚至在太空行走之前为我们松开了螺栓……我很感激你的帮助，”梅农补充道。

paras.en: During the Oct. 29 spacewalk, Canadarm2 will do even more. Kutryk and Menon will slide an array off its transport rail and then have Menon get onto a Canadarm2 platform, to put the array into his hands. From inside the ISS, NASA astronauts Luke Delaney and Jessica Watkins will carefully move Canadarm2 to put Menon and the array at the ISS port-installation site, supporting the 2A electrical-power channel.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 29 日的太空行走中，Canadarm2 将会做更多的事情。 Kutryk 和 Menon 会将阵列从运输轨道上滑下，然后让 Menon 登上 Canadaarm2 平台，将阵列交到他手中。在国际空间站内部，NASA 宇航员卢克·德莱尼 (Luke Delaney) 和杰西卡·沃特金斯 (Jessica Watkins) 将小心地移动 Canadaarm2，将 Menon 和阵列放置在国际空间站端口安装地点，支持 2A 电力通道。

paras.en: Each array is about 10 feet (3 meters) long when folded up and weighs 750 pounds (340 kilograms) here on Earth, according to Garrett Hehn, NASA's spacewalk flight director. The agency therefore knows the iROSAs are "a lot to handle," he said during a press conference on Oct. 20 that previewed the two upcoming spacewalks.
paras.zh: 据 NASA 太空行走飞行总监加勒特·赫恩 (Garrett Hehn) 介绍，每个阵列折叠起来后长约 10 英尺（3 米），在地球上重 750 磅（340 公斤）。因此，该机构知道 iROSA 任务“有很多事情需要处理”，他在 10 月 20 日的新闻发布会上表示，该新闻发布会预览了即将进行的两次太空行走。

paras.en: As such, NASA looked at how previous iROSA spacewalks were performed and created a new "elegant series of maneuvers, where we've tried to rotate around the actual center of mass of the arrays, rather than the crew member," Hehn added. "It was a lesson learned from previous EVAs, of how we thought we could make it a little less tiring on Anil."
paras.zh: 因此，NASA 研究了之前 iROSA 太空行走的执行方式，并创建了一系列新的“优雅的机动动作，我们试图围绕阵列的实际质心而不是机组人员旋转，”Hehn 补充道。 “这是从之前的 EVA 中吸取的教训，我们认为我们可以让阿尼尔不那么累。”

paras.en: Kutryk will move over to the installation location, hand-over-hand, to join Menon. There, the two will place the IROSA onto the older solar array, using a "mod kit" placed on a previous spacewalk. "We've got a series of bolts to structurally attach it [the IROSA] and release, in order for this folded-up configuration to fold open, and basically go from about 10 feet long to around 20 feet [6 m] long," Hehn explained.
paras.zh: 库特里克将移至安装地点，与梅农会合。在那里，两人将使用之前太空行走中放置的“改装套件”将 IROSA 放置在旧的太阳能电池阵列上。 “我们有一系列螺栓在结构上连接它 [IROSA] 并释放，以便这种折叠式配置能够折叠打开，并且基本上从约 10 英尺长到约 20 英尺 [6 m] 长，”Hehn 解释道。

paras.en: "These arrays," he added, "I kind of think of them like a snap bracelet … They basically have a series of magnets up the side, where they deploy with enough energy that it just continues rolling out steadily. That process will take about 10 minutes on the day of the EVA."
paras.zh: “这些阵列，”他补充道，“我觉得它们就像一个按扣手镯……它们的侧面基本上有一系列磁铁，它们在其中部署了足够的能量，使其能够继续稳定地滚动。在 EVA 当天，这个过程大约需要 10 分钟。”

paras.en: Following that, the astronauts need to access power cables at a time when that area of the ISS is not in sunlight; the station will be (as always) moving through its orbit, circling the Earth every 90 minutes, so timing will be important.
paras.zh: 之后，宇航员需要在国际空间站的该区域没有阳光照射的时候接入电源线；该站将（一如既往）沿其轨道运行，每 90 分钟绕地球一圈，因此时机非常重要。

paras.en: "We can't have any sun on the arrays, whenever we're handling those hot cables," Hehn said. "Basically, we'll use a jumper to bring together both the legacy arrays' power, and this new rollout solar arrays' power, in order to have a pretty substantial gain to our power-generation capability."
paras.zh: “每当我们处理这些热电缆时，阵列上都不能有任何阳光，”Hehn 说。 “基本上，我们将使用跳线将传统阵列的电力和新推出的太阳能电池阵列的电力结合在一起，以便大幅提高我们的发电能力。”

paras.en: The Nov. 5 EVA will essentially have the astronauts do the same installation procedure with another array, this time heading to the starboard side of the space station. The last IROSA installation, however, will take place a little farther from the station, beyond Canadarm2's reach. So the astronauts will do a "leapfrog" to get out there.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日的 EVA 基本上会让宇航员对另一个阵列执行相同的安装程序，这次是前往空间站的右舷。然而，最后一次 IROSA 安装将在距离空间站稍远的地方进行，超出了 Canadarm2 的范围。所以宇航员会通过“蛙跳”的方式离开那里。

paras.en: After Menon, the array and Canadarm2 are brought to the installation location, Hehn said, Kutryk — moving to the same location by himself, hand over hand — will go into another platform installed on the station truss, and take the IROSA from Menon's hands. As Kutryk waits in place, Menon will exit the robotics platform, move it from the Canadarm2 to another spot on the space station's truss, and then get back on to the platform to hold the IROSA securely for installation for the 3B electrical-power channel.
paras.zh: Hehn 说，在梅农之后，阵列和 Canadaarm2 被带到安装位置，库特里克自己移到同一位置，交接手 - 将进入安装在车站桁架上的另一个平台，并从梅农手中接过 IROSA。当 Kutryk 在原地等待时，Menon 将离开机器人平台，将其从 Canadaarm2 移至空间站桁架上的另一个位置，然后返回平台，牢固地固定 IROSA，以便安装 3B 电力通道。

paras.en: "This is the way that we close that final distance that the robotic arm is unable to do on its own," Hehn said.
paras.zh: 赫恩说：“这是我们缩小机械臂无法独自完成的最后距离的方法。”

paras.en: Canadian robots, support teams — and new funding
paras.zh: 加拿大机器人、支持团队——以及新资金

paras.en: The CSA's last spacewalk was during the agency's previous mission seven years ago, which involved astronaut David Saint-Jacques. On April 8, 2019, Saint-Jacques successfully fought difficult equipment during a busy excursion alongside NASA astronaut Anne McClain.
paras.zh: CSA 的最后一次太空行走是在七年前该机构的上一次任务期间，宇航员大卫·圣雅克 (David Saint-Jacques) 参与其中。 2019 年 4 月 8 日，圣雅克在与 NASA 宇航员安妮·麦克莱恩 (Anne McClain) 一起繁忙的旅行中成功地对抗了困难的设备。

paras.en: CSA has a 2.3% contribution to ISS, usually working out to a flight every five or six years. However, Kutryk's slot was delayed two years, from 2024 to 2026, because he was originally assigned to fly up on Boeing's Starliner capsule, which needs more flight testing following numerous issues that cropped up during its crewed demonstration flight in 2024.
paras.zh: CSA 对国际空间站的贡献为 2.3%，通常每五六年进行一次飞行。然而，库特里克的飞行时间从 2024 年推迟了两年，从 2024 年推迟到 2026 年，因为他最初被分配乘坐波音公司的 Starliner 太空舱飞行，该太空舱在 2024 年载人演示飞行期间出现了许多问题，需要进行更多的飞行测试。

paras.en: Kutryk, who launched Oct. 1 aboard a SpaceX Crew Dragon with three other astronauts, has generated a lot of political and industry excitement in Canada. His mission marks a rare pair of CSA astronaut launches in a single year, as Artemis II astronaut Jeremy Hansen just launched in April. (The last time this happened was in 2009, when Robert Thirsk was doing a long-duration station excursion and Julie Payette visited during a two-week space shuttle mission.)
paras.zh: 库特里克于 10 月 1 日与其他三名宇航员搭乘 SpaceX 载人龙飞船升空，在加拿大引起了政界和业界的热烈关注。他的任务标志着 CSA 宇航员在一年内进行了罕见的两次发射，就像阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员杰里米·汉森 (Jeremy Hansen) 在四月份刚刚发射一样。 （上一次发生这种情况是在 2009 年，当时罗伯特·瑟斯克（Robert Thirsk）正在进行一次长时间的空间站游览，朱莉·帕耶特（Julie Payette）在为期两周的航天飞机任务中访问过。）

paras.en: Canadian astronaut missions are unusual, even when including private missions — or non-CSA government astronauts, like now-retired NASA astronaut Andrew Feustel, who has dual U.S.-Canadian citizenship. Canada is therefore using the new CSA mission as a catalyst. In recent weeks, Canada announced several government and industry commitments to keep the momentum going even after Kutryk returns next spring.
paras.zh: 加拿大宇航员的任务很不寻常，即使包括私人任务或非 CSA 政府宇航员，例如现已退休的美国宇航局宇航员安德鲁·费斯特尔 (Andrew Feustel)，他拥有美国和加拿大双重国籍。因此，加拿大利用新的 CSA 使命作为催化剂。最近几周，加拿大宣布了几项政府和行业承诺，即使在库特里克明年春天回归后也将保持这一势头。

paras.en: For example, Canada just announced its first bipartisan space caucus, named Hansen a space advisor to the prime minister, pledged to soon give CSA its first space strategy since 2019, and promised, if at all possible, to announce a mission assignment for Gibbons within the next year. (The latter may depend on factors such as NASA's availability for missions, as Canada does not launch astronauts on its own.)
paras.zh: 例如，加拿大刚刚宣布成立首个两党太空核心小组，任命汉森为总理太空顾问，承诺很快为 CSA 提供自 2019 年以来的第一份太空战略，并承诺如果可能的话，在明年内宣布吉本斯的任务分配。 （后者可能取决于美国宇航局是否可以执行任务等因素，因为加拿大不会自行发射宇航员。）

paras.en: On the industry side, Canada's defense department last week promised the launch company NordSpace $20 million CDN ($14 million USD) for a 10-year launch pad access agreement at the company's young spaceport in the province Newfoundland and Labrador; additional mission costs will be paid when those are ordered. Canada also recently promised $200 million CDN ($140 million USD) to Maritime Launch Services over 10 years, committing to a launch pad at the company's emerging spaceport in Nova Scotia.
paras.zh: 在工业方面，加拿大国防部上周向发射公司 NordSpace 承诺提供 2000 万加元（1400 万美元），用于在该公司位于纽芬兰和拉布拉多省的年轻航天发射场签订为期 10 年的发射台使用协议；额外的任务费用将在订购后支付。加拿大最近还承诺在 10 年内向海上发射服务公司提供 2 亿加元（1.4 亿美元），并承诺在该公司位于新斯科舍省的新兴航天港建造发射台。

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell (she/her), Ph.D., was a staff writer in the spaceflight channel between 2022 and 2024 specializing in Canadian space news. She was contributing writer for Space.com for 10 years from 2012 to 2024. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, leading world coverage about a lost-and-found space tomato on the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪威尔（Elizabeth Howell）（她/她）博士于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任太空飞行频道的特约撰稿人，专门报道加拿大太空新闻。从 2012 年到 2024 年，她在 Space.com 担任特约撰稿人长达 10 年。伊丽莎白的报道内容包括多份白宫独家报道、主导国际空间站失物招领太空番茄的全球报道、见证五次载人航天在两大洲的发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。

articles.title: 5 days beneath the waves: What it's like to live in an underwater 'space station'
articles.author: Michaela Musilova

paras.en: Living underwater was surprisingly peaceful. It was in many ways exactly what I imagine living on Mars would be like one day. There were no humans around us, except for my three SEA STAR crewmembers and me. Apart from the human noises we made, we couldn't hear anything other than the life support systems keeping us alive submerged 22 feet (7 meters) below the surface.
paras.zh: 水下的生活出奇的平静。从很多方面来说，这都和我想象的有一天在火星上生活的样子一模一样。除了我和我的三名 SEA STAR 船员外，我们周围没有人类。除了我们发出的人类噪音之外，我们听不到任何声音，除了在水下 22 英尺（7 米）处维持我们生命的生命维持系统。

paras.en: We were living in these extreme conditions to study the challenges astronauts may face on long-duration space missions. Since performing research in space is still rare and expensive, there are numerous facilities around the world that focus on recreating space-like conditions on Earth. One of those stations is the Jules' Undersea Lab, where the SEA STAR simulated space mission took place.
paras.zh: 我们生活在这些极端条件下，研究宇航员在长期太空任务中可能面临的挑战。由于在太空中进行研究仍然罕见且昂贵，因此世界各地有许多设施专注于在地球上重现类似太空的条件。其中一个站是 Jules 的海底实验室，SEA STAR 模拟太空任务就是在这里进行的。

paras.en: This underwater habitat was called "La Chalupa" when it was built in the 1970s. Its purpose was to allow divers to live and perform research as aquanauts — people who spend more than 24 hours underwater in a so-called state of saturation. Today, the Jules' Undersea Lab is located near Key Largo, in Florida. However, it was originally designed to be mobile — inside a barge 20 feet wide and 60 feet long (6 to 18 meters).
paras.zh: 这个水下栖息地于 20 世纪 70 年代建成时被称为“La Chalupa”。其目的是让潜水员能够以潜水员的身份生活和进行研究，即在水下处于所谓的饱和状态下度过超过 24 小时的人。如今，朱尔斯的海底实验室位于佛罗里达州拉哥岛附近。然而，它最初设计为可移动的——在 20 英尺宽、60 英尺长（6 至 18 米）的驳船上。

paras.en: The aquanauts could choose an ideal site for their research expeditions underwater and then have the facility be submerged. They did that by flooding most of its inside space, turning it from a boat to a submarine. Once their work was done, they could remove the water and move "La Chalupa" to another location.
paras.zh: 潜水员可以为他们的水下研究探险选择一个理想的地点，然后将设施淹没。他们通过淹没其大部分内部空间，将其从一艘船变成了一艘潜艇来做到这一点。一旦工作完成，他们就可以清除水并将“La Chalupa”移动到另一个位置。

paras.en: Unfortunately, the funding to keep this facility running ran out over time, and it was moved one last time to its current home. Since then, the now Jules' Undersea Lab served as the research station for tens of different aquanaut missions, including a NASA 30-day project and two missions that set world records for the longest time living underwater (73 and 100 days).
paras.zh: 不幸的是，随着时间的推移，维持该设施运行的资金耗尽了，它最后一次搬到了现在的家。从那时起，现在的朱尔斯海底实验室成为了数十个不同的潜水任务的研究站，其中包括 NASA 为期 30 天的项目和两次创下水下生存时间最长世界纪录（73 天和 100 天）的任务。

paras.en: On the inside, the underwater station is made up of a galley with a kitchen and dining/work area. Next to it there is a basic toilet, shower and the "moon pool," which is the equivalent of a door to get inside the habitat. The final area is the bedroom with two bunk beds, which can be split in the middle to create two bedrooms and provide additional privacy. Three windows throughout the habitat provide its dwellers with a view of a mostly green outside world.
paras.zh: 在内部，水下站由带厨房和餐厅/工作区的厨房组成。旁边有一个基本的厕所、淋浴和“月亮池”，相当于进入栖息地的门。最后一个区域是配有两张双层床的卧室，可以从中间分割成两间卧室并提供额外的隐私。整个栖息地的三扇窗户为居住者提供了大部分绿色的外部世界的视野。

paras.en: To start our SEA STAR simulated space mission, we waved goodbye to our Mission Control team on "Earth" and dove down to enter the Jules' Undersea Lab through the "moon pool" at 25 feet (7.6 m) underwater. After that, we did not return to the surface again until five days later. We lived and worked the whole time underwater, performing our space-related research and "spacewalks" (a.k.a. exploration dives in scuba gear).
paras.zh: 为了开始我们的 SEA STAR 模拟太空任务，我们向“地球”上的任务控制团队挥手告别，通过水下 25 英尺（7.6 m）处的“月池”潜入朱尔斯的海底实验室。此后，直到五天后我们才再次返回地面。我们一直在水下生活和工作，进行与太空相关的研究和“太空行走”（又名穿着水肺潜水装备的探索潜水）。

paras.en: We were able to survive all this time in such a challenging environment thanks to a number of important life support systems keeping us alive. The communications and umbilical support cables (providing air, fresh water and power) for the habitat were originally supplied by NASA. All the piping and fittings are inside the submerged barge, protected from the air-sea interface and from encrusting marine creatures. There was also a direct line to Mission Control "on Earth" to help us in case of any emergencies.
paras.zh: 我们之所以能够在如此充满挑战的环境中生存下来，得益于许多重要的生命支持系统的支持。栖息地的通讯和脐带支持电缆（提供空气、淡水和电力）最初由 NASA 提供。所有管道和配件都位于水下驳船内，免受空气-海洋界面和海洋生物结壳的影响。还有一条直达“地球上”任务控制中心的线路，可以在发生任何紧急情况时为我们提供帮助。

paras.en: Our schedule kept us busy all day every day to simulate what astronauts experience on the International Space Station (ISS). All four of us on the SEA STAR crew had research projects that we were responsible for, as well as daily tasks. These tasks involved cooking, medical checkups, cognitive tests, maintenance work and taking care of unexpected issues. As the Commander of the crew, I also made sure everyone was on top of their work and addressed any problems that came up.
paras.zh: 我们的日程安排让我们每天都忙于模拟宇航员在国际空间站 (ISS) 上的经历。 SEA STAR 船员的所有四人都有我们负责的研究项目以及日常任务。这些任务包括烹饪、体检、认知测试、维护工作和处理意外问题。作为机组的指挥官，我还确保每个人都做好工作并解决出现的任何问题。

paras.en: We performed "spacewalks" in between all those other activities. They were pretty physically exhausting, which meant that we did not do additional exercise during the mission. I have been the Commander of 40 simulated space missions, and normally we exercise for at least an hour or two during each mission, just like astronauts on the ISS. Nonetheless, the pressure in the Jules' Undersea Lab was approximately twice as high as it was on the surface at sea level. This caused the crew to experience additional stress to their bodies, which is why no further exercise was required.
paras.zh: 我们在所有这些其他活动之间进行了“太空行走”。他们的体力消耗很大，这意味着我们在任务期间没有进行额外的锻炼。我担任过40次模拟太空任务的指挥官，通常每次任务我们都会锻炼一两个小时，就像国际空间站上的宇航员一样。尽管如此，朱尔斯海底实验室的压力大约是海平面表面压力的两倍。这导致船员的身体承受额外的压力，因此不需要进一步锻炼。

paras.en: Even though our hands were full with activities during the mission, none of us felt particularly stressed out. Whether it was because of the effects of the pressurized conditions or thanks to good planning, we actually enjoyed our time living underwater. One of the nice surprises of the mission was that the food wasn't too bad, either. We were allowed to use a small crock pot, which meant we could eat soups, stews and overnight oats. Small joys like that boosted our spirits immensely.
paras.zh: 尽管任务期间我们忙得不可开交，但我们都没有感到特别紧张。无论是由于加压条件的影响还是由于良好的计划，我们实际上很享受在水下生活的时光。这次任务的一个惊喜是食物也不错。我们被允许使用一个小锅，这意味着我们可以吃汤、炖菜和隔夜燕麦。像这样的小快乐极大地鼓舞了我们的精神。

paras.en: Having said all that, the Jules' Undersea Lab did also make the isolation from our lives on Earth feel very realistic. While we didn't have a view of Earth like the astronauts on the ISS, our very green view of a completely different world outside our windows gave us an impression of living on another planet. It was the alien nature of our lifestyle 22 feet underwater and all the challenges that came with it that made this mission feel Mars-like. Our daily schedule grounded us, the extreme environment around us kept us on our toes and our scientific exploration helped us reach new frontiers.
paras.zh: 话虽如此，朱尔斯的海底实验室也确实让我们与地球生活的隔离变得非常现实。虽然我们没有像国际空间站上的宇航员那样看到地球，但窗外完全不同的世界的绿色视野给我们一种生活在另一个星球上的印象。正是我们在水下 22 英尺的生活方式的陌生性以及随之而来的所有挑战让这次任务感觉就像火星一样。我们的日程安排让我们脚踏实地，周围的极端环境让我们保持警惕，科学探索帮助我们到达新的领域。

paras.en: You can follow Dr. Michaela Musilova at her website and on social media: @astro_michaela (Instagram, TikTok and Threads), @Dr. Michaela Musilova (Facebook) and @astro-michaela.bsky.social (Bluesky).
paras.zh: 您可以在 Michaela Musilova 博士的网站和社交媒体上关注她：@astro_michaela（Instagram、TikTok 和 Threads）、@Dr. Michaela Musilova (Facebook) 和@astro-michaela.bsky.social (Bluesky)。

paras.en: Dr. Michaela Musilova is an award-winning astrobiologist, explorer, professional speaker and author. Michaela has been conducting space-related research at institutions around the world, including NASA, ESA, CalTech, the Canada-France-Hawaii telescope and many others. She was the Commander of 40 simulated missions to the Moon and Mars — the most missions led to date.
paras.zh: 米凯拉·穆西洛娃 (Michaela Musilova) 博士是一位屡获殊荣的天体生物学家、探险家、专业演讲家和作家。米凯拉一直在世界各地的机构进行与太空相关的研究，包括美国宇航局、欧洲航天局、加州理工学院、加拿大-法国-夏威夷望远镜等。她是 40 次月球和火星模拟任务的指挥官，这是迄今为止执行次数最多的任务。

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 28, 1971: Britain launches its 1st satellite Prospero into space on a Black Arrow rocket
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Oct. 28, 1971, the United Kingdom launched its first satellite. The satellite was named Prospero, but it was also known as the X-3.
paras.zh: 1971年10月28日，英国发射了第一颗卫星。这颗卫星被命名为 Prospero，但也被称为 X-3。

paras.en: This wasn't Britain's first satellite, but it was the first and only one the British space program launched with one of its own rockets. The first six British satellites all launched from the United States on NASA rockets. Prospero launched on a carrier rocket called the Black Arrow.
paras.zh: 这不是英国的第一颗卫星，但它是英国太空计划用自己的火箭发射的第一颗也是唯一一颗卫星。前六颗英国卫星均由美国宇航局火箭从美国发射升空。普洛斯彼罗乘坐名为“黑箭”的运载火箭发射升空。

paras.en: The Prospero mission was the fourth and final flight of a Black Arrow rocket. Prospero was designed to study how the environment in space affects communications satellites. It tested things solar cells and telemetry systems, and even had a micrometeoroid detector that would determine small particles in space posed a threat to the spacecraft.
paras.zh: 普洛斯彼罗任务是黑箭火箭的第四次也是最后一次飞行。 Prospero 旨在研究太空环境如何影响通信卫星。它测试了太阳能电池和遥测系统，甚至还有一个微流星体探测器，可以确定太空中的小颗粒对航天器构成的威胁。

paras.en: The mission lifted off from the Woomera Range Complex in Australia. While the launch was a success, the rocket's final stage bumped into the satellite after it separated, and the collision broke one of Prospero's four radio antennas. But the satellite still worked, and it remained operational until 1973.
paras.zh: 该任务从澳大利亚伍默拉山脉综合体起飞。虽然发射很成功，但火箭的最后一级在分离后撞上了卫星，碰撞损坏了普洛斯彼罗的四个无线电天线之一。但这颗卫星仍然可以工作，并且一直运行到 1973 年。

paras.en: The launch of Prospero is etched in the history books of British spaceflight. To this date, it remains the first and last British satellite ever launched on a native rocket built in the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 普洛斯彼罗的发射被铭刻在英国航天史书中。迄今为止，它仍然是第一颗也是最后一颗由英国制造的本土火箭发射的英国卫星。

paras.en: The 66-kilogram satellite launched on a three-stage Black Arrow R-3 rocket and flew in an elliptical orbit that ranged between 522 km to 1,300 km above the Earth. The rocket itself was based on the smaller Black Knight research rocket and stood nearly 13 meters tall. While the launch was successful, the Black Arrow program, which had seen two failures and two successes, was ultimately canceled.
paras.zh: 这颗重 66 公斤的卫星由三级黑箭 R-3 火箭发射，在距离地球 522 公里至 1,300 公里的椭圆轨道上飞行。该火箭本身基于较小的“黑骑士”研究火箭，高度接近 13 米。虽然发射成功，但经历了两次失败和两次成功的黑箭计划最终被取消。

paras.en: The Prospero satellite, meanwhile, operated in orbit for two years, with regular communications ending in 1973, though it was contacted at least once each year through 1996, according to the BBC.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，与此同时，普洛斯彼罗卫星在轨道上运行了两年，定期通信于 1973 年结束，但到 1996 年为止每年至少进行一次联系。

paras.en: The satellite remains in orbit today, its legacy such that at least one company - the Scotland-based space startup Skyrora, has announced plans to retrieve Prospero in orbit and deorbit in Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: 这颗卫星至今仍在轨道上运行，它的遗产使得至少一家公司——总部位于苏格兰的太空初创公司 Skyrora 宣布了将普洛斯彼罗送入轨道并在地球大气层中脱轨的计划。

paras.en: That Skyrora plan, announced in 2021, would use the company's space tug to rendezvous with the defunct Prospero, latch onto it and pull it from space. The company aims to launch its Skyrora XL rocket out of a Saxavord Spaceport in Scotland.
paras.zh: Skyrora 计划于 2021 年宣布，将利用该公司的太空拖船与已失效的 Prospero 号会合，抓住它并将其从太空中拉出。该公司的目标是从苏格兰的 Saxavord 太空港发射 Skyrora XL 火箭。

paras.en: "By recovering Prospero, we are not only coming together as a space nation and taking responsibility for what we have launched into orbit, but also confirming our commitment to the sustainable use of outer space," Volodymyr Levykin, Skyrora founder and CEO, said at the time.
paras.zh: Skyrora 创始人兼首席执行官弗拉基米尔·莱维金 (Volodymyr Levykin) 当时表示：“通过回收 Prospero，我们不仅作为一个太空国家团结在一起，对我们发射到轨道上的东西承担责任，而且还确认了我们对可持续利用外层空间的承诺。”

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: AnySignal to Deliver Space-to-Earth Communications for Three Reflect Orbital Missions
articles.author: AnySignal

paras.en: LOS ANGELES — October 20, 2026 AnySignal, a leading provider of software-defined radios and space-based networking, today announced an agreement with Reflect Orbital to deliver space-to-earth communications for Reflect Orbital’s inaugural satellite and two subsequent missions. The agreement includes the delivery of AnySignal’s USX space transceivers for flight operations and the implementation of the AnyLink software for ground connectivity. This establishes AnySignal as Reflect Orbital’s communications partner, integrating spacecraft radio hardware directly with ground network infrastructure.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶 — 2026 年 10 月 20 日 软件定义无线电和天基网络的领先提供商 AnySignal 今天宣布与 Reflect Orbital 达成协议，为 Reflect Orbital 的首颗卫星和后续的两次任务提供空对地通信。该协议包括交付用于飞行操作的 AnySignal USX 空间收发器以及实施用于地面连接的 AnyLink 软件。这使得 AnySignal 成为 Reflect Orbital 的通信合作伙伴，将航天器无线电硬件直接与地面网络基础设施集成。

paras.en: For these missions, Reflect Orbital satellites will utilize the AnySignal USX transceiver, a multi-band software-defined radio. The USX unit consolidates high-rate payload downlinks and Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) functions within a single hardware module. This configuration removes the need for separate radios for different frequency bands, reducing mass and cabling requirements on the satellite bus. The agreement involves the implementation of AnySignal’s AnyLink software for ground operations. AnyLink functions as an interface that aggregates access to multiple ground-station-as-a-service (GSaaS) providers. The technology enables operators at Reflect to access different third-party ground networks through a single architecture.
paras.zh: 对于这些任务，Reflect Orbital 卫星将利用 AnySignal USX 收发器，这是一种多频段软件定义无线电。 USX 单元将高速有效负载下行链路以及遥测、跟踪和命令 (TT&C) 功能整合到单个硬件模块中。这种配置无需针对不同频段使用单独的无线电，从而减少了卫星总线的质量和布线要求。该协议涉及实施 AnySignal 的 AnyLink 软件以进行地面操作。 AnyLink 充当聚合对多个地面站即服务 (GSaaS) 提供商的访问的接口。该技术使 Reflect 的运营商能够通过单一架构访问不同的第三方地面网络。

paras.en: “AnySignal is excited to provide Reflect with full-stack communications for their upcoming missions,” said CEO and Co-Founder John Malsbury. “This agreement reflects the power of AnySignal’s operating system for the electromagnetic spectrum. The AnySignal operating system, including radio hardware and ground networking, solves technical RF problems so that innovative customers like Reflect Orbital can focus on their groundbreaking missions.”
paras.zh: “AnySignal 很高兴能够为 Reflect 即将到来的任务提供全栈通信，”首席执行官兼联合创始人 John Malsbury 说道。 “该协议体现了 AnySignal 操作系统在电磁频谱方面的强大功能。AnySignal 操作系统（包括无线电硬件和地面网络）解决了射频技术问题，使像 Reflect Orbital 这样的创新客户能够专注于他们的开创性任务。”

paras.en: “We selected AnySignal for both our flight radio and ground connectivity software because it delivers a true end-to-end comms solution,” said Ben Nowack, Co-Founder and CEO, Reflect Orbital. “AnySignal has helped us de-risk early operations and let us focus on engineering the novel parts of our spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Reflect Orbital 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Ben Nowack 表示：“我们选择 AnySignal 作为我们的飞行无线电和地面连接软件，因为它提供了真正的端到端通信解决方案。” “AnySignal 帮助我们降低了早期运营的风险，让我们专注于设计航天器的新颖部件。”

paras.en: AnySignal is a U.S.-based aerospace and defense technology company building the operating system for the electromagnetic spectrum. The company designs, builds, integrates, and operates end-to-end radio-frequency (RF) systems for civil, commercial, and national security customers to sense, connect, and defend across land, air, sea, and space—providing the adaptable spectrum capabilities their missions depend on. For more information, visit: anysignal.com
paras.zh: AnySignal 是一家总部位于美国的航空航天和国防技术公司，致力于构建电磁频谱操作系统。该公司为民用、商业和国家安全客户设计、构建、集成和运营端到端射频 (RF) 系统，以跨陆地、空中、海上和太空进行感知、连接和防御，从而提供他们的任务所依赖的适应性频谱功能。欲了解更多信息，请访问：anysignal.com

paras.en: Reflect Orbital is developing space-enabled infrastructure to deliver sunlight to precise locations on Earth. By redirecting sunlight from orbit, we aim to extend electricity generation at solar farms and provide light to help search-and-rescue teams find people at night and construction crews work more safely after dark. We believe reliable access to affordable energy is the foundation of human progress, a healthier planet and economic growth. Our mission is to unlock more of the sun’s potential and deliver energy abundance to a world that urgently needs it. For more information, visit: https://www.reflectorbital.com/
paras.zh: Reflect Orbital 正在开发太空基础设施，将阳光传送到地球上的精确位置。通过重新定向轨道上的阳光，我们的目标是扩大太阳能发电厂的发电量，并提供照明以帮助搜救队在夜间找到人员，并帮助施工人员在天黑后更安全地工作。我们相信可靠地获得负担得起的能源是人类进步、更健康的地球和经济增长的基础。我们的使命是释放更多太阳能潜力，为急需能源的世界提供丰富的能源。欲了解更多信息，请访问：https://www.reflectorbital.com/

paras.en: Reflect Orbital: press@reflectorbital.com
paras.zh: 反射轨道：press@reflectorbital.com

articles.title: Flexell Space Establishes French Subsidiary to Strengthen European Presence
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Paris-based FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS creates a local business hub in Europe
paras.zh: – 总部位于巴黎的 FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS 在欧洲创建本地商业中心

paras.en: – New entity to support ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers, from technical reviews to supply planning
paras.zh: – 新实体支持与欧洲客户正在进行的合同和批量生产讨论，从技术审查到供应计划

paras.en: Paris, France – Flexell Space, a space solar solution company, announced the establishment of its French entity, FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS, in Paris to strengthen support for ongoing contract and volume-production discussions with European customers.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎——太空太阳能解决方案公司 Flexell Space 宣布在巴黎成立其法国实体 FLEXELL SPACE FRANCE SAS，以加强对与欧洲客户正在进行的合同和批量生产讨论的支持。

paras.en: The move comes as the company’s business discussions in Europe advance. Flexell Space is currently in talks with multiple European customers regarding collaboration agreements and volume supply of space solar cells and power solutions. Through its local presence, the company aims to accelerate customer communication and strengthen its ability to support business activities ranging from technical reviews to negotiations on supply terms.
paras.zh: 此举正值该公司在欧洲的业务讨论取得进展之际。 Flexell Space 目前正在与多个欧洲客户就合作协议以及太空太阳能电池和电力解决方案的批量供应进行谈判。通过其本地业务，该公司旨在加速客户沟通，并增强其支持从技术审查到供应条款谈判等业务活动的能力。

paras.en: - Advancing Contract and Production Discussions with European Customers
paras.zh: - 推进与欧洲客户的合同和生产讨论

paras.en: Space solar cells require close coordination on performance, dimensions, reliability, and delivery schedules, depending on each customer’s spacecraft design and operating environment. Beyond initial product introductions, discussions involve technical documentation reviews, sample evaluations, environmental test results, and design adjustments. Progressing toward volume supply also requires alignment on production schedules and quality management processes.
paras.zh: 太空太阳能电池需要在性能、尺寸、可靠性和交付时间表方面密切协调，具体取决于每个客户的航天器设计和操作环境。除了最初的产品介绍之外，讨论还涉及技术文档审查、样品评估、环境测试结果和设计调整。实现批量供应还需要调整生产计划和质量管理流程。

paras.en: Flexell Space said that as discussions with European customers move toward contracts and volume production, a local presence has become increasingly important for responding promptly to customer needs. The French entity will support these activities and serve as a link between European customers and the company’s R&D and manufacturing teams in Korea.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 表示，随着与欧洲客户的讨论转向合同和批量生产，本地业务对于迅速响应客户需求变得越来越重要。法国实体将支持这些活动，并充当欧洲客户与该公司在韩国的研发和制造团队之间的纽带。

paras.en: The company plans to deepen engagement with customers and partners across Europe, including France, Germany, Italy, and Lithuania. By gaining a closer understanding of each customer’s development schedule and technical requirements, it aims to facilitate timely decisions and follow-up actions throughout the collaboration process.
paras.zh: 该公司计划加深与欧洲各地客户和合作伙伴的接触，包括法国、德国、意大利和立陶宛。通过更深入地了解每个客户的开发进度和技术要求，旨在促进整个协作过程中的及时决策和后续行动。

paras.en: - Connecting Next-Generation Space Solar Technology with Production Readiness
paras.zh: - 将下一代太空太阳能技术与生产准备相结合

paras.en: Flexell Space develops next-generation tandem solar cells and related power solutions for space applications. Its tandem architecture combines solar cells with different characteristics to deliver the performance, low weight, and cost competitiveness required for space missions.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 为太空应用开发下一代串联太阳能电池和相关电源解决方案。其串联架构结合了具有不同特性的太阳能电池，以提供太空任务所需的性能、低重量和成本竞争力。

paras.en: The company is expanding beyond solar cell development into modules and arrays tailored to customer missions and satellite platforms. Its preparations for commercialization and volume production address not only product performance, but also reliability in the space environment, manufacturing process repeatability, quality management, and supply stability.
paras.zh: 该公司正在将太阳能电池开发扩展到为客户任务和卫星平台量身定制的模块和阵列。其商业化和量产的准备工作不仅涉及产品性能，还涉及太空环境的可靠性、制造过程的可重复性、质量管理和供应稳定性。

paras.en: With the establishment of its French entity, Flexell Space plans to incorporate feedback from European technical discussions into product development and supply planning more quickly. It will strengthen coordination between its Korean R&D teams and European customers by communicating required specifications and evaluation criteria, while sharing development progress and validation results.
paras.zh: 随着法国实体的成立，Flexell Space 计划更快地将欧洲技术讨论的反馈纳入产品开发和供应规划中。它将通过沟通所需的规格和评估标准，同时共享开发进度和验证结果，加强韩国研发团队和欧洲客户之间的协调。

paras.en: The company will also continue discussions on supply scope, development schedules, production volumes, and delivery timelines to translate ongoing negotiations into concrete business outcomes.
paras.zh: 该公司还将继续讨论供应范围、开发计划、产量和交付时间表，将正在进行的谈判转化为具体的业务成果。

paras.en: - Building Long-Term Partnerships Across Europe
paras.zh: - 在欧洲建立长期合作伙伴关系

paras.en: Flexell Space plans to operate its French entity as a hub for developing long-term relationships with European customers. Alongside supporting existing customer projects, it will explore new product applications and joint development opportunities with local space companies and research institutions.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 计划将其法国实体作为与欧洲客户发展长期关系的中心进行运营。除了支持现有客户项目外，还将探索新产品应用以及与当地航天公司和研究机构的联合开发机会。

paras.en: As satellite missions and platforms become more diverse, space power solutions increasingly require development and supply arrangements tailored to specific operating conditions. Flexell Space’s strategy is to maintain close contact with customers and connect their requirements with R&D and manufacturing preparations to expand its European business.
paras.zh: 随着卫星任务和平台变得更加多样化，空间电源解决方案越来越需要针对特定​​操作条件进行定制的开发和供应安排。 Flexell Space的战略是与客户保持密切联系，将他们的需求与研发和制造准备工作联系起来，以扩大其欧洲业务。

paras.en: “We are currently discussing contracts and volume supply with multiple European customers. As these discussions progress, being closer to our customers has become increasingly important in turning them into tangible results,” said Keo-san Lee, CFO of Flexell Space. “Our French entity will help accelerate technical discussions and business execution, while enabling us to respond more closely to our customers’ development and production schedules.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 首席财务官 Keo-san Lee 表示：“我们目前正在与多个欧洲客户讨论合同和批量供应。随着这些讨论的进展，为了将其转化为切实成果，与客户的距离变得越来越重要。” “我们的法国实体将有助于加快技术讨论和业务执行，同时使我们能够更密切地响应客户的开发和生产计划。”

paras.en: “In the space industry, technical capability must be accompanied by confidence in a supplier’s ability to deliver products reliably,” Lee added. “By connecting our R&D and manufacturing capabilities in Korea with local customer support in Europe, we aim to build stronger, longer-term partnerships.”
paras.zh: “在航天工业中，技术能力必须伴随着对供应商可靠交付产品能力的信心，”李补充道。 “通过将我们在韩国的研发和制造能力与欧洲当地客户支持联系起来，我们的目标是建立更强大、更长期的合作伙伴关系。”

articles.title: NASA Welcomes Vietnam as Newest Artemis Accords Signatory
articles.author: Elizabeth Shaw

paras.en: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam became the 78th nation to sign the Artemis Accords, joining a growing coalition of like-minded nations committed to the peaceful, transparent, and responsible exploration of space.
paras.zh: 越南社会主义共和国成为第 78 个签署《阿耳忒弥斯协议》的国家，加入了由志同道合的国家组成的日益壮大的联盟，致力于和平、透明和负责任的太空探索。

paras.en: “Vietnam is joining at an important point in the development of its own space program,” said NASA Deputy Administrator Matt Anderson in recorded remarks for the ceremony. “NASA and the Vietnam National Space Center have built momentum in satellite innovation, land-use research, and radar-based Earth observation. Joining the Artemis Accords opens a new chapter in that relationship. We’ve aligned on the principles. The opportunities are in front of us, and now we can build on that foundation together. We are proud to welcome Vietnam to the Artemis Accords community.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局副局长马特·安德森在仪式录音中表示：“越南正在其自身太空计划发展的重要时刻加入。” “美国宇航局和越南国家航天中心在卫星创新、土地利用研究和基于雷达的地球观测方面势头强劲。加入《阿尔忒弥斯协议》开启了这种关系的新篇章。我们在原则上达成了一致。机遇就在我们面前，现在我们可以共同在此基础上再接再厉。我们很自豪地欢迎越南加入《阿尔忒弥斯协议》社区。”

paras.en: Vietnam’s Minister of Science and Technology Vũ Hải Quân signed the Artemis Accords on behalf of the country during the Vietnam International Digital Week in Ha Long. The United States Ambassador to Vietnam Jennifer Wicks also participated in the signing event.
paras.zh: 越南科技部部长武海泉在下龙湾越南国际数字周期间代表国家签署了《阿耳忒弥斯协议》。美国驻越南大使詹妮弗·威克斯也参加了签字仪式。

paras.en: Vietnam’s decision extends the U.S.-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership into a new frontier. Built on more than 30 years of cooperation, the partnership spans defense, economic, law enforcement, war legacy, and technological cooperation, and it advances peace, stability, and prosperity in a free and open Indo-Pacific.
paras.zh: 越南的决定将美越全面战略伙伴关系拓展到新领域。该伙伴关系建立在30多年的合作基础上，涵盖国防、经济、执法、战争遗产和技术合作，并促进自由开放的印太地区的和平、稳定与繁荣。

paras.en: Earlier this year, NASA partnered with Vietnam’s Vietnamese-German University to support the agency’s Soil Moisture Active Passive mission, which measures surface-soil water worldwide. Vietnam also inaugurated its National Space Center in Hanoi and is developing domestic satellite capabilities through the LOTUSat program, focusing on Earth observation, weather monitoring, and disaster response.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，美国宇航局与越南越南-德国大学合作，支持该机构的土壤湿度主动被动任务，该任务测量全球表层土壤水。越南还在河内开设了国家航天中心，并正在通过 LOTUSat 计划发展国内卫星能力，重点是地球观测、天气监测和灾害响应。

paras.en: In 2020, NASA and the State Department joined with seven other founding nations to establish the Artemis Accords, responding to the growing interest in lunar activities by both governments and private companies. They introduced the first set of practical principles aimed at enhancing the safety and coordination between nations as they explore the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
paras.zh: 2020 年，美国宇航局和国务院与其他七个创始国共同制定了《阿耳忒弥斯协议》，以回应政府和私营公司对月球活动日益增长的兴趣。他们提出了第一套实用原则，旨在加强各国探索月球、火星及其他地方时的安全和协调。

paras.en: Signing the Artemis Accords means committing to explore peaceably and transparently, to render aid to those in need, to enable access to scientific data that all of humanity can learn from, to ensure activities do not interfere with those of others, and to preserve historically significant sites and artifacts by developing best practices for space exploration for the benefit of all.
paras.zh: 签署《阿尔忒弥斯协议》意味着致力于和平、透明地探索，向有需要的人提供援助，获得全人类都可以学习的科学数据，确保活动不干扰他人的活动，并通过为所有人的利益制定太空探索最佳实践来保护具有历史意义的遗址和文物。

paras.en: More countries are expected to sign the Artemis Accords in the months and years ahead, as NASA continues its work to establish a safe, peaceful, and prosperous future in space.
paras.zh: 随着美国宇航局继续努力在太空建立安全、和平和繁荣的未来，预计未来数月乃至数年将有更多国家签署《阿耳忒弥斯协议》。

paras.en: Learn more about the Artemis Accords at:
paras.zh: 了解有关《阿耳忒弥斯协议》的更多信息：

articles.title: Caltech Names Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman as NASA JPL Deputy
articles.author: Ryan J. Smernoff

paras.en: Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman has been named Caltech associate vice president and deputy director of NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. The emeritus astronaut and retired U.S. Navy captain begins his new role at NASA’s center of excellence for robotics and deep space exploration and at Caltech, which manages JPL for NASA, on Nov. 30, 2026.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号指挥官里德·怀斯曼被任命为加州理工学院副总裁兼美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室副主任。这位名誉宇航员和退役美国海军上尉将于 2026 年 11 月 30 日开始在 NASA 机器人和深空探索卓越中心以及负责管理 NASA 喷气推进实验室的加州理工学院担任新职务。

paras.en: “Reid has spent his career at the edge of what is possible, and he has the technical judgment, operational experience, and leadership to help push that edge farther,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “As commander of Artemis II, he helped carry America back around the Moon, and now, as an emeritus astronaut, he will continue giving back to NASA from a new vantage point at JPL. Reid is joining a storied laboratory that has made an enormous amount of history, and there is a lot more ahead. I am excited to see what he and the JPL team accomplish in the years to come.”
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 表示：“里德的职业生涯一直处于可能性的边缘，他拥有技术判断、操作经验和领导力，可以帮助进一步推动这一边缘。” “作为阿耳忒弥斯二号的指挥官，他帮助美国重返月球，现在，作为一名荣誉宇航员，他将在喷气推进实验室的新有利位置继续回馈美国宇航局。里德正在加入一个创造了巨大历史的传奇实验室，未来还有更多的事情要做。我很高兴看到他和喷气推进实验室团队在未来几年取得的成就。”

paras.en: During the Artemis II test flight, Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen journeyed 695,081 miles on a lunar flyby that took them farther than any humans have ever traveled before.
paras.zh: 在阿耳忒弥斯二号试飞期间，怀斯曼、维克多·格洛弗、克里斯蒂娜·科赫和杰里米·汉森飞越月球，飞行了 695,081 英里，这比任何人类以前走过的距离都要远。

paras.en: “It feels fitting for Reid, who with the Artemis II crew traveled farther from Earth than any human in history, to join Caltech and JPL — institutions that for nearly 90 years have sent spacecraft into the far reaches of our solar system and beyond,” said Dave Gallagher, JPL director and Caltech vice president. “Reid shares our drive for discovery, knows what it takes to lead teams through high-stakes missions, and has a remarkable ability to inspire people everywhere. He adds incredible bench strength to our leadership team as we build on the lab’s legacy and shape its future together.”
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室主任兼加州理工学院副院长戴夫·加拉格尔 (Dave Gallagher) 表示：“里德和阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员一起离开地球的距离比历史上任何人都远，加入加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室这对里德来说感觉很合适，这两个机构在近 90 年来一直将航天器送入太阳系深处及更远的地方。” “里德与我们一样追求发现，知道如何领导团队完成高风险任务，并且具有激励世界各地人们的非凡能力。他为我们的领导团队增添了令人难以置信的后备力量，让我们在实验室的遗产基础上继续发展，共同塑造实验室的未来。”

paras.en: After joining NASA’s astronaut corps in 2009, Wiseman went on to serve as flight engineer aboard the International Space Station for the 165-day Expedition 41 mission in 2014 and was a commander of NASA’s 21st Extreme Environment Mission Operations expedition, during which he lived for eight days in a habitat on the ocean floor in 2016. As the agency’s chief astronaut from December 2020 to November 2022, Wiseman led NASA’s astronaut corps, overseeing crew flight readiness and crew safety for all NASA human spaceflight missions. During his years of service at the agency, he has conducted hundreds of scientific experiments.
paras.zh: 2009 年加入 NASA 宇航员队伍后，怀斯曼于 2014 年在国际空间站担任飞行工程师，执行为期 165 天的 Expedition 41 任务，并担任 NASA 第 21 次极端环境任务行动探险队的指挥官，期间他于 2016 年在海底栖息地生活了八天。2020 年 12 月至 11 月担任该机构的首席宇航员2022 年，怀斯曼领导 NASA 宇航员团队，负责监督 NASA 所有载人航天任务的机组人员飞行准备情况和机组人员安全。在该机构任职期间，他进行了数百次科学实验。

paras.en: “I’ve explored the furthest reaches of what a human can explore at NASA — and there were truly no words in the English vocabulary to describe seeing the Sun disappear behind the Moon from deep space. But that experience was really the jumping off point to go do the impossible things that Caltech and JPL dream, dare together, and do for NASA and the nation,” Wiseman said. “What an awesome time in my career to join this team and to try and push humanity and push our understanding of the solar system and the universe.”
paras.zh: 怀斯曼说：“我在 NASA 探索了人类可以探索的最远领域，英语词汇中确实没有任何词语可以形容看到太阳从深空消失在月球后面。但那次经历确实是实现加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室梦想、共同敢于为 NASA 和国家做不可能的事情的起点。” “加入这个团队，努力推动人类进步，推动我们对太阳系和宇宙的理解，这是我职业生涯中多么美好的时光。”

paras.en: Wiseman joins JPL, NASA’s only federally funded research and development center, as the lab approaches its 90th anniversary since being founded by Caltech. In his role as Caltech’s associate vice president and JPL deputy director, Wiseman will be responsible for the strategic leadership, stewardship and continuous improvement of laboratory operations, including close partnership with Caltech on institutional planning, management and compliance. Serving as Center Management Authority for JPL mission execution, Wiseman will ensure operational excellence across mission support functions in accordance with NASA requirements and applicable federal and state regulations. In addition, he will be JPL’s primary interface for national security programs.
paras.zh: 随着加州理工学院成立 90 周年之际，怀斯曼加入了 NASA 唯一一家由联邦资助的研发中心 JPL。作为加州理工学院的副总裁和喷气推进实验室副主任，怀斯曼将负责实验室运营的战略领导、管理和持续改进，包括与加州理工学院在机构规划、管理和合规性方面的密切合作。作为喷气推进实验室任务执行的中心管理机构，怀斯曼将根据 NASA 的要求以及适用的联邦和州法规，确保任务支持职能的卓越运营。此外，他还将成为喷气推进实验室国家安全项目的主要接口。

paras.en: “Reid brings to Caltech and JPL a truly unprecedented view of what humanity can achieve when ingenuity and determination are matched with the courage to pursue the furthest frontiers,” said Caltech president Ray Jayawardhana. “His pioneering spirit coupled with unbounded curiosity make him a natural fit for Caltech and JPL, a force-multiplier for a community whose daring continues to push the limits of humanity’s reach. I look forward to working closely with Dave and Reid as we chart our next era of exploration in partnership with NASA, elevating America’s space ambitions to breathtaking new heights.”
paras.zh: 加州理工学院院长雷·贾亚瓦德哈纳 (Ray Jayawardhana) 表示：“里德为加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室带来了一种真正前所未有的视角，让我们看到，当聪明才智、决心与追求最远领域的勇气相结合时，人类可以取得怎样的成就。” “他的开拓精神加上无限的好奇心使他天生适合加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室，对于一个不断突破人类所能达到极限的社区来说，这是一个力量倍增器。我期待着与戴夫和里德密切合作，与 NASA 合作规划我们的下一个探索时代，将美国的太空雄心提升到令人惊叹的新高度。”

paras.en: After receiving a bachelor’s degree in computer and systems engineering from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Wiseman joined the Navy, going on to fly combat missions and serve as a test pilot. He also has a master’s degree in systems engineering from Johns Hopkins University in his hometown of Baltimore.
paras.zh: 在伦斯勒理工学院获得计算机和系统工程学士学位后，怀斯曼加入海军，继续执行战斗任务并担任试飞员。他还拥有家乡巴尔的摩约翰霍普金斯大学的系统工程硕士学位。

paras.en: Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室，加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳

articles.title: Arnab Strikes India

paras.en: The first named storm of the 2026 North Indian Ocean cyclone season—Arnab (pronounced Or-nab)—emerged in the Bay of Bengal on October 25, a rather late start for a basin that typically produces named cyclones in April or May.
paras.zh: 2026 年北印度洋气旋季节的第一个命名风暴——阿纳布（Arnab，发音为 Or-nab）——于 10 月 25 日在孟加拉湾出现，对于通常在 4 月或 5 月产生命名气旋的盆地来说，这是一个相当晚的开始。

paras.en: When the VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite) on NOAA-20 captured this nighttime image at 20:12 Universal Time on October 26 (1:42 a.m. India Standard Time on October 27), the storm had sustained winds of about 140 kilometers (85 miles) per hour, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD).
paras.zh: 据印度气象局 (IMD) 称，当 NOAA-20 上的 VIIRS（可见红外成像辐射计套件）于 10 月 26 日世界时间 20:12（印度标准时间 10 月 27 日凌晨 1:42）捕捉到这张夜间图像时，风暴持续的风速约为每小时 140 公里（85 英里）。

paras.en: When Arnab made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coast early on October 28, sustained winds were 130 kilometers per hour. IMD categorizes a storm that strength as a "very severe cyclonic storm," which is similar to a Category 1 storm on the Saffir-Simpson hurricane wind scale. It made landfall between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, a heavily settled area home to large cities, farmland, and fishing communities.
paras.zh: 当阿纳布于10月28日早些时候在安得拉邦和亚南海岸登陆时，持续风速为每小时130公里。 IMD 将这种强度的风暴归类为“非常严重的气旋风暴”，类似于萨菲尔-辛普森飓风等级的 1 类风暴。它在巴帕特拉和维沙卡帕特南之间登陆，这是一个人口稠密的地区，拥有大城市、农田和渔业社区。

paras.en: Arnab caused extensive damage, uprooting trees, inundating crops and homes, limiting fishing operations, and disrupting transportation and power networks, according to news reports. Prior to landfall, Indian authorities had evacuated tens of thousands of people from vulnerable coastal areas.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，阿纳布造成了广泛的破坏，树木被连根拔起，农作物和房屋被淹没，捕鱼作业受到限制，交通和电力网络也受到干扰。登陆前，印度当局已从脆弱的沿海地区疏散了数万人。

paras.en: The storm comes in the midst of an El Niño, a climate pattern marked by warmer-than-normal water temperatures in parts of the equatorial Pacific that emerges roughly every two to seven years. The changed ocean conditions can influence the atmosphere in ways that alter global weather patterns and change the distribution of rainfall, winds, tropical cyclones, fires, floods, and other phenomena.
paras.zh: 这场风暴发生在厄尔尼诺现象期间，厄尔尼诺现象是一种气候模式，其特点是赤道太平洋部分地区的水温高于正常水平，大约每两到七年出现一次。海洋条件的变化会影响大气，从而改变全球天气模式，改变降雨、风、热带气旋、火灾、洪水和其他现象的分布。

paras.en: In the Bay of Bengal, for instance, some research indicates that altered environmental conditions during an El Niño are associated with a reduction in tropical cyclone activity. The ocean basin sees both less frequent and less intense tropical cyclones during El Niño years, researchers have found.
paras.zh: 例如，在孟加拉湾，一些研究表明，厄尔尼诺现象期间环境条件的变化与热带气旋活动的减少有关。研究人员发现，在厄尔尼诺现象期间，海洋盆地的热带气旋频率较低，强度也较低。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory image by Michala Garrison, using VIIRS day-night band data from NASA EOSDIS LANCE, GIBS/Worldview, and the Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS). Story by Adam Voiland.
paras.zh: NASA 地球观测站图像，由 Michala Garrison 拍摄，使用来自 NASA EOSDIS LANCE、GIBS/Worldview 和联合极地卫星系统 (JPSS) 的 VIIRS 昼夜波段数据。亚当·沃伊兰的故事。
