articles.title: Georgia insurance commissioner incumbent and former state legislator face off for position
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Two candidates are running for a four-year term as Georgia Commissioner of Insurance and Safety Fire on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 两名候选人将于 11 月 3 日竞选佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员，任期四年。

paras.en: Incumbent John King, a Republican, is running against Keisha Waites, a former state representative and Atlanta city councilwoman.
paras.zh: 现任共和党人约翰·金正在与前州众议员、亚特兰大市议员凯莎·韦特斯竞选。

paras.en: King was appointed to the position in 2019 and elected to a full term in 2022, according to his campaign website.
paras.zh: 据他的竞选网站称，金于 2019 年被任命为该职位，并于 2022 年当选完成任期。

paras.en: The website adds that he retired from the U.S. Army as a major general and also previously served as the chief of the Doraville Police Department.
paras.zh: 该网站补充说，他以少将身份从美国陆军退役，此前还曾担任多拉维尔警察局局长。

paras.en: “As Georgia’s Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner, General King has disrupted the status quo, put Georgia families first, and held the powerful accountable,” the website states.
paras.zh: 该网站称：“作为佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员，金将军打破了现状，将佐治亚州家庭放在第一位，并追究了当权者的责任。”

paras.en: King says that his office fields 10,000 complaints from Georgians per year and has recovered more than $100 million from insurance companies.
paras.zh: 金表示，他的办公室每年都会收到 10,000 起格鲁吉亚人的投诉，并已从保险公司追回超过 1 亿美元。

paras.en: “When insurance companies try to take advantage of Georgians, we’re there,” King says on the website. “Since 2019, my office has leveled more than $22 million in fines against insurance companies, including the single largest fine in Georgia history at $5 million. Now, I’m fighting to increase the maximum initial fines allowed.”
paras.zh: 金在网站上表示：“当保险公司试图利用格鲁吉亚人的利益时，我们就会介入。” “自 2019 年以来，我的办公室已对保险公司处以超过 2200 万美元的罚款，其中包括佐治亚州历史上最大的单笔罚款 500 万美元。现在，我正在努力提高允许的最高初始罚款额。”

paras.en: The office has delivered tort and lawsuit reform in the state, his website claims.
paras.zh: 他的网站称，该办公室已在该州实施侵权和诉讼改革。

paras.en: “When disaster strikes, we’re there,” he says. “Over the last six years, my team has responded to natural disasters throughout Georgia, deploying teams on the ground and setting up claims villages to connect storm victims directly with providers.”
paras.zh: “当灾难来袭时，我们就在那里，”他说。 “在过去的六年里，我的团队应对了佐治亚州各地的自然灾害，在当地部署了团队并建立了索赔村，将风暴受害者与提供者直接联系起来。”

paras.en: Waites previously worked as a disaster reservist/commercial loan specialist for the U.S. Small Business Administration Disaster Assistance Division and in several Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) roles, according to her LinkedIn.
paras.zh: 据 LinkedIn 介绍，维特斯此前曾担任美国小企业管理局灾难援助部门的灾难预备役人员/商业贷款专家，并在联邦紧急事务管理局 (FEMA) 担任过多个职务。

paras.en: “This combination — federal disaster work, state legislation, and citywide governance — directly aligns with the mission of the Georgia Office of Insurance and Safety Fire Commissioner: protecting families through fair regulation, consumer services, rate review, and oversight of insurers and agents,” Waites’ website states. “I stand on a foundation of public service and legislative victories. The people of Georgia deserve proven leadership; look at the record, look at the results.”
paras.zh: 韦特斯的网站称：“这种结合——联邦灾难工作、州立法和全市治理——与佐治亚州保险和安全消防专员办公室的使命直接一致：通过公平监管、消费者服务、费率审查以及对保险公司和代理人的监督来保护家庭。” “我站在公共服务和立法胜利的基础上。佐治亚州人民应该得到经过验证的领导力；看看记录，看看结果。”

paras.en: Waites says that the rate freeze initiative is a top priority. This includes aggressively reviewing and challenging unjustified auto and home insurance rate hikes.
paras.zh: 韦茨表示，冻结利率举措是重中之重。这包括积极审查和挑战不合理的汽车和家庭保险费率上涨。

paras.en: She also wants to end ZIP code and credit score discrimination by investing in modern equipment and faster response times for Georgia’s rural and underserved communities.
paras.zh: 她还希望通过投资现代设备并为佐治亚州的农村和服务欠缺的社区提供更快的响应时间，结束邮政编码和信用评分歧视。

paras.en: Another of Waites’s priorities is a “Consumer Fraud Strike Force” to protect seniors and vulnerable families from predatory insurance scams.
paras.zh: 韦特斯的另一个优先事项是建立“消费者欺诈打击部队”，以保护老年人和弱势家庭免受掠夺性保险诈骗。

paras.en: An Insurify analysis says the next Georgia commissioner will play a key role in market oversight and consumer protection as home insurance costs continue rising in the state. It found that the state’s average annual home insurance premium increased by 25% from 2023 to mid-2026.
paras.zh: Insurify 的一项分析称，随着该州家庭保险成本持续上涨，下一任佐治亚州专员将在市场监管和消费者保护方面发挥关键作用。研究发现，从 2023 年到 2026 年中期，该州平均每年家庭保险保费增加了 25%。

paras.en: “Georgia recently passed a massive insurance bill imposing expanded regulations on insurers to help protect consumers and, among other things, expanding the insurance commissioner’s authority,” Insurify says. “For example, effective Jan. 1, 2027, the commissioner will be able to increase penalties and factor an insurer’s claims conduct history into rate review decisions. And the insurance commissioner elected in November will be the first to exercise the new authority.”
paras.zh: Insurify 表示：“佐治亚州最近通过了一项大规模的保险法案，扩大了对保险公司的监管，以帮助保护消费者，并扩大保险专员的权力。” “例如，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，专员将能够加大处罚力度，并将保险公司的索赔行为历史纳入费率审查决定中。11 月当选的保险专员将是第一个行使新权力的人。”

articles.title: LKQ replaces CEO, announces Q3 losses
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: LKQ replaces Justin Jude, after a little over two years as president and CEO, as the company announces a net loss of $16 million to $32 million in its third quarter.
paras.zh: LKQ 接替贾斯汀·裘德 (Justin Jude) 担任总裁兼首席执行官两年多后，该公司宣布第三季度净亏损 1600 万美元至 3200 万美元。

paras.en: The company’s shares fell Friday to $17.42 at close, a 22.47% decline, after the announcement of its Q3 and administrative changes. The shares continued to hold close to Friday’s closing price early this week.
paras.zh: 在宣布第三季度业绩和行政变动后，该公司股价周五收盘下跌 22.47%，至 17.42 美元。本周初，该股继续维持在接近周五收盘价的水平。

paras.en: Salvatore A. Abbate, CEO of Veritiv Corp., will start as president and CEO Dec. 15, LKQ says. It added that Jude departed from the company Oct. 23.
paras.zh: LKQ 表示，Veritiv Corp. 首席执行官 Salvatore A. Abbate 将于 12 月 15 日就任总裁兼首席执行官。它还补充说，裘德于 10 月 23 日离开公司。

paras.en: “LKQ’s performance, particularly in Europe, has fallen significantly short of the board’s expectations, and the board is taking decisive action to address it,” said John Mendel, chairman of the board, in the release. “We have strong conviction in LKQ’s business and its potential to create significant value for shareholders. Sal is a proven operator with a track record of driving performance in complex distribution businesses, and A&M brings deep experience in operational improvement. Together with LKQ’s talented teams, we are focused on improving execution and delivering improved results for our stakeholders.”
paras.zh: 董事会主席 John Mendel 在新闻稿中表示：“LKQ 的业绩，尤其是在欧洲的业绩，明显低于董事会的预期，董事会正在采取果断行动来解决这个问题。” “我们对 LKQ 的业务及其为股东创造巨大价值的潜力充满信心。Sal 是一位久经考验的运营商，在复杂的分销业务中拥有推动业绩的记录，而 A&M 在运营改进方面拥有丰富的经验。与 LKQ 的才华横溢的团队一起，我们致力于提高执行力并为我们的利益相关者提供更好的结果。”

paras.en: Mendel and Sue Grove, chair of the audit committee, will cover the president and CEO duties until Abbate assumes the role, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，孟德尔和审计委员会主席苏格罗夫将承担总裁和首席执行官的职责，直到阿巴特就任这一职位。

paras.en: Preliminary financial results show LKQ’s revenue dropped in Q3 to $3.32 billion, from $3.50 billion in Q3 2025, the release adds.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充道，初步财务结果显示，LKQ 第三季度的收入从 2025 年第三季度的 35 亿美元下降至 33.2 亿美元。

paras.en: Parts and services organic revenue declined 5.4%.
paras.zh: 零部件和服务有机收入下降 5.4%。

paras.en: The company’s net loss includes $111 million of non-cash impairment charges compared with a net income of $178 million in Q3 2025, according to the release.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，该公司的净亏损包括 1.11 亿美元的非现金减值费用，而 2025 年第三季度的净利润为 1.78 亿美元。

paras.en: “The third quarter results primarily reflect underperformance in the Europe segment, including operational disruptions associated with the ERP implementation in Germany and volume declines in the United Kingdom and Benelux,” the release states. “While Specialty was modestly below expectations, the shortfall was more limited, and North America performed in line with the company’s expectations despite softer market conditions.”
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“第三季度业绩主要反映了欧洲市场的表现不佳，包括德国 ERP 实施带来的运营中断以及英国和比荷卢经济联盟的销量下降。” “虽然特种业务略低于预期，但缺口更为有限，尽管市场状况疲软，北美地区的表现仍符合公司的预期。”

paras.en: LKQ is withdrawing its full-year 2026 guidance, last updated in July, due to the Q3 results and the appointment of Abbate, the release adds.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充道，由于第三季度的业绩和 Abbate 的任命，LKQ 将撤回 2026 年全年指引（上次更新于 7 月）。

paras.en: The company also announced that Andy Hamilton is departing from his role as president and managing director of LKQ Europe in the news release. It adds that the board has engaged Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) to advise the company on its European operations.
paras.zh: 该公司还在新闻稿中宣布安迪·汉密尔顿 (Andy Hamilton) 将辞去 LKQ Europe 总裁兼董事总经理的职务。它补充说，董事会已聘请 Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) 就该公司的欧洲业务提供建议。

paras.en: Abbate brings three decades of experience leading large, complex distribution and industrial businesses, according to an LKQ release.
paras.zh: 据 LKQ 发布的消息称，Abbate 拥有三十年领导大型复杂分销和工业企业的经验。

paras.en: “As CEO of Veritiv Corporation, he led a significant transformation of the company, with its share price increasing more than 13-fold during his tenure, culminating in its $2.6 billion sale to Clayton, Dubilier & Rice in 2023,” the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“作为 Veritiv 公司的首席执行官，他领导了公司的重大转型，公司股价在他任职期间上涨了 13 倍以上，最终于 2023 年以 26 亿美元的价格出售给了 Clayton, Dubilier & Rice。”

paras.en: He previously served as Veritiv’s chief operating officer and chief commercial officer. He also previously held senior leadership roles at Andersen Windows & Doors, Solutia (now East Chemical Company, and Armstrong World Industries, according to the release.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任 Veritiv 的首席运营官和首席商务官。据新闻稿称，他此前还曾在 Andersen Windows & Doors、Solutia（现为 East Chemical Company）和 Armstrong World Industries 担任高级领导职务。

paras.en: LKQ says that Abbate’s experience “aligns closely with LKQ’s strategic and operational priorities.” It adds that he has led high-volume, multi-site distribution businesses where pricing, procurement and supply chain discipline are critical to performance.
paras.zh: LKQ 表示，Abbate 的经验“与 LKQ 的战略和运营重点密切相关”。它还补充说，他领导过大批量、多地点的分销业务，其中定价、采购和供应链纪律对业绩至关重要。

paras.en: The release adds that Abbate has led portfolio transformations focused on margin improvement and cash generation.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿补充说，阿巴特领导了专注于利润率提高和现金生成的投资组合转型。

paras.en: “After a thorough search, the Board concluded that Sal is the right leader for LKQ at this moment,” Mendel said. “He is a disciplined operator and people-centered leader, who has transformed a complex distribution business, improved margins and created significant value for shareholders. Sal brings the operating rigor, commercial instincts and sense of urgency we need to sharpen execution across our businesses and unlock the full potential of LKQ. On behalf of the Board, I also want to thank Justin for his years of service and contributions to LKQ.”
paras.zh: “经过彻底的调查，董事会得出结论，萨尔是目前 LKQ 的正确领导者，”孟德尔说。 “他是一位纪律严明的经营者和以人为本的领导者，他改变了复杂的分销业务，提高了利润率，并为股东创造了巨大的价值。Sal 带来了我们所需的运营严谨性、商业本能和紧迫感，以提高我们整个业务的执行力并释放 LKQ 的全部潜力。我还要代表董事会感谢 Justin 多年来对 LKQ 的服务和贡献。”

paras.en: LKQ said that it expected positive business growth for aftermarket parts during its second quarter earnings call.
paras.zh: LKQ 表示，预计在第二季度财报电话会议上售后零部件业务将出现积极增长。

paras.en: Jude said insurance carriers are looking for ways to cut costs and the easiest way to do so is by using more alternative parts and improving cycle times.
paras.zh: 裘德说，保险公司正在寻找削减成本的方法，最简单的方法是使用更多替代零件并缩短周期时间。

paras.en: “A lot more business is being driven to the MSOs [multi-shop operators] right now,” Jude said. “Now, MSOs are the bigger customers. They get the best prices. But at the end of the day, they do use more alternative parts than a non-MSO rooftop, so we see a bigger share of opportunity for our wallet to grow with those guys.”
paras.zh: “现在，更多的业务正在转向 MSO（多商店运营商），”Jude 说。 “现在，MSO 是更大的客户。他们获得最优惠的价格。但归根结底，他们确实比非 MSO 屋顶使用更多的替代部件，因此我们看到我们的钱包有更大的机会与这些人一起成长。”

paras.en: Alternative parts usage (APU) was more than 40% for the second quarter, Jude said. He added this surpasses a previous record from last quarter.
paras.zh: Jude 表示，第二季度替代零件使用率 (APU) 超过 40%。他补充说，这超过了上季度的记录。

articles.title: NABC to hold new fundraiser during SEMA Week
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The National Auto Body Council (NABC) and the Changing and Saving Lives Foundation are hosting a new fall fundraiser this year, Nov. 1-6, during SEMA Week in Las Vegas and through nationwide virtual participation.
paras.zh: 美国国家汽车车身委员会 (NABC) 和改变与拯救生命基金会将于今年 11 月 1 日至 6 日在拉斯维加斯 SEMA 周期间通过全国虚拟参与方式举办一场新的秋季筹款活动。

paras.en: The “Steps to Change and Save Lives Challenge,” presented by Enterprise, will trade the usual golf spikes for walking shoes to benefit the NABC Recycled Rides and NABC First Responder Emergency Extrication (F.R.E.E.) programs.
paras.zh: Enterprise 提出的“改变和拯救生命的步骤挑战”将用普通的高尔夫球鞋换成步行鞋，以使 NABC 回收游乐设施和 NABC 急救人员紧急救援 (F.R.E.E.) 计划受益。

paras.en: Every year, the program gifts around 250 vehicles to veterans, military members, and families in need to get them to work, school, and medical appointments, and take care of their families. The program has gifted more than 3,850 vehicles to date, valued at nearly $69 million.
paras.zh: 该计划每年都会向退伍军人、军人和有需要的家庭赠送约 250 辆汽车，供他们上班、上学、就医和照顾家人。迄今为止，该计划已捐赠了超过 3,850 辆汽车，价值近 6,900 万美元。

paras.en: The F.R.E.E. program provides free training to more than 1,500 first responders each year on how to rescue those involved in collisions from late-model vehicles. More than 7,000 first responders have been trained through the program.
paras.zh: F.R.E.E.该计划每年为 1,500 多名急救人员提供免费培训，教他们如何营救新型车辆碰撞事故中的人员。超过 7,000 名急救人员已通过该计划接受了培训。

paras.en: Through the upcoming fundraiser, individuals can compete for top honors, and company teams can challenge competitors.
paras.zh: 通过即将举行的筹款活动，个人可以争夺最高荣誉，公司团队可以挑战竞争对手。

paras.en: To participate, select the pledge amount per step and complete registration to receive a personalized link. Next, download the app or save the link to your personal step-tracker page. Track your steps and log them each day. Participants can check their progress daily on the leaderboard.
paras.zh: 要参与，请选择每步的承诺金额并完成注册以接收个性化链接。接下来，下载应用程序或将链接保存到您的个人步数跟踪器页面。跟踪您的步数并每天记录下来。参与者可以每天在排行榜上查看自己的进度。

paras.en: At the end of the week, tally your final steps and complete your donation. All donations are tax-deductible. The winners will be announced at that time. Top performers will win prizes. Sponsorship opportunities are also available.
paras.zh: 在周末，统计您的最后步骤并完成您的捐赠。所有捐款均可免税。获奖者名单将于届时公布。表现最好的人将赢得奖品。还提供赞助机会。

paras.en: “The collision repair industry has always generously supported our efforts to give back to those in need, and we wanted to provide a new, unique way for them to be involved in helping veterans, military members, families, and first responders,” said Tom Wolf, NABC Board of Directors chairman, in a press release. “Everyone attending the Las Vegas event is already logging their steps and sharing their daily data with their colleagues, so this is a creative way to capture their enthusiasm and efforts for a good cause.”
paras.zh: NABC 董事会主席汤姆·沃尔夫 (Tom Wolf) 在一份新闻稿中表示：“碰撞修复行业一直慷慨支持我们回馈有需要的人的努力，我们希望为他们提供一种新的、独特的方式来参与帮助退伍军人、军人、家庭和急救人员。” “参加拉斯维加斯活动的每个人都已经记录了他们的步数并与同事分享了他们的日常数据，因此这是一种创造性的方式来捕捉他们的热情和为美好事业所做的努力。”

articles.title: Snap-on ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go Workstation
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: Snap-on introduces the ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go workstation, a portable hard case designed to help technicians safely transport their ZEUS+ scan tool and accessories throughout the repair shop, from shop to shop or for roadside recovery — all in one convenient package.
paras.zh: 实耐宝推出 ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go 工作站，这是一款便携式硬箱，旨在帮助技术人员在整个维修店、从一家商店到另一家商店或路边恢复时安全地运输其 ZEUS+ 扫描工具和配件 - 所有这些都在一个方便的包装中。

paras.en: “The new ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go workstation makes it easy for technicians to safely move their equipment around the repair shop where a cart won’t fit or take their scan tool and accessories on the road,” said Helen Cox, marketing and client services director, Snap-on Diagnostics. “It brings diagnostic capabilities together in a durable, mobile package to help technicians keep their equipment organized, protected and ready to go wherever the job takes them.”
paras.zh: Snap-on Diagnostics 营销和客户服务总监 Helen Cox 表示：“新的 ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go 工作站让技术人员能够轻松地在无法容纳手推车的维修店周围安全地移动设备，或者在路上携带扫描工具和配件。” “它将诊断功能整合到一个耐用的移动包中，帮助技术人员保持设备井井有条、受到保护，并随时准备好前往任何工作地点。”

paras.en: The new ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go features a rugged, heavy-duty custom case with two carry handles, a telescopic handle and wheels for easy mobility. The case also includes a built-in 22-inch touchscreen monitor and three PRO-FI foam storage dividers. The foam inserts keep all the oscilloscope accessories needed to operate the ZEUS+ to its full capacity organized and protected. An additional foam insert between the scan tool and the monitor can also serve as a sunshade when working in direct sunlight.
paras.zh: 新款 ZEUS+ Grab N’ Go 采用坚固耐用的定制箱子，配有两个提手、一个伸缩手柄和方便移动的轮子。该保护套还包括一个内置 22 英寸触摸屏显示器和三个 PRO-FI 泡沫存储隔板。泡沫衬垫可将 ZEUS+ 充分发挥其功能所需的所有示波器配件组织起来并受到保护。当在阳光直射下工作时，扫描工具和显示器之间的附加泡沫插入物也可以充当遮阳罩。

paras.en: With exclusive Fast-Track Intelligent Diagnostics, ZEUS+ helps simplify the diagnostic workflow by guiding technicians through each step, from start to finish, with the information needed to diagnose, repair and manage vehicle issues while avoiding unnecessary steps. With its robust design, ZEUS+ offers an intuitive user experience, advanced hardware and communication tools to help technicians stay connected with online resources and to their customers. ZEUS+ increases efficiency by providing maximum functionality in a single diagnostic platform.
paras.zh: 凭借独有的 Fast-Track 智能诊断，ZEUS+ 指导技术人员从开始到结束的每个步骤，并提供诊断、维修和管理车辆问题所需的信息，同时避免不必要的步骤，从而帮助简化诊断工作流程。凭借其稳健的设计，ZEUS+ 提供直观的用户体验、先进的硬件和通信工具，帮助技术人员与在线资源及其客户保持联系。 ZEUS+ 通过在单一诊断平台中提供最大功能来提高效率。

paras.en: To learn more, visit www.snapon.com/diagnostics or talk to a Snap-on franchisee or other Snap-on sales representative.
paras.zh: 要了解更多信息，请访问 www.snapon.com/diagnostics 或与 Snap-on 特许经营商或其他 Snap-on 销售代表联系。

articles.title: NAPA Apprentice Program Builds a New Path Into the Service Bay
articles.author: NAPA

paras.en: As repair shops across the country struggle to recruit qualified technicians, the NAPA Auto Care Apprentice Program offers participating businesses a structured way to develop new talent inside their own service bays.
paras.zh: 由于全国各地的维修店都在努力招募合格的技术人员，NAPA 汽车护理学徒计划为参与的企业提供了一种结构化的方法，以在自己的维修站内培养新人才。

paras.en: More than 700 NAPA Auto Care centers nationwide participate in the program, which combines technical education, hands-on experience and mentorship. Its mission is to educate and cultivate the next generation of automotive repair professionals by providing a broad learning experience that combines online and classroom training.
paras.zh: 全国 700 多个 NAPA 汽车护理中心参与了该计划，该计划结合了技术教育、实践经验和指导。其使命是通过提供结合在线和课堂培训的广泛学习经验来教育和培养下一代汽车维修专业人员。

paras.en: For shop owners, the program offers an alternative to waiting for experienced technicians to appear in an increasingly competitive labor market. A participating shop can identify someone with the right attitude and work ethic, then help that person build technical skills through a defined training path.
paras.zh: 对于店主来说，该计划提供了一种替代方案，让他们无需等待经验丰富的技术人员出现在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中。参与的商店可以识别具有正确态度和职业道德的人员，然后通过明确的培训路径帮助该人员培养技术技能。

paras.en: “NAPA is committed to finding solutions that address the national shortage of skilled automotive technicians,” said Jason Rainey, vice president of Auto Care. “Our apprenticeship program is one of several key NAPA initiatives that help pave the way for young people to launch long and fruitful careers in our industry.”
paras.zh: Auto Care 副总裁 Jason Rainey 表示：“NAPA 致力于寻找解决方案，解决全国熟练汽车技术人员短缺的问题。” “我们的学徒计划是 NAPA 的几项关键举措之一，有助于为年轻人在我们行业开展长期且富有成果的职业生涯铺平道路。”

paras.en: The NAPA Apprentice Program uses a nine-stage curriculum designed to give participants a broad understanding of the systems and components found on modern vehicles. Most apprentices can complete the program in two years or less.
paras.zh: NAPA 学徒计划采用九阶段课程，旨在让参与者广泛了解现代车辆上的系统和组件。大多数学徒可以在两年或更短的时间内完成该计划。

paras.en: However, the curriculum is competency-based rather than tied strictly to a calendar. Apprentices can progress through each stage at a pace that matches their learning style and demonstrated abilities. A participant who quickly masters a subject can move forward, while someone who needs additional practice can spend more time developing that competency.
paras.zh: 然而，课程是基于能力的，而不是严格与日历挂钩。学徒可以按照与他们的学习风格和能力相匹配的速度完成每个阶段。快速掌握某一主题的参与者可以继续前进，而需要额外练习的参与者可以花更多的时间来发展该能力。

paras.en: Training is 100% technical and is delivered through several formats:
paras.zh: 培训 100% 是技术性的，并通过多种形式提供：

paras.en: - Classroom training videos exclusive to the Apprentice Program provide in-depth instruction from experienced master technicians.
paras.zh: - 学徒计划独有的课堂培训视频提供经验丰富的技术大师的深入指导。

paras.en: - NAPA Autotech classes offer instructor-led training taught by experienced ASE Master Certified instructors.
paras.zh: - NAPA Autotech 课程提供由经验丰富的 ASE 大师认证讲师授课的讲师指导培训。

paras.en: - Autotech eLearning provides web-based instruction targeting specific systems, procedures and diagnostic topics.
paras.zh: - Autotech eLearning 提供针对特定系统、程序和诊断主题的基于网络的指导。

paras.en: - Hands-on training allows apprentices to apply what they have learned while working in the shop under the guidance of a mentor.
paras.zh: - 实践培训允许学徒在导师的指导下在商店工作时运用所学知识。

paras.en: This combination helps connect classroom theory with real repairs. Apprentices do not just learn how a component operates; they also gain experience inspecting, testing and servicing that component on vehicles.
paras.zh: 这种结合有助于将课堂理论与实际维修联系起来。学徒不仅学习组件的工作原理，还学习组件的工作原理。他们还获得了检查、测试和维修车辆部件的经验。

paras.en: The curriculum will continue to evolve as vehicle technology and industry standards change. Planned enhancements include updated training modules and specialized certification options covering emerging service areas, giving apprentices additional opportunities for career advancement.
paras.zh: 随着车辆技术和行业标准的变化，课程将不断发展。计划的增强功能包括更新的培训模块和涵盖新兴服务领域的专业认证选项，为学徒提供更多的职业发展机会。

paras.en: Apprentices earn the work experience requirement for three Automotive Service Excellence certifications as they advance through the program: Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5). They also gain the practical know-how to pass the EPA Section 609 refrigerant recovery and recycling credential test administered through ASE.
paras.zh: 学徒在完成该计划时将获得三项卓越汽车服务认证的工作经验要求：维护和轻型维修 (G1)、悬架和转向 (A4) 以及制动器 (A5)。他们还获得了通过 ASE 管理的 EPA 第 609 节制冷剂回收和再循环证书测试的实用知识。

paras.en: That distinction is important: G1, A4 and A5 are ASE professional certifications, while Section 609 is an EPA-required credential for technicians who service motor-vehicle air-conditioning systems. Together, these credentials provide outside validation of the knowledge and skills developed during the apprenticeship.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要：G1、A4 和 A5 是 ASE 专业认证，而第 609 条是 EPA 要求的维修机动车辆空调系统的技术人员的证书。这些证书共同为学徒期间开发的知识和技能提供了外部验证。

paras.en: Because the program is registered with the U.S. Department of Labor, graduates also finish with a nationally recognized journey-level credential in automotive repair. This gives apprentices evidence of completing a structured combination of education and supervised on-the-job training.
paras.zh: 由于该项目已在美国劳工部注册，因此毕业生还可以获得全国认可的汽车维修旅程级证书。这为学徒提供了完成教育和监督在职培训的结构化组合的证据。

paras.en: The program provides the curriculum and training materials, but its success inside a repair facility depends heavily on the shop’s involvement. An apprentice needs an experienced technician who can explain procedures, demonstrate good work habits, supervise repairs and provide constructive feedback.
paras.zh: 该计划提供课程和培训材料，但其在维修厂内的成功在很大程度上取决于商店的参与。学徒需要经验丰富的技术人员来解释程序、展示良好的工作习惯、监督维修并提供建设性反馈。

paras.en: “We need their mentorship, their participation,” said Hannah Klausman, account marketing manager for Auto Care. “We want to support them by providing the materials for their technicians to go through this program, but we need their buy-in by having them provide a mentor and really put their time into taking a chance on these new technicians.”
paras.zh: “我们需要他们的指导和参与，”汽车护理公司客户营销经理汉娜·克劳斯曼 (Hannah Klausman) 说。 “我们希望通过为他们的技术人员提供完成该计划的材料来支持他们，但我们需要他们的支持，让他们提供导师，并真正投入时间来为这些新技术人员提供机会。”

paras.en: For a shop owner, that requires a real commitment. Mentoring can temporarily affect the productivity of an experienced technician, especially during an apprentice’s first months. The potential return is a technician trained around the shop’s procedures, quality standards and culture.
paras.zh: 对于店主来说，这需要真正的承诺。指导可能会暂时影响经验丰富的技术人员的工作效率，尤其是在学徒的头几个月。潜在的回报是一名接受过工厂程序、质量标准和文化培训的技术人员。

paras.en: The program can also create a clearer career ladder. Instead of hiring someone as an entry-level employee with no defined next step, a shop can show the apprentice how training, demonstrated competencies and certifications lead to greater responsibilities.
paras.zh: 该计划还可以创建更清晰的职业阶梯。商店可以向学徒展示培训、展示的能力和认证如何带来更大的责任，而不是雇用某人作为没有明确下一步的入门级员工。

paras.en: “The success of the apprentice program is a reflection not only of the investment NAPA has made but also of its collaboration with Auto Care centers across the country,” said Ryan Ouellette, director of strategic accounts at NAPA. “We are committed to developing future professionals at NAPA, and we look forward to continuing to educate and support the talent in the industry.”
paras.zh: NAPA 战略客户总监 Ryan Ouellette 表示：“学徒计划的成功不仅反映了 NAPA 的投资，也反映了其与全国各地汽车护理中心的合作。” “我们致力于在 NAPA 培养未来的专业人士，我们期待继续教育和支持该行业的人才。”

paras.en: Applicants must be at least 17 years old. Applicants who are 17 require written parental consent, and there is no maximum age.
paras.zh: 申请人必须年满 17 岁。年满 17 岁的申请人需要获得父母的书面同意，并且没有最高年龄限制。

paras.en: Previous professional repair experience is not the program’s defining qualification. Shops should look for candidates who have a positive attitude, arrive ready to work and take initiative beyond their assigned tasks.
paras.zh: 以前的专业维修经验并不是该计划的定义资格。商店应该寻找态度积极、做好工作准备、主动超越分配任务的候选人。

paras.en: Successful apprentices must also be able to build relationships. Automotive repair is increasingly collaborative, particularly when diagnostic information, specialized equipment and technical knowledge must be shared among technicians. An apprentice must be willing to ask questions, accept coaching and learn from the people around them.
paras.zh: 成功的学徒还必须能够建立关系。汽车维修的协作性日益增强，特别是当技术人员必须共享诊断信息、专业设备和技术知识时。学徒必须愿意提出问题、接受指导并向周围的人学习。

paras.en: Most importantly, candidates need to embrace continuous learning. Vehicle technology does not stand still, and neither can a technician’s education.
paras.zh: 最重要的是，候选人需要接受持续学习。汽车技术不会停滞不前，技术人员的教育也不会停滞不前。

paras.en: For aspiring technicians, the program provides an opportunity to learn the trade without taking on the expense of a traditional trade-school program. Apprentices receive a paycheck while learning in an operating repair facility, and the training itself is provided at no cost to the participant.
paras.zh: 对于有抱负的技术人员来说，该计划提供了学习该行业的机会，而无需承担传统职业学校计划的费用。学徒在运营的维修设施中学习时可以获得薪水，并且培训本身是免费向参与者提供的。

paras.en: Additional information about the program is available at NAPA Auto Care Training.
paras.zh: 有关该计划的更多信息，请访问 NAPA 汽车护理培训。

paras.en: Sidebar: Addressing the Cost of a Technician’s First Tools
paras.zh: 侧边栏：解决技术人员第一个工具的成本问题

paras.en: Tools represent one of the largest entry barriers for a new automotive technician. Even a basic professional set can require a substantial investment before the technician earns a full professional wage.
paras.zh: 工具是新汽车技术人员最大的进入障碍之一。即使是基本的专业设置也可能需要大量投资才能使技术人员获得全额专业工资。

paras.en: To help address that barrier, Carlyle Tools developed an Apprentice Set containing professional-quality tools considered essential for a new technician’s career. NAPA Auto Care makes the exclusive set, which has a stated retail value of $6,566, available for participating Auto Care centers to purchase for their apprentices.
paras.zh: 为了帮助解决这一障碍，凯雷工具开发了一套学徒套装，其中包含被认为对新技术人员职业生涯至关重要的专业品质工具。 NAPA Auto Care 生产了这套独家套装，标称零售价为 6,566 美元，可供参与的汽车护理中心为学徒购买。

paras.en: Providing or helping finance an appropriate starter set can make a shop’s apprenticeship opportunity more attractive. It also helps ensure that the apprentice begins with tools capable of withstanding daily professional use.
paras.zh: 提供或帮助资助合适的入门套件可以使商店的学徒机会更具吸引力。它还有助于确保学徒从能够承受日常专业使用的工具开始。

articles.title: Servicing Volkswagen Electronic Parking Brakes
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: The majority of Volkswagen vehicles sold in the past decade have electronic parking brakes. However, most customers don’t even realize that the vehicle has an electronic parking brake, because the system engages and disengages the parking brake automatically on most vehicles. But, when the system fails and turns on the light or has a warning in the driver information center, then the customer will notice.
paras.zh: 过去十年销售的大多数大众汽车都配备了电子驻车制动器。然而，大多数客户甚至没有意识到车辆有电子驻车制动器，因为大多数车辆上的系统会自动接合和释放驻车制动器。但是，当系统出现故障并打开灯或在驾驶员信息中心发出警告时，客户就会注意到。

paras.en: If you are doing a brake job on a vehicle with an electronic parking brake, you will need a scan tool with the proper software for the parking brake system to retract the calipers, adjust and perform diagnostics. There are no shortcuts on YouTube. You can find videos that involve removing the electric motor, jumping connectors and disassembling the parking brake mechanism. But, these methods are very risky and can damage the vehicle and kill productivity. Unapproved methods will set malfunction codes, and the worst-case scenario is that you could damage the unit.
paras.zh: 如果您要对配备电子驻车制动器的车辆进行制动作业，您将需要一个带有适合驻车制动系统软件的扫描工具，以缩回卡钳、调整和执行诊断。 YouTube 上没有捷径。您可以找到涉及拆卸电动机、跳接连接器和拆卸驻车制动机构的视频。但是，这些方法风险很大，可能会损坏车辆并降低生产力。未经批准的方法会设置故障代码，最坏的情况是您可能会损坏设备。

paras.en: The VW system that was installed on many of its platforms starting in 2004 is an example of a system that requires a scan tool to replace the rear brake pads.
paras.zh: 从 2004 年开始在其许多平台上安装的大众系统就是一个需要扫描工具来更换后刹车片的系统的例子。

paras.en: The system has stepper motors on the back of the caliper that actuate the piston. The motor can be removed from the caliper, though the ignition should be switched off for at least 30 seconds before removing the connector.
paras.zh: 该系统在卡钳背面装有步进电机，用于驱动活塞。电机可以从卡钳上拆下，但在拆下连接器之前应关闭点火装置至少 30 秒。

paras.en: The motor is sealed to the caliper with an o-ring around the spindle. The condition of this o-ring is critical for the life of the motor and should be lightly lubricated with brake fluid. If the o-ring fails, water and debris will be one step closer to the motor gears.
paras.zh: 电机通过主轴周围的 O 形圈密封至卡钳。该 O 形圈的状况对于电机的使用寿命至关重要，应使用制动液进行轻微润滑。如果 O 形圈失效，水和碎屑就会离电机齿轮更近一步。

paras.en: The spindle on the caliper can be rocked slightly with a torx bit so the motor seats in the spindle. Don’t force the motor assembly onto the caliper, because damage to the housing can occur.
paras.zh: 可以用梅花钻头稍微摇动卡尺上的主轴，以便将电机固定在主轴中。请勿将电机组件强行安装到卡钳上，因为可能会损坏外壳。

paras.en: On recent platforms, VW have outfitted the motors with a sensor that can measure brake pad wear and adjust the pads for the least amount of drag. During this adjustment on some vehicles, the pad thickness is calculated. The system counts the number of rotations of the motor with a hall effect sensor inside the unit.
paras.zh: 在最新的平台上，大众汽车为电机配备了传感器，可以测量刹车片的磨损情况并调整刹车片以获得最小的阻力。在某些车辆的调整过程中，会计算垫厚度。该系统通过装置内部的霍尔效应传感器来计算电机的转数。

paras.en: Inspecting the caliper, hardware and motors may not give you a complete picture of what is happening with these systems. Having access to a scan tool can reduce diagnostic time.
paras.zh: 检查卡钳、硬件和电机可能无法让您全面了解这些系统发生的情况。使用扫描工具可以减少诊断时间。

paras.en: The OEMs have built-in bi-directional protocols to retract the parking brake so the pads can be replaced. A dedicated brake tool or enhanced scan tool is able to command these protocols and interrogate the module for codes and faults.
paras.zh: 原始设备制造商具有内置的双向协议来缩回驻车制动器，以便更换刹车片。专用制动工具或增强型扫描工具能够命令这些协议并询问模块的代码和故障。

paras.en: The Electronic Parking Brake Module (EPBM) is the module on the CAN bus of most vehicles equipped with this system. Any missing data for vehicle speed, gear position or brake pedal input will cause a problem with the system.
paras.zh: 电子驻车制动模块 (EPBM) 是大多数配备此系统的车辆的 CAN 总线上的模块。任何车速、档位或制动踏板输入数据的缺失都会导致系统出现问题。

paras.en: Some systems use information from the electric parking brake to track shoe and pad wear. The system will count the number of turns the actuator makes or the position of the stepper motor to determine the thickness of the friction material.
paras.zh: 一些系统使用来自电动驻车制动器的信息来跟踪蹄片和刹车片的磨损情况。系统将计算执行器的转数或步进电机的位置，以确定摩擦材料的厚度。

paras.en: If you do find yourself working on a vehicle whose electronic parking brake will not disengage, the first thing to do is look at the basics. Some systems require that the doors be shut and the brake pedal depressed. Some models may even require the seat belt to be buckled. Simple items like a defective brake pedal or door switch may hinder operation. Also, in some cases, the button may be defective. On some vehicles, the operation of the switch can be verified with a scan tool.
paras.zh: 如果您确实发现自己正在维修一辆电子驻车制动器无法松开的车辆，那么首先要做的就是了解基础知识。某些系统要求关闭车门并踩下制动踏板。有些车型甚至可能需要扣上安全带。制动踏板或门开关有缺陷等简单的部件可能会妨碍操作。此外，在某些情况下，按钮可能有缺陷。在某些车辆上，可以使用扫描工具验证开关的操作。

articles.title: MEYLE to Bring Back Scholarship Fundraiser at AAPEX 2026
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: MEYLE announced that it will bring its German license plate fundraiser to raise money for Northwood University scholarships back to AAPEX 2026 (Nov. 3-5 in Las Vegas).
paras.zh: MEYLE 宣布将在 AAPEX 2026（11 月 3 日至 5 日在拉斯维加斯）举行德国车牌筹款活动，为诺斯伍德大学奖学金筹集资金。

paras.en: MEYLE will host the fundraiser at its exhibit at the show, featuring a German license plate stamping machine. Visitors can create custom MEYLE-branded plates in exchange for donations benefiting Northwood students.
paras.zh: MEYLE 将在展会上的展位上举办筹款活动，展出一台德国车牌冲压机。参观者可以制作定制的 MEYLE 品牌盘子，以换取惠及诺斯伍德学生的捐款。

paras.en: Last year’s initiative generated $9,171 in donations. MEYLE supplemented that amount with a $5,000 matching contribution, bringing the total to $14,171.
paras.zh: 去年的倡议筹集了 9,171 美元的捐款。 MEYLE 补充了 5,000 美元的配套捐款，使总额达到 14,171 美元。

paras.en: Northwood Student Receives First MEYLE Scholarship
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德学生获得首届梅尔奖学金

paras.en: Earlier this year, Quinn Balcam became the first recipient of the MEYLE scholarship. Balcam, an automotive aftermarket management major from Bloomington, Indiana, serves as president of Northwood’s student aftermarket club.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，奎因·巴尔卡姆（Quinn Balcam）成为第一位获得梅尔奖学金的人。巴尔卡姆是来自印第安纳州布卢明顿的汽车售后市场管理专业学生，担任诺斯伍德学生售后市场俱乐部的主席。

paras.en: MEYLE notes that Balcam has demonstrated his industry commitment through multiple internships and leadership in the Northwood University International Auto Show’s aftermarket division. He has also participated in events including AAPEX, SEMA and Heavy-Duty Aftermarket Week.
paras.zh: MEYLE 指出，Balcam 通过在诺斯伍德大学国际汽车展售后市场部门的多次实习和领导，展示了他的行业承诺。他还参加了 AAPEX、SEMA 和重型售后市场周等活动。

paras.en: “Seeing the funds raised at AAPEX translate into scholarship support for a student like Quinn illustrates why partnerships like this are so important,” said James O’Dell, director of aftermarket education at Northwood University. “The automotive aftermarket needs talented, motivated young professionals, and MEYLE is helping our students gain both the financial support and industry connections they need to succeed.”
paras.zh: 诺斯伍德大学售后教育总监詹姆斯·奥戴尔 (James O'Dell) 表示：“看到 AAPEX 筹集的资金转化为对 Quinn 这样的学生的奖学金支持，这说明了为什么这样的合作伙伴关系如此重要。” “汽车售后市场需要有才华、积极进取的年轻专业人士，MEYLE 正在帮助我们的学生获得成功所需的财务支持和行业联系。”

articles.title: Automotive Parts Services Group CEO Jeff Koviak on Multiplying Successes
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Jeff Koviak, CEO of the Automotive Parts Services Group. In this interview, Koviak said he views industry consolidation as an inevitable evolution that can ultimately make the independent aftermarket stronger and more competitive. Rather than becoming “distracted by the noise,” he believes Automotive Parts Services Group members should remain focused on running their businesses and getting their parts through the supply chain and installed onto cars.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是汽车零部件服务集团首席执行官杰夫·科维亚克 (Jeff Koviak)。在接受采访时，科维亚克表示，他认为行业整合是一种不可避免的演变，最终可以使独立售后市场变得更强大、更具竞争力。他认为，汽车零部件服务集团成员不应“被噪音分散注意力”，而应继续专注于经营自己的业务，让零部件通过供应链并安装到汽车上。

paras.en: Koviak sees consolidation creating stronger organizations through investment and greater efficiencies, helping the independent aftermarket compete more effectively with OEM service centers.
paras.zh: Koviak 认为，整合可以通过投资和提高效率创建更强大的组织，帮助独立售后市场更有效地与 OEM 服务中心竞争。

paras.en: Koviak said collaboration and shared innovation represent one of The Group’s greatest opportunities to help members grow while preserving their entrepreneurial spirit. His focus as CEO includes bringing members together through collaborative workshops where they can exchange best practices and learn from one another. While building trust takes time, Koviak added that members are increasingly recognizing the value of working together. He believes closer collaboration can multiply growth opportunities and strengthen The Group and its members.
paras.zh: Koviak 表示，协作和共享创新是集团帮助成员成长并同时保持创业精神的最佳机会之一。作为首席执行官，他的重点包括通过协作研讨会将成员聚集在一起，让他们交流最佳实践并相互学习。科维亚克补充说，虽然建立信任需要时间，但成员们越来越认识到合作的价值。他相信更紧密的合作可以增加增长机会并增强集团及其成员的实力。

paras.en: Koviak also sees data and technology as critical competitive advantages. The Group is investing in IT best-practices workshops and industry technology initiatives to identify cost-saving opportunities and share innovative approaches across its membership. Koviak said The Group’s extensive North American DIFM market data can help members optimize inventory and make smarter business decisions while supporting closer collaboration with supplier partners on supply chain needs. Ultimately, the goal is to maximize that data to improve product availability and get the right parts where they are needed.
paras.zh: Koviak 还将数据和技术视为关键的竞争优势。该集团正在投资 IT 最佳实践研讨会和行业技术计划，以确定节省成本的机会并在其成员中分享创新方法。 Koviak表示，集团广泛的北美DIFM市场数据可以帮助会员优化库存并做出更明智的业务决策，同时支持与供应商合作伙伴就供应链需求进行更密切的合作。最终的目标是最大限度地利用这些数据，以提高产品可用性并在需要的地方获得正确的零件。

paras.en: To hear more of Koviak’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Koviak 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How Koviak views consolidation as an opportunity to strengthen the independent aftermarket and its competitive position. (5:08)
paras.zh: - Koviak 如何将整合视为加强独立售后市场及其竞争地位的机会。 (5:08)

paras.en: - How greater collaboration and shared best practices can help The Group’s members grow while maintaining their entrepreneurial strengths. (7:15)
paras.zh: - 加强合作和共享最佳实践如何帮助集团成员成长，同时保持其创业优势。 （7:15）

paras.en: - How The Group is investing in data and technology to improve decision-making, inventory optimization and supply chain collaboration. (8:59)
paras.zh: - 集团如何投资数据和技术来改善决策、库存优化和供应链协作。 （8:59）

paras.en: - The value of APSG membership conferences and key takeaways of this type of collaboration. (10:56)
paras.zh: - APSG 会员会议的价值以及此类合作的要点。 （10:56）

paras.zh: - 闪电回合：Koviak 分享了一些个人见解。 (13:59)

articles.title: Why Are Cabin Air Filters Electrically Charged?
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: In the second episode of our new series, That’s Not a Stupid Question, our topic is: Why are cabin air filters electrically charged?
paras.zh: 在我们新系列的第二集中，这不是一个愚蠢的问题，我们的主题是：为什么机舱空气过滤器带电？

paras.en: Some are, some aren’t, and we get into why that is. Watch the video above for more.
paras.zh: 有些是，有些不是，我们将了解其中的原因。观看上面的视频了解更多信息。

paras.en: EV lockout tagout procedures help technicians safely service high-voltage electric vehicle systems. Unlike gasoline vehicles, where disconnecting the 12-volt battery may be enough, EVs can operate at more than 400 volts. Some systems can reach 800 volts.
paras.zh: 电动汽车上锁挂牌程序可帮助技术人员安全地维修高压电动汽车系统。与汽油车不同，断开 12 伏电池就足够了，电动汽车可以在 400 伏以上的电压下运行。有些系统可以达到 800 伏。

paras.en: Accidentally energizing one of these circuits can have catastrophic consequences. For that reason, many EV manufacturers require a lockout tagout, or LOTO, procedure before technicians service high-voltage components.
paras.zh: 意外地给这些电路之一通电可能会带来灾难性的后果。因此，许多电动汽车制造商在技术人员维修高压部件之前都需要上锁挂牌（LOTO）程序。

articles.title: How Brake-Based Traction Control Helps AWD
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Many all-wheel-drive (AWD) systems reached the market during the 1990s, as the SUV boom gave automakers an opportunity to sell profitable light trucks. Many early SUVs used transfer cases, limited-slip or locking differentials, and locking hubs adapted from the automakers’ truck platforms. As buyers began asking for four-wheel-drive capability in smaller, more fuel-efficient vehicles, automakers developed lighter AWD systems for passenger cars and crossovers.
paras.zh: 许多全轮驱动 (AWD) 系统在 20 世纪 90 年代进入市场，SUV 的繁荣给汽车制造商提供了销售有利可图的轻型卡车的机会。许多早期的 SUV 使用分动箱、限滑或锁止差速器以及源自汽车制造商卡车平台的锁止轮毂。随着买家开始要求更小、更省油的车辆具有四轮驱动能力，汽车制造商为乘用车和跨界车开发了更轻的全轮驱动系统。

paras.en: Sending power to all four wheels is possible with either a longitudinal or transverse engine. A transverse layout can send power from the transaxle through a power takeoff unit and driveshaft to the rear axle. Depending on the design, the system may use a center differential, a coupling, or another device to manage the front-to-rear torque distribution. One feature these systems may lack, compared with traditional four-wheel-drive hardware, is a mechanical differential lock or limited-slip differential.
paras.zh: 使用纵向或横向发动机可以向所有四个车轮发送动力。横向布局可以将动力从变速驱动桥通过动力输出装置和驱动轴传送至后轴。根据设计，系统可能使用中央差速器、联轴器或其他设备来管理前后扭矩分配。与传统的四轮驱动硬件相比，这些系统可能缺乏的一项功能是机械差速锁或限滑差速器。

paras.en: Engineers found another way to improve traction: use the ABS hardware to apply a brake at a slipping wheel. This brake-based traction control can make an open differential behave somewhat like a limited-slip differential in low-traction conditions.
paras.zh: 工程师找到了另一种提高牵引力的方法：使用 ABS 硬件对打滑的车轮进行制动。这种基于制动的牵引力控制可以使开式差速器在低牵引力条件下表现得有点像限滑差速器。

paras.en: An open differential allows the drive wheels to turn at different speeds while cornering. The ring gear turns the differential case, which carries small spider gears. Those gears mesh with side gears connected to the axle shafts. An open differential delivers similar torque to both axle shafts, but the torque available is limited by the wheel with less grip. If one tire is on a slippery surface, it can spin while the other tire receives too little torque to move the vehicle effectively.
paras.zh: 开放式差速器允许驱动轮在转弯时以不同的速度转动。环形齿轮转动差速器壳，差速器壳带有小星形齿轮。这些齿轮与连接到车轴的侧齿轮啮合。开放式差速器向两个车轴提供相似​​的扭矩，但可用扭矩受到抓地力较小的车轮的限制。如果一个轮胎位于光滑的表面上，它可能会打滑，而另一个轮胎接收的扭矩太小而无法有效地移动车辆。

paras.en: Brake-based traction control addresses this by applying the brake at the spinning wheel. The added resistance creates a reaction torque through the differential, allowing more usable torque to reach the wheel with better grip. The system does not lock the differential mechanically, but it can produce a limited-slip effect. Some AWD systems also use brake control to manage wheelspin across the front and rear axles; the exact strategy depends on the vehicle’s driveline and control system.
paras.zh: 基于制动的牵引力控制通过在旋转的车轮上施加制动来解决这个问题。增加的阻力通过差速器产生反作用扭矩，从而使更多可用扭矩以更好的抓地力到达车轮。该系统不会机械锁定差速器，但可以产生限滑效果。一些全轮驱动系统还使用制动控制来管理前轴和后轴的车轮打滑；确切的策略取决于车辆的传动系统和控制系统。

paras.en: The system makes quick adjustments based on wheel-speed signals. Depending on the vehicle, it may apply the brakes, reduce engine torque, or use both strategies to control wheelspin. Some drivers may feel or hear the brakes operating during a traction event. On some vehicles, limited brake-based traction functions remain active even when the driver switches off part of the stability-control system.
paras.zh: 该系统根据轮速信号进行快速调整。根据车辆的不同，它可能会施加制动，降低发动机扭矩，或同时使用这两种策略来控制车轮打滑。一些驾驶员可能会在牵引事件期间感觉到或听到制动器正在操作。在某些车辆上，即使驾驶员关闭部分稳定性控制系统，基于制动的有限牵引功能仍保持活动状态。

paras.en: Brake-based traction control has limits compared with a four-wheel-drive system equipped with mechanically locking differentials. Brake application creates heat, and traction may be reduced if the system reaches its operating limits. Still, for drivers who encounter snow, mud, or other slippery conditions occasionally, the system can make a substantial difference.
paras.zh: 与配备机械锁定差速器的四轮驱动系统相比，基于制动的牵引力控制具有局限性。制动时会产生热量，如果系统达到其运行极限，牵引力可能会降低。尽管如此，对于偶尔遇到雪、泥或其他湿滑状况的驾驶员来说，该系统可以发挥很大的作用。

paras.en: These systems do not have differential clutches that require service, but brake-based traction control adds activity to the brakes and ABS hydraulic control unit. Follow the manufacturer’s brake-fluid specification and service interval. Some vehicles require a low-viscosity DOT 4 fluid so the hydraulic system can respond as designed; use it only when specified for that application.
paras.zh: 这些系统没有需要维修的差速离合器，但基于制动器的牵引力控制增加了制动器和 ABS 液压控制单元的活动。遵循制造商的制动液规格和保养周期。有些车辆需要低粘度 DOT 4 液压油，以便液压系统能够按照设计做出响应；仅当为该应用程序指定时才使用它。

paras.en: Replacement brake pads should perform similarly to the original pads across the operating temperature range. A pad with different friction behavior may affect braking response and the system’s ability to control wheelspin.
paras.zh: 在工作温度范围内，替换刹车片的性能应与原始刹车片类似。具有不同摩擦行为的刹车片可能会影响制动响应和系统控制车轮打滑的能力。

paras.en: Wheel-speed sensors are another service consideration. If a sensor or its circuit provides an inaccurate signal, the system may limit its operation or disable traction-control functions. That can reduce the vehicle’s ability to manage wheelspin in snow, mud or ice. Check for ABS and traction-control codes, inspect the sensor wiring and tone or encoder rings, and verify wheel-speed data before condemning a sensor.
paras.zh: 轮速传感器是另一个服务考虑因素。如果传感器或其电路提供不准确的信号，系统可能会限制其操作或禁用牵引力控制功能。这会降低车辆在雪、泥或冰中控制车轮打滑的能力。检查 ABS 和牵引力控制代码，检查传感器接线和音调或编码器环，并在报废传感器之前验证轮速数据。

articles.title: Goodyear Names Jerome Rouquet Chief Financial Officer
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co. announced that Jerome Rouquet will join the company as chief financial officer (CFO), effective Dec. 1, 2026. He will report to CEO Mark Stewart and serve on the company’s senior leadership team.
paras.zh: 固特异轮胎橡胶公司 (Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.) 宣布，Jerome Rouquet 将加入公司担任首席财务官 (CFO)，自 2026 年 12 月 1 日起生效。他将向首席执行官马克·斯图尔特 (Mark Stewart) 汇报工作，并在公司高级领导团队中任职。

paras.en: Goodyear Appoints Experienced Finance Executive
paras.zh: 固特异任命经验丰富的财务主管

paras.en: Rouquet is an experienced global finance executive with extensive expertise in the automotive industry. He currently serves as CFO of Visteon Corp., where he leads the company’s global financial activities.
paras.zh: Rouquet 是一位经验丰富的全球财务高管，在汽车行业拥有丰富的专业知识。他目前担任伟世通公司的首席财务官，领导公司的全球财务活动。

paras.en: Before joining Visteon in 2020, he held senior finance leadership positions at Tenneco and Federal-Mogul. His roles at Federal-Mogul included CFO, chief accounting officer and controller.
paras.zh: 在 2020 年加入伟世通之前，他曾在天纳克和辉门担任高级财务领导职务。他在辉门的职位包括首席财务官、首席会计官和财务总监。

paras.en: “This is an important addition to our leadership team,” said Mark Stewart. “Jerome combines deep financial expertise with a proven ability to help organizations improve performance and navigate transformation. As we continue building momentum and executing our long-term strategy, his leadership and experience will help position Goodyear for success.”
paras.zh: “这是我们领导团队的重要补充，”马克·斯图尔特说。 “杰罗姆将深厚的财务专业知识与久经考验的能力相结合，帮助组织提高绩效并引导转型。随着我们继续积蓄动力并执行我们的长期战略，他的领导力和经验将帮助固特异取得成功。”

paras.en: Rouquet Brings Financial Strategy Experience
paras.zh: Rouquet带来财务策略经验

paras.en: Rouquet has broad experience in financial strategy, operational performance, investor relations and public-company finance. His appointment aligns with Goodyear’s strategy to drive shareholder value through operational improvement, financial discipline and prudent capital allocation.
paras.zh: Rouquet 在财务战略、运营绩效、投资者关系和上市公司财务方面拥有丰富的经验。他的任命符合固特异通过运营改进、财务纪律和审慎资本配置来提升股东价值的战略。

paras.en: Rouquet holds a master’s degree in business and management from Institut Supérieur de Gestion in Paris. He also completed the International Business Management Program at the Manhattan Institute of Management in New York.
paras.zh: Rouquet 拥有巴黎高等管理学院商业和管理硕士学位。他还完成了纽约曼哈顿管理学院的国际商业管理课程。

paras.en: Scott Deakin, who has served as interim CFO, will continue in the role until Rouquet joins the company. He will also support the leadership transition.
paras.zh: 曾担任临时首席财务官的斯科特·迪肯 (Scott Deakin) 将继续担任该职务，直至鲁凯加入公司。他还将支持领导层过渡。

articles.title: MANN-FILTER Wins 2027 German Design Award
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: MANN-FILTER has won the German Design Award 2027, following its previous win in 2026. The company’s “Better cabin air filters. Made easy.” campaign won in the “Excellent Communications Design – Integrated Campaigns and Advertising” category.
paras.zh: 曼牌滤清器继 2026 年获奖后，再次荣获 2027 年德国设计奖。该公司的“更好的机舱空气滤清器。变得简单”。该活动荣获“优秀传播设计——综合活动和广告”类别。

paras.en: The campaign highlights selected FreciousPlus cabin air filters that use recycled coconut-based activated carbon.
paras.zh: 该活动重点介绍了使用回收椰子活性炭的精选 FreciousPlus 车内空气过滤器。

paras.en: MANN-FILTER Campaign Highlights Sustainable Materials
paras.zh: 曼牌滤清器活动强调可持续材料

paras.en: Campaign ambassador Sammy the Squirrel helps explain the technical topic and draws attention to the more sustainable material solution. MANN-FILTER introduced Sammy last year alongside its lignin campaign. He has since become a recognizable feature of the brand’s sustainability campaigns.
paras.zh: 活动大使松鼠萨米帮助解释技术主题并提请人们关注更可持续的材料解决方案。曼牌滤清器去年在推出木质素系列产品的同时推出了 Sammy。此后，他已成为该品牌可持续发展活动中的一个知名人物。

paras.en: The campaign uses a clean design and the brand’s signature yellow across digital channels, websites, trade magazines and trade shows.
paras.zh: 该活动在数字渠道、网站、贸易杂志和贸易展览中采用了简洁的设计和品牌标志性的黄色。

paras.en: “We are very pleased to receive this award once again,” says Mario Milinovic, MANN-FILTER brand manager. “It shows that technical innovation and responsible use of materials can be communicated clearly and attentively. Our campaign brings the product idea to a simple point while remaining unmistakably MANN-FILTER. With our creative agency FACT from Kirchheim/Teck, we have a partner at our side who understands our brand and effectively presents ideas. We would like to thank the entire team for this.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴再次获得这一奖项，”曼牌滤清器品牌经理 Mario Milinovic 说道。 “这表明，技术创新和负责任地使用材料可以清晰、专注地传达出来。我们的活动将产品理念变得简单，同时又保持了曼牌滤清器的鲜明特色。通过我们来自 Kirchheim/Teck 的创意机构 FACT，我们身边有一位合作伙伴，他了解我们的品牌并有效地提出想法。为此，我们要感谢整个团队。”

paras.en: Recycled Activated Carbon Maintains Filtration Performance
paras.zh: 回收活性炭保持过滤性能

paras.en: MANN-FILTER reprocesses and reuses activated carbon from production residues generated during its cabin air filter manufacturing process. The company uses the recovered material in selected FreciousPlus cabin air filters.
paras.zh: 曼牌滤清器对空调滤清器制造过程中产生的生产残留物中的活性炭进行再加工和再利用。该公司将回收的材料用于选定的 FreciousPlus 车内空气过滤器。

paras.en: The recovered activated carbon replaces some of the new activated carbon traditionally used in these filters. This approach conserves natural raw materials and supports material recycling without changing filtration performance, quality or service life.
paras.zh: 回收的活性炭取代了这些过滤器中传统使用的一些新活性炭。这种方法可以节省天然原材料并支持材料回收，而不会改变过滤性能、质量或使用寿命。

paras.en: The campaign slogan “Better cabin air filters. Made easy.” emphasizes simplicity and practical benefits for workshops, retailers and vehicle owners. The campaign combines information about sustainable materials with straightforward messaging and distinctive design.
paras.zh: 活动口号是“更好的机舱空气过滤器。变得简单。”强调简单性和对车间、零售商和车主的实际好处。该活动将有关可持续材料的信息与简单的信息和独特的设计结合起来。

paras.en: The German Design Award recognized the campaign’s combination of relevant content, clear communication and design.
paras.zh: 德国设计奖表彰了该活动将相关内容、清晰的沟通和设计相结合。

paras.en: “Good communication makes complex topics easy to understand,” Milinovic adds. “Sammy gives the campaign a strong visual anchor. In this way, we are drawing attention to a product innovation that works seamlessly in everyday life.”
paras.zh: “良好的沟通使复杂的话题变得容易理解，”米利诺维奇补充道。 “Sammy 为该活动提供了强大的视觉锚点。通过这种方式，我们将人们的注意力吸引到日常生活中无缝运作的产品创新上。”

paras.en: Workshops and distributors will not need to change their existing processes. The filters remain available as standard production products, with no additional part numbers or logistics changes required.
paras.zh: 车间和经销商不需要改变他们现有的流程。过滤器仍可作为标准生产产品使用，无需额外的零件编号或物流变更。

paras.en: The German Design Council presents the German Design Award annually. The international competition recognizes projects for their design quality, innovation and relevance.
paras.zh: 德国设计委员会每年颁发德国设计奖。这项国际竞赛表彰项目的设计质量、创新性和相关性。

articles.title: Parts Authority Names Danielle Rickerson Senior Vice President
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Parts Authority, national distributor of automotive replacement parts, tools, and equipment, announced the promotion of Danielle Rickerson to senior vice president of marketing & communications. In this expanded role, Rickerson will provide executive oversight of the company’s marketing and communications functions, with a focus on strengthening the Parts Authority brand and aligning marketing initiatives with the company’s broader commercial and growth objectives, the company said.
paras.zh: 汽车更换零件、工具和设备的全国分销商 Parts Authority 宣布晋升 Danielle Rickerson 为营销与传播高级副总裁。该公司表示，在这一扩大的职位上，里克森将对公司的营销和传播职能进行行政监督，重点是加强 Parts Authority 品牌，并使营销举措与公司更广泛的商业和增长目标保持一致。

paras.en: Rickerson brings more than two decades of experience in the automotive aftermarket, with leadership experience spanning sales, marketing, communications, and commercial strategy. Throughout her career, she has built a strong track record of driving growth, developing teams, and connecting strategic marketing initiatives to measurable business results.

articles.title: What About the Scratch?
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Vehicle scratch repairs depend on the depth of the damage. Counter professionals can recommend polishing compounds and buffing pads for minor clear-coat scratches. Deeper scratches that penetrate the base coat require touch-up paint and clear coat.
paras.zh: 车辆划痕修复取决于损坏的深度。柜台专业人士可以推荐抛光剂和抛光垫来处理轻微的透明涂层划痕。穿透底漆的较深划痕需要补漆和清漆。

paras.en: For more extensive repairs, customers may need 2,000-grit sandpaper and progressively finer polishing pads. Caution customers against machine polishing near edges.
paras.zh: 对于更广泛的维修，客户可能需要 2,000 目砂纸和越来越细的抛光垫。提醒客户不要对边缘附近进行机器抛光。

articles.title: Dayco Expands Radiator Hose Line With 283 New Parts
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Dayco is expanding its radiator hose line in response to key market indicators and growing demand. The company supplies engine products and drive systems to the automotive, industrial and aftermarket industries. The expansion will introduce 283 new hoses for complex vehicle applications.
paras.zh: Dayco正在扩大其散热器软管生产线，以应对关键市场指标和不断增长的需求。该公司为汽车、工业和售后市场行业提供发动机产品和驱动系统。此次扩建将为复杂车辆应用引入283种新软管。

paras.en: Dayco Targets 90% Radiator Hose Coverage
paras.zh: Dayco 的目标是散热器软管覆盖率达到 90%

paras.en: The expansion will increase Dayco’s radiator hose coverage to 90% of vehicles in operation (VIO) by March 2027. That represents a 20% increase since 2025. Dayco will make 66 applications available in November and another 40 by year-end. The company will launch the remaining applications by the end of the first quarter of 2027.
paras.zh: 此次扩建将使 Dayco 的散热器软管覆盖率在 2027 年 3 月之前达到运营车辆 (VIO) 的 90%。这意味着自 2025 年以来增加了 20%。Dayco 将在 11 月提供 66 个应用程序，到年底将提供 40 个应用程序。该公司将于 2027 年第一季度末推出剩余的应用程序。

paras.en: The new part numbers include simple and branched hoses that meet stringent original equipment specifications for fit, form and function.
paras.zh: 新零件号包括简单软管和分支软管，符合严格的原始设备规格、形状和功能。

paras.en: Industry trends helped drive Dayco’s hose line expansion. These include more vehicles approaching cooling system maintenance intervals. Today’s downsized turbocharged and high-performance engines also place greater demands on cooling systems and surrounding components.
paras.zh: 行业趋势帮助推动了 Dayco 软管生产线的扩张。其中包括更多车辆接近冷却系统维护间隔。当今的小型涡轮增压和高性能发动机也对冷却系统和周边部件提出了更高的要求。

paras.en: “Between strong market drivers related to maintenance as well as an increase in demand, we prioritized an aggressive go-to-market strategy so we could introduce a significant number of new hose applications over the next several months,” said Jerry Reeves, head of product management for Dayco N.A. “This enables us to help our customers capture immediate market share while also enhancing our core value proposition.”
paras.zh: Dayco N.A. 产品管理主管 Jerry Reeves 表示：“在与维护相关的强劲市场驱动因素以及需求增长之间，我们优先考虑了积极的市场进入战略，以便我们可以在未来几个月内推出大量新的软管应用。这使我们能够帮助我们的客户立即占领市场份额，同时增强我们的核心价值主张。”

paras.en: Dayco’s automotive hose line includes simple and branched designs for radiators, heaters, exhaust vents, fuel systems and other applications.
paras.zh: Dayco 的汽车软管系列包括用于散热器、加热器、排气口、燃油系统和其他应用的简单和分支设计。

paras.en: The company uses EPDM compounds and other materials to manufacture hoses for transferring fluids or gases. These hoses serve applications involving corrosive substances and high-pressure environments.
paras.zh: 该公司使用 EPDM 化合物和其他材料来制造用于传输流体或气体的软管。这些软管适用于涉及腐蚀性物质和高压环境的应用。

paras.en: For more information on Dayco’s complete hose line, visit the company’s website.
paras.zh: 有关 Dayco 完整软管系列的更多信息，请访问该公司的网站。

articles.title: A woman carried a 'stone baby' in her abdomen for 3 years
articles.author: Anirban Mukhopadhyay

paras.en: The patient: A 42-year-old woman in Somaliland, Africa
paras.zh: 患者：非洲索马里兰一名42岁女性

paras.en: The symptoms: The woman went to the hospital after having three years of chronic, dull pain in her lower abdomen, as well as a growing sense of heaviness in her abdomen that had worsened in recent months.
paras.zh: 症状：该女子因下腹部慢性钝痛三年，并且腹部沉重感越来越大，近几个月来更加严重，前往医院就诊。

paras.en: When doctors reviewed her medical history, they learned that, three years earlier, she had experienced a number of symptoms that seemed to indicate a pregnancy. She recalled her abdomen growing over time and feeling "fetal movements," her doctors noted in a report of the case. Then, the movements stopped, the abdominal growth halted, and the enlargement gradually subsided. She had not sought medical care during or after this apparent pregnancy.
paras.zh: 当医生回顾她的病史时，他们了解到，三年前，她经历了许多似乎表明怀孕的症状。她的医生在一份病例报告中指出，她回忆起随着时间的推移，她的腹部逐渐变大，并感觉到“胎儿的运动”。随后，动作停止，腹部停止生长，肿大逐渐消退。在这次明显怀孕期间或之后，她没有寻求医疗护理。

paras.en: What happened next: When doctors physically examined the woman's abdomen, they found a hard, irregular mass that extended to her belly button and barely moved when they touched it. Blood tests showed mild anemia, meaning she had fewer healthy red blood cells than normal. Her white blood cell count and kidney and liver tests were normal, and a pregnancy test was negative.
paras.zh: 接下来发生了什么：当医生对这位女士的腹部进行身体检查时，他们发现一个坚硬的、不规则的肿块一直延伸到她的肚脐，当他们触摸它时几乎没有移动。血液检查显示轻度贫血，这意味着她的健康红细胞比正常人少。她的白细胞计数以及肾脏和肝脏检查均正常，妊娠试验呈阴性。

paras.en: An ultrasound revealed a calcified mass and an empty uterus. Calcification is a buildup of calcium that hardens tissue into a solid mass.
paras.zh: 超声波检查显示钙化肿块和空子宫。钙化是钙的积累，使组织硬化成固体。

paras.en: To get a better look at the mass, which occupied the woman's lower abdomen and pelvis, the doctors ordered an advanced CT scan to create a 3D model. The imaging revealed that the mass contained clearly identifiable fetal skeletal structures, including a skull, a spinal column, ribs, and arm and leg bones. The mass measured roughly 7 by 5 inches (18 by 13 centimeters).
paras.zh: 为了更好地观察占据该妇女下腹部和骨盆的肿块，医生要求进行先进的 CT 扫描以创建 3D 模型。成像显示，肿块中含有清晰可辨的胎儿骨骼结构，包括头骨、脊柱、肋骨、臂骨和腿骨。该质量大约为 7 x 5 英寸（18 x 13 厘米）。

paras.en: The diagnosis: Doctors concluded that the woman had a lithopedion, or "stone baby." The term comes from the Greek words "lithos," meaning stone, and "paidion," meaning child.
paras.zh: 诊断：医生得出结论，该妇女患有石足症，或“石婴”。该术语源自希腊语“lithos”，意思是石头，“paidion”，意思是孩子。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: In a typical pregnancy, an egg is fertilized in a fallopian tube — the structure between the ovaries and the womb — and then travels into the uterus, where it implants in the uterine lining. By contrast, lithopedions most often start as abdominal pregnancies, a type of ectopic pregnancy in which the embryo instead implants on the lining of the abdominal cavity.
paras.zh: 在典型的怀孕过程中，卵子在输卵管（卵巢和子宫之间的结构）中受精，然后进入子宫，植入子宫内膜。相比之下，石足症最常以腹部妊娠开始，这是一种宫外孕，其中胚胎植入腹腔内壁。

paras.en: There, the embryo shares the space with organs like the stomach, kidneys and appendix. These misplaced pregnancies are almost never viable and are highly life-threatening for the mother. Because the placenta attaches directly to delicate abdominal organs and blood vessels, these carry a severe risk of catastrophic internal bleeding.
paras.zh: 在那里，胚胎与胃、肾脏和阑尾等器官共享空间。这些异位妊娠几乎不可能成功，并且对母亲的生命构成极大威胁。由于胎盘直接附着在脆弱的腹部器官和血管上，因此存在发生灾难性内出血的严重风险。

paras.en: If the fetus dies at a developmental stage when it is too large for the mother's body to naturally break down and absorb, her immune system can sometimes treat the retained tissue as a foreign object. To protect the mother from inflammatory complications and infection, the body progressively deposits calcium over the fetal remains, creating a protective casing. In this case, the calcified fetus likely accounted for the woman's chronic abdominal pain and increasing sense of heaviness, her doctors concluded.
paras.zh: 如果胎儿在发育阶段死亡，此时胎儿太大，母亲的身体无法自然分解和吸收，她的免疫系统有时会将保留的组织视为异物。为了保护母亲免受炎症并发症和感染的影响，身体逐渐将钙沉积在胎儿遗体上，形成保护壳。医生得出的结论是，在这种情况下，钙化的胎儿很可能是导致该妇女出现慢性腹痛和日益增加的沉重感的原因。

paras.en: The treatment: The doctors performed abdominal surgery to completely remove the calcified fetal mass from the woman's pelvis.
paras.zh: 治疗：医生进行了腹部手术，将孕妇骨盆内钙化的胎儿肿块完全切除。

paras.en: The day after surgery, she developed a mild fever and nausea, but both resolved with treatment. She remained stable and improved during her hospital stay before being discharged in good condition.
paras.zh: 手术后第二天，她出现了轻微发烧和恶心，但均通过治疗得到缓解。她在住院期间保持稳定并有所改善，之后出院时情况良好。

paras.en: Follow-up visits over the next six months showed she had healed well, with a complete resolution of her abdominal pain.
paras.zh: 接下来六个月的随访显示她康复良好，腹痛完全消失。

paras.en: What makes this case unique: Only about 340 cases of lithopedion have been documented in the medical literature over the past 400 years, with the earliest documented in 1582.
paras.zh: 该病例的独特之处在于：过去 400 年来，医学文献中仅记录了大约 340 例石斑症病例，最早的记录是在 1582 年。

paras.en: This woman's case stands out because she was 42 years old, while many recent cases have been diagnosed in postmenopausal women. (Women typically experience menopause around 51 to 52 years old.) In these cases, the initial ectopic pregnancy occurred during the woman's childbearing years, but she unknowingly carried the calcified remains for decades before developing symptoms. For example, a 74-year old woman from India carried her "stone baby" for more than three decades. By contrast, the woman's recent case was caught after only three years.
paras.zh: 这名妇女的病例之所以引人注目，是因为她今年 42 岁，而最近的许多病例都是在绝经后妇女中诊断出来的。 （女性通常在 51 至 52 岁左右经历更年期。）在这些病例中，最初的宫外孕发生在女性的育龄期间，但她在出现症状之前不知不觉地携带了钙化残留物数十年。例如，印度一位74岁的妇女怀着她的“石头宝宝”长达三十多年。相比之下，该女子最近的案件仅在三年后就被抓获。

paras.en: The case also highlights the challenges of maternal healthcare in resource-limited settings such as Somaliland, where a lack of access to routine prenatal care and early pregnancy scans can lead to delayed diagnoses. That said, the successful use of advanced 3D imaging and complete surgical recovery demonstrate that excellent outcomes are possible even in these constrained environments, the doctors noted.
paras.zh: 该案例还凸显了索马里兰等资源有限地区孕产妇保健面临的挑战，在这些地区，缺乏常规产前护理和早期妊娠扫描可能会导致诊断延迟。医生指出，先进 3D 成像技术的成功使用和完整的手术恢复表明，即使在这些受限的环境中，也可以取得优异的结果。

paras.en: For more intriguing medical cases, check out our Diagnostic Dilemma archives.
paras.zh: 有关更多有趣的医疗案例，请查看我们的诊断困境档案。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Ali, A. M. H., Mohamed, A. O., & Ibrahim, K. J. (2026). Lithopedion Following Presumed Primary Abdominal Pregnancy in a 42-Year-Old Woman from Somaliland: A Case Report and Literature Review. International Medical Case Reports Journal, Volume 19, 1–8. https://doi.org/10.2147/imcrj.s634443
paras.zh: Ali, A. M. H.、Mohamed, A. O. 和 Ibrahim, K. J. (2026)。一名来自索马里兰的 42 岁妇女假定原发性腹部妊娠后进行 Lithopedion：病例报告和文献综述。国际医疗病例报告杂志，第 19 卷，1-8。 https://doi.org/10.2147/imcrj.s634443

paras.en: Anirban Mukhopadhyay is an independent science journalist. He holds a PhD in genetics and a master’s in computational biology and drug design. He regularly writes for The Hindu and has contributed to The Wire Science, where he conveys complex biomedical research to the public in accessible language. Beyond science writing, he enjoys creating and reading fiction that blends myth, memory, and melancholy into surreal tales exploring grief, identity, and the quiet magic of self-discovery. In his free time, he loves long walks with his dog and motorcycling across The Himalayas.
paras.zh: Anirban Mukhopadhyay 是一位独立科学记者。他拥有遗传学博士学位以及计算生物学和药物设计硕士学位。他定期为《印度教徒报》撰稿，并为《The Wire Science》撰稿，以通俗易懂的语言向公众传达复杂的生物医学研究成果。除了科学写作之外，他还喜欢创作和阅读小说，将神话、记忆和忧郁融入超现实故事中，探索悲伤、身份和自我发现的安静魔力。在空闲时间，他喜欢带着他的狗长途散步和骑摩托车穿越喜马拉雅山。

articles.title: Our extinct cousins the Denisovans had a 'distinctive' appearance, new analysis reveals
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: The enigmatic and now-extinct Denisovans of China shared traits with Neanderthals, modern humans and Homo erectus, according to a new study that looked at ancient proteins and fossils. But the Denisovans also had several unique skull traits and genetic variants that made them a distinctive ancient human group, according to the researchers — and these traits have now revealed a new face for a Denisovan man.
paras.zh: 一项对古代蛋白质和化石进行研究的新研究显示，神秘且现已灭绝的中国丹尼索瓦人与尼安德特人、现代人类和直立人有共同特征。但研究人员表示，丹尼索瓦人还拥有一些独特的头骨特征和基因变异，使他们成为一个独特的古代人类群体，而这些特征现在为丹尼索瓦人揭示了一张新面孔。

paras.en: In the study, published Oct. 21 in the journal Nature, researchers analyzed Denisovan skulls from the archaeological site of Xujiayao in northern China. The Denisovans were a group of ancient humans who lived in Asia and disappeared around 30,000 years ago. This human relative was first identified in 2010 from the DNA of a finger bone discovered in a cave in Siberia.
paras.zh: 在10月21日发表在《自然》杂志上的这项研究中，研究人员分析了来自中国北方徐家窑考古遗址的丹尼索瓦人头骨。丹尼索瓦人是一群生活在亚洲的古代人类，大约在 3 万年前就消失了。 2010 年，根据在西伯利亚一个洞穴中发现的指骨 DNA，首次鉴定出这种人类亲戚。

paras.en: The Xujiayao bones and teeth were excavated in the late 1970s, long before scientists knew about the existence of Denisovans, and were initially thought to be either Neanderthals or archaic Homo sapiens due to the shape of the fossils and their age: 138,000 to 199,000 years old.
paras.zh: 徐家窑的骨头和牙齿是在 20 世纪 70 年代末出土的，早在科学家们知道丹尼索瓦人存在之前，由于化石的形状和年龄（138,000 至 199,000 岁），最初被认为是尼安德特人或古代智人。

paras.en: But recent advances in paleoproteomics — the study of bone and tooth proteins that persist longer than DNA — have helped researchers identify Denisovan individuals due to specific genetic variants that differentiate them from other ancient human groups.
paras.zh: 但古蛋白质组学（对比 DNA 存留时间更长的骨骼和牙齿蛋白质的研究）的最新进展帮助研究人员识别了丹尼索瓦人，因为其特定的遗传变异使他们与其他古代人类群体区分开来。

paras.en: In the new study, researchers used paleoproteomic analysis on 20 remains from Xujaiyao and determined that all of them were from Denisovans. This determination then allowed the researchers to study the skull bones closely and figure out what Denisovans might have looked like.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员对徐家窑的 20 具遗骸进行了古蛋白质组学分析，确定它们全部来自丹尼索瓦人。这一决定使研究人员能够仔细研究头骨，并找出丹尼索瓦人可能的样子。

paras.en: The Xujiayao skulls had some features similar to H. erectus, the researchers wrote, including a low and wide braincase and thick cranial bones. But they also had anatomical features more similar to those of Neanderthals and modern humans, particularly in their bicuspids (the teeth between the canines and molars). The researchers also identified some unique Denisovan cranial traits. The back of the skull, for example, was more vertical and less rounded than in Neanderthals or modern humans.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道，徐家窑头骨具有一些与直立人相似的特征，包括低而宽的脑壳和厚厚的颅骨。但他们的解剖学特征也与尼安德特人和现代人类更相似，特别是他们的二尖牙（犬齿和臼齿之间的牙齿）。研究人员还发现了一些独特的丹尼索瓦人颅骨特征。例如，与尼安德特人或现代人类相比，头骨后部更加垂直，不那么圆润。

paras.en: Armed with a better understanding of Denisovan skull shape from the Xujiayao fossils, the researchers compared them with East Asian Denisovan remains that some experts have assigned to other species, such as Homo juluensis and Homo longi. But the researchers identified similarities that may preclude splitting Denisovans into different species.
paras.zh: 通过对徐家窑化石中丹尼索瓦人头骨形状的更好了解，研究人员将其与东亚丹尼索瓦人遗骸进行了比较，一些专家将这些遗骸归为其他物种，例如朱鲁人和长人。但研究人员发现了一些相似之处，这可能会阻止将丹尼索瓦人分成不同的物种。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "This unique combination of morphological traits, distinct from H. erectus, modern humans and Neanderthal-lineage hominins, supports the assignment of most members of East Asian late Middle Pleistocene archaic Homo as Denisovans," they wrote in the study. This means that Denisovans may have been one human lineage that adapted to diverse ecological zones across Asia over hundreds of thousands of years.
paras.zh: 他们在研究中写道：“这种独特的形态特征组合，不同于直立人、现代人类和尼安德特人谱系的古人类，支持将东亚中更新世晚期古人类的大多数成员归为丹尼索瓦人。”这意味着丹尼索瓦人可能是数十万年来适应亚洲不同生态区的人类谱系。

paras.en: - Enigmatic Denisovans lived by cave in what is now China for 100,000 years, rare fossils and handcrafted tools reveal
paras.zh: - 稀有化石和手工工具揭示了神秘的丹尼索瓦人在现在的中国的洞穴里生活了十万年

paras.en: - Denisovan DNA influences the immune systems of modern Oceanians — but researchers aren't sure why
paras.zh: - 丹尼索瓦人 DNA 影响现代大洋洲人的免疫系统——但研究人员不确定原因

paras.en: - 1 million-year-old skull from China holds clues to the origins of Neanderthals, Denisovans and humans
paras.zh: - 来自中国的一百万年前头骨蕴藏着尼安德特人、丹尼索瓦人和人类起源的线索

paras.en: "It is still possible that there are some other lineages that existed in East Asia during the time Denisovans are known to have existed," study co-author Qiaomei Fu, director of the Ancient DNA Laboratory at the Institute of Vertebrate Paleontology and Paleoanthropology, part of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、中国科学院古脊椎动物与古人类研究所古代DNA实验室主任付巧梅在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“在已知丹尼索瓦人存在的时期，东亚地区仍有可能存在其他一些谱系。”

paras.en: "We know from DNA that Denisovans were a very varied group genetically, which split early into different populations," Chris Stringer, a paleoanthropologist at the Natural History Museum in London who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email. "These could have developed a lot of morphological variation, which may well surprise us as the sample of fossils grows."
paras.zh: “我们从DNA中得知，丹尼索瓦人在基因上是一个非常多样化的群体，他们很早就分裂成不同的种群，”伦敦自然历史博物馆的古人类学家克里斯·斯金格（Chris Stringer）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，他没有参与这项研究。 “这些可能会产生很多形态变化，随着化石样本的增加，这很可能会让我们感到惊讶。”

paras.en: The researchers also produced a new reconstruction of what a Denisovan man might have looked like. A previous DNA study suggested that Denisovans likely had dark skin, brown hair and brown eyes. The new reconstruction shows the Denisovan looking directly at the viewer, with his low, wide braincase mostly obscured by dark hair flowing back from his massive brow ridge. There are clear similarities between the Denisovan man and Neanderthals as well as modern humans, but the Denisovan has a distinct visage all his own.
paras.zh: 研究人员还对丹尼索瓦人的外貌进行了新的重建。之前的一项 DNA 研究表明，丹尼索瓦人可能拥有深色皮肤、棕色头发和棕色眼睛。新的重建显示丹尼索瓦人直视观察者，他低矮而宽阔的脑壳大部分被从巨大眉脊向后流淌的黑发遮住。丹尼索瓦人与尼安德特人以及现代人类之间有明显的相似之处，但丹尼索瓦人有自己独特的面貌。

paras.en: Xing, S., Wu, Z., Shao, Q., Ge, J., Bennett, E. A., Rao, H., Lin, S., Zhao, Y., Liu, F., Liu, Y., Zhou, K., Feng, X., Jiangzuo, Q., & Fu, Q. (2026). The proteome of Middle Pleistocene Xujiayao and common Denisovan morphology. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11132-z
paras.zh: 兴 S.、吴 Z.、邵 Q.、葛 J.、Bennett E. A.、饶 H.、林 S.、赵 Y.、刘 F.、刘 Y.、周 K.、冯 X.、江左 Q. 和付 Q. (2026)。中更新世许家窑蛋白质组及常见丹尼索瓦人形态.自然。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11132-z

paras.zh: 通过我们的人类进化测验，看看您对早期人类了解多少！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。
