paras.en: “The anti-Netanyahu camp had an election handed to them on a silver platter, and they still lost,” Mr. Hazan said. “Israelis have sent an ambiguous message: ‘We don’t really like the current government, but we don’t see a viable alternative.’”
paras.zh: “反内塔尼亚胡阵营已经把选举交给了他们，但他们仍然失败了，”哈赞先生说。 “以色列人发出了一个模棱两可的信息：‘我们并不真正喜欢现任政府，但我们看不到可行的替代方案。’”

paras.en: Netanyahu’s coalition shrank, but he has options.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的联盟缩小了，但他有选择。

paras.en: As votes were being counted on Wednesday afternoon, Likud was poised to be the largest party in the larger of the two blocs of Jewish-led parties, meaning Mr. Netanyahu could well be given the chance to form a government, Mr. Hazan said.
paras.zh: 哈赞表示，周三下午计票时，利库德集团有望成为犹太人领导的两个政党集团中最大的政党，这意味着内塔尼亚胡很可能有机会组建政府。

paras.en: The long-serving Israeli premier may try to peel away some of Mr. Eisenkot’s putative partners in order to achieve a majority of 61 seats in Parliament. A number of them are as right-wing as he is, though all have more or less ruled out entering a Netanyahu-led government.
paras.zh: 这位长期任职的以色列总理可能会试图剥离艾森科特先生的一些假定合作伙伴，以在议会中获得 61 个席位的多数席位。他们中的一些人和他一样是右翼分子，尽管他们都或多或少地排除了加入内塔尼亚胡领导的政府的可能性。

paras.en: He could also try to form a national unity government with Mr. Eisenkot — perhaps with the assistance of President Trump, who has praised Mr. Netanyahu as a “warrior prime minister” and has made clear he wants Israel to join the United States in another round of war against Iran.
paras.zh: 他还可能尝试与艾森科特组建民族团结政府——也许会得到特朗普总统的协助。特朗普称赞内塔尼亚胡是“战士总理”，并明确表示希望以色列加入美国对伊朗的另一轮战争。

paras.en: Perhaps the most mind-bending option available to Mr. Netanyahu, given that he ran a scaremongering campaign that demonized Arab lawmakers and stoked fears of Arab voter turnout, would be to recruit an Arab party to join him in a government. He nearly did so once before, in 2022.
paras.zh: 鉴于内塔尼亚胡先生发起了一场妖魔化阿拉伯立法者并引发了对阿拉伯选民投票率的担忧的危言耸听活动，也许内塔尼亚胡先生可以采取的最令人费解的选择就是招募一个阿拉伯政党加入他的政府。此前，也就是 2022 年，他差点就做到了这一点。

paras.en: “It could very well be that they become indispensable,” said Dahlia Scheindlin, a pollster and political analyst, said of Arab lawmakers. “And Netanyahu has certainly demonstrated his willingness to do anything to stay in power.”
paras.zh: “他们很可能变得不可或缺，”民调专家兼政治分析师达丽娅·谢恩德林 (Dahlia Scheindlin) 在谈到阿拉伯立法者时说道。 “内塔尼亚胡无疑已经表明，他愿意不惜一切代价继续掌权。”

paras.en: Speaking of Jewish opposition parties in isolation ignores the fact that, when Arab parties are included, Mr. Netanyahu’s rivals appeared headed toward a significant majority in Parliament, with about 66 seats to roughly 54 for the prime minister’s bloc.
paras.zh: 孤立地谈论犹太反对党忽略了这样一个事实：如果将阿拉伯政党也包括在内，内塔尼亚胡的竞争对手似乎将在议会中占据绝大多数席位，总理集团将获得约 66 个席位，而总理集团则将获得约 54 个席位。

paras.en: “There is no need to go with the racist assumption that you need not count the Arabs,” said Gayil Talshir, a political scientist at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem who is advising the opposition.
paras.zh: 为反对派提供咨询的耶路撒冷希伯来大学政治学家盖伊尔·塔尔希尔 (Gayil Talshir) 表示：“没有必要接受种族主义假设，即不需要计算阿拉伯人。”

paras.en: That means the Knesset in effect will be controlled by the anti-Netanyahu opposition, regardless of who ends up being prime minister. If the vote breakdown roughly holds, Ms. Talshir said she expected Mr. Eisenkot and his Jewish and Arab allies to elect a new parliamentary speaker, begin repealing unpopular laws and at least try to form a government — perhaps including some combination of Arab and ultra-Orthodox lawmakers.
paras.zh: 这意味着无论谁最终成为总理，以色列议会实际上都将由反内塔尼亚胡反对派控制。塔尔希尔表示，如果投票结果大致成立，她预计艾森科特和他的犹太和阿拉伯盟友将选出一位新的议长，开始废除不受欢迎的法律，并至少尝试组建一个政府——或许包括一些阿拉伯和极端正统派议员的组合。

paras.en: “I’m not saying it’s a good scenario to take the Knesset and not be able to form the government,” Ms. Talshir said. “It’s a disaster. But this is the hand they’re dealt, and they have to play it.”
paras.zh: 塔尔希尔女士说：“我并不是说拿下议会但无法组建政府是一个好的情况。” “这是一场灾难。但这就是他们面临的局面，他们必须打好它。”

paras.en: Arab voters broke records but could face rejection.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯选民打破了记录，但可能面临拒绝。

paras.en: Tuesday’s election appears to have had many losers. Mr. Netanyahu’s support shrank and Mr. Eisenkot came up short of his goal. The ultra-Orthodox parties were projected to lose seats, according to the latest returns, and two right-wing nationalist parties failed to make gains, despite four years in which they drove the Netanyahu government’s extreme policies in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 周二的选举似乎有很多失败者。内塔尼亚胡的支持率下降，艾森科特也未能实现他的目标。根据最新的民意调查结果，极端正统派政党预计将失去席位，而两个右翼民族主义政党尽管四年来推动内塔尼亚胡政府在西岸推行极端政策，但未能取得席位。

paras.en: The biggest ostensible winners were the Arab voters who voted in record numbers. But they could well wind up the most disappointed citizens of all, if the Jewish opposition leaders prove unwilling or unable to form a majority in an alliance with the Arab parties.
paras.zh: 表面上最大的赢家是投票人数创纪录的阿拉伯选民。但如果犹太反对派领导人不愿意或无法在与阿拉伯政党的联盟中获得多数席位，他们很可能会成为最失望的公民。

paras.en: “They’re saying, ‘We believe in Israeli democracy, we believe in the system, we want to be part of the system, and we want to be treated better,’” Mr. Hazan said. “And if Netanyahu forms a government, they’ll get none of that.”
paras.zh: “他们说，‘我们相信以色列的民主，我们相信这个制度，我们希望成为这个制度的一部分，我们希望得到更好的待遇，’”哈赞先生说。 “如果内塔尼亚胡组建政府，他们将一无所获。”

paras.en: Israel’s president, Isaac Herzog, said he would not begin consulting party leaders about forming a government before next week, when he expects to receive the full official vote count. As head of state, Herzog will pick whoever he thinks has the best shot at assembling a majority in Parliament. If the first effort fails, he can ask up to two other candidates. If they also fail, new elections will be held. “We must do everything we can, certainly after yesterday, to avoid another round of elections,” Herzog said.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格表示，他不会在下周之前开始就组建政府问题与党派领导人进行磋商，预计届时将收到完整的官方计票结果。作为国家元首，赫尔佐格将挑选他认为最有可能在议会中获得多数席位的人。如果第一次尝试失败，他可以询问最多两名其他候选人。如果他们也失败，将举行新的选举。赫尔佐格说：“我们必须尽一切努力，尤其是在昨天之后，以避免另一轮选举。”

paras.en: Yakov Matzlawi, 51, who manages a men’s undergarment stall in the market in Ramla, a city near Tel Aviv, is an activist for Likud, Benjamin Netanyahu’s party. He said the right-wing voters he knows, including some critical of the prime minister and his government, were mobilized out of anxiety that the Israeli left and Arab parties would take power.
paras.zh: 51 岁的雅科夫·马茨拉维 (Yakov Matzlawi) 在特拉维夫附近城市拉姆拉的市场上经营着一个男士内衣摊位，他是本雅明·内塔尼亚胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 政党利库德集团 (Likud) 的积极分子。他说，他认识的右翼选民，包括一些批评总理及其政府的人，是出于对以色列左翼和阿拉伯政党掌权的焦虑而被动员起来的。

paras.en: “People voted against the Muslims and the secular Jews,” he said.
paras.zh: “人们投票反对穆斯林和世俗犹太人，”他说。

paras.en: Accountability for the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, attacks has been a major election issue. Many residents of the communities hit hardest by the assault said they are disappointed that many Israelis had voted to return to office Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who was in power at the time.
paras.zh: 追究哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击事件的责任一直是选举的一个重大问题。受袭击影响最严重的社区的许多居民表示，他们对许多以色列人投票支持当时执政的本杰明·内塔尼亚胡总理重返办公室感到失望。

paras.en: Nili Bar Sinai, 76, a retired social worker whose husband was killed by militants in Be’eri, a kibbutz near the Gaza border, said that she hoped opposition leaders would have the “courage to join hands with the Arab parties,” a move that could unseat Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 76 岁的退休社会工作者尼利·巴尔·西奈 (Nili Bar Sinai) 的丈夫在加沙边境附近的基布兹贝埃里 (Be’eri) 被武装分子杀害。她说，她希望反对派领导人有“勇气与阿拉伯政党联手”，此举可能会让内塔尼亚胡下台。

paras.en: For many Israelis, Tuesday’s election represents a pivotal moment for the future of their country. For Israel’s neighbors in the Middle East, the stakes look decidedly different.
paras.zh: 对于许多以色列人来说，周二的选举代表着他们国家未来的关键时刻。对于以色列的中东邻国来说，利害关系看起来截然不同。

paras.en: Few expect the election — whoever ultimately emerges as the winner — to be a turning point for the region, or to fundamentally change Israel’s security doctrine, analysts say. That doctrine, which has hardened since the Hamas-led attacks on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, includes crippling the Iranian government, occupying areas of Lebanon and Syria, and often favoring military force over diplomacy.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，很少有人预计这次选举——无论谁最终获胜——将成为该地区的转折点，或者从根本上改变以色列的安全学说。自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击以来，这一学说变得更加坚定，包括削弱伊朗政府、占领黎巴嫩和叙利亚地区，以及往往倾向于军事力量而非外交。

paras.en: While the outcome of the election is unlikely to prompt Israel to change course, it may decide how far the country is prepared to take its regional ambitions.
paras.zh: 虽然选举结果不太可能促使以色列改变路线，但它可能决定该国准备在多大程度上实现其地区野心。

paras.en: Re-election for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, backed by his far-right coalition partners, could embolden him to again escalate the war with Iran and push diplomacy with Israel’s neighbors farther out of reach, analysts said.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，在极右翼联盟伙伴的支持下，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡总理连任可能会鼓励他再次升级与伊朗的战争，并使与以色列邻国的外交更加遥不可及。

paras.en: And in both Lebanon and Syria, where Israeli forces have established and expanded military-controlled buffer zones over the past two years, a win for Mr. Netanyahu could see Israel further entrench or expand its occupation.
paras.zh: 在过去两年里，以色列军队在黎巴嫩和叙利亚建立并扩大了军事控制的缓冲区，内塔尼亚胡的胜利可能会导致以色列进一步巩固或扩大其占领。

paras.en: Even if Mr. Netanyahu’s coalition doesn’t win, many in the region do not see “any major visible strategic difference among the candidates,” said Paul Salem, a nonresident senior associate at the Center for Strategic and International Studies.
paras.zh: 战略与国际研究中心非常驻高级研究员保罗·塞勒姆表示，即使内塔尼亚胡先生的联盟没有获胜，该地区许多人也没有看到“候选人之间存在任何重大、明显的战略差异”。

paras.en: “They don’t see much difference in Israel’s forward defense that it insists on having — the occupied zones in Syria, in Lebanon, in Gaza and the West Bank that is just adding instability regionally,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“他们认为以色列坚持的前沿防御没有太大区别——叙利亚、黎巴嫩、加沙和约旦河西岸的占领区只会加剧地区不稳定。”

paras.en: The same is true of Palestinian statehood, which remains a distant prospect regardless of the election’s outcome. It has been a central issue for Israel’s neighbors and for American-led efforts to seek normalized relations between Israel and Gulf countries.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦建国也是如此，无论选举结果如何，巴勒斯坦建国仍然是一个遥远的前景。对于以色列的邻国以及以美国为首的寻求以色列与海湾国家关系正常化的努力来说，这一直是一个核心问题。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia and others have said any agreement with Israel would require the creation of a Palestinian state. But with Israeli proponents of a two-state solution now relegated to the political fringes, such a deal appears more distant than ever.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯和其他国家表示，与以色列达成的任何协议都需要建立巴勒斯坦国。但由于以色列两国解决方案的支持者现在已被置于政治边缘，这样的协议似乎比以往任何时候都更加遥远。

paras.en: In Iran, the outcome of the Israeli election could have more immediate consequence. While Israel’s animosity toward Tehran is unlikely to change regardless of who is in power, a change in leadership could alter the course of the war.
paras.zh: 在伊朗，以色列选举的结果可能会产生更直接的后果。尽管无论谁掌权，以色列对德黑兰的敌意都不太可能改变，但领导层的更迭可能会改变战争的进程。

paras.en: Ahead of the election, Mr. Netanyahu sought to energize his voter base by saying that he was the person President Trump wanted by his side to “finish the job once and for all.”
paras.zh: 选举前，内塔尼亚胡先生试图激励他的选民基础，他说他是特朗普总统希望在他身边“一劳永逸地完成任务”的人。

paras.en: Iranian officials believe a victory for Mr. Netanyahu could prolong the American-Israeli military campaign against Iran, leading to an even more protracted conflict, analysts say. And there is no clear sign among the opposition that they would seek to curtail Israel’s confrontation with Iran.
paras.zh: 分析人士称，伊朗官员认为，内塔尼亚胡的胜利可能会延长美国和以色列针对伊朗的军事行动，从而导致冲突更加旷日持久。反对派也没有明确迹象表明他们会寻求遏制以色列与伊朗的对抗。

paras.en: Israel’s current approach to Iran “poses a major threat to Iran’s security and very existence,” said Hadi Borhani, a professor of Israeli studies at the University of Tehran. “From this perspective, Netanyahu’s re-election poses a threat to Iran’s territorial integrity as a whole.”
paras.zh: 德黑兰大学以色列研究教授哈迪·博尔哈尼表示，以色列目前对伊朗的态度“对伊朗的安全和生存构成了重大威胁”。 “从这个角度来看，内塔尼亚胡的连任对伊朗的整体领土完整构成了威胁。”

paras.en: It’s nearly 8 a.m. in Israel and the outcome of Tuesday’s election is still unclear. More than 40 percent of the votes have been counted, according to the authorities, and most of the remaining ballots will be tallied within the next several hours. Then, officials will begin counting hundreds of thousands of ballots from Israeli soldiers, diplomats abroad and a few other categories of voters. That could take until Thursday.
paras.zh: 现在以色列已近上午 8 点，周二的选举结果仍不明朗。据当局称，超过 40% 的选票已经清点完毕，其余大部分选票将在接下来的几个小时内清点。然后，官员们将开始清点来自以色列士兵、驻外外交官和其他几类选民的数十万张选票。这可能需要到周四。

paras.en: Isaac Herzog, Israel’s president, has a largely ceremonial role — except after national elections, when it is his responsibility to choose a potential prime minister and then tasks that person with trying to form a government.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格(Isaac Herzog)在很大程度上扮演着仪式性的角色——全国选举之后除外，届时他有责任选择一位潜在的总理，然后责成该人组建政府。

paras.en: Since Israelis vote for a party or parties rather than an individual, the person who might lead the country is selected after the ballots are counted and parliamentary seats are allocated to parties according to their proportion of the vote. The president — who is separately elected by the Knesset, Israel’s single-chamber legislature — then convenes party leaders to hear their recommendations for prime minister before choosing someone to form a government.
paras.zh: 由于以色列人投票支持一个或多个政党而不是个人，因此可能领导国家的人是在计票后选出的，议会席位根据政党的得票比例分配给政党。总统由以色列单院立法机构以色列议会单独选举产生，然后召集各党派领导人听取他们对总理的建议，然后再选择某人组建政府。

paras.en: While the president can choose the leader of the party that won the most votes, he can also select another leader who seems more likely to assemble a coalition that can secure a vote of confidence in the Knesset.
paras.zh: 虽然总统可以选择赢得最多选票的政党的领导人，但他也可以选择另一位似乎更有可能组建联盟以确保议会获得信任票的领导人。

paras.en: In 2009, President Shimon Peres chose Benjamin Netanyahu — the current prime minister — even though his right-wing Likud party had won fewer votes than the centrist Kadima party.
paras.zh: 2009年，西蒙·佩雷斯总统选择了现任总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡，尽管他的右翼利库德集团赢得的选票少于中间派前进党。

paras.en: Early exit polls on Wednesday suggest a tight race between the far-right coalition led by Mr. Netanyahu and the center-right opposition bloc that has called for change. The opposition bloc includes the Yashar party, led by Gadi Eisenkot. But Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party appears to have received the most votes, which means he will argue that he should be selected as prime minister.
paras.zh: 周三早期的出口民意调查显示，内塔尼亚胡领导的极右翼联盟与呼吁变革的中右翼反对派集团之间存在着激烈的竞争。反对派集团包括加迪·艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党。但内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团似乎获得了最多的选票，这意味着他将主张自己应该被选为总理。

paras.en: Mr. Herzog, whose job is to stay above the political fray, is expected to face a difficult decision. He must discern whether the votes show that the majority of Israelis demanded change or if they indicated a preference for another Netanyahu government.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格的工作是远离政治纷争，预计他将面临一个艰难的决定。他必须辨别投票是否表明大多数以色列人要求变革，或者是否表明他们倾向于另一个内塔尼亚胡政府。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu’s governing coalition, the most right-wing in Israel’s history, has drawn international condemnation, heightened tensions with allies and divided Israelis. Mr. Herzog has repeatedly criticized what he has called “a terrible process of brutalization” creeping into Israeli society, citing violence by Jewish settlers in the occupied West Bank against Palestinians and the abuse of detainees in Israeli custody, which some far-right ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s coalition are accused of encouraging.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生的执政联盟是以色列历史上最右翼的联盟，它引起了国际社会的谴责，加剧了与盟友的紧张关系，并导致以色列人分裂。赫尔佐格多次批评他所称的“可怕的残酷过程”正在渗透到以色列社会，他列举了被占领的约旦河西岸犹太定居者对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为，以及虐待以色列拘留中的被拘留者的行为，内塔尼亚胡联盟中的一些极右翼部长被指控鼓励这些行为。

paras.en: The Israeli president, who can grant criminal pardons and commute sentences, has also faced pressure from President Trump, who has called on him to pardon Mr. Netanyahu as he stands trial on corruption charges. Mr. Herzog has respectfully resisted, saying that “Israel is a sovereign state governed by the rule of law.”
paras.zh: 这位可以给予刑事赦免和减刑的以色列总统也面临着来自特朗普总统的压力，特朗普呼吁他在内塔尼亚胡因腐败指控受审时赦免他。赫尔佐格先生恭敬地予以抵制，称“以色列是一个法治的主权国家。”

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu has long resisted calls for an independent commission of inquiry into the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attack on Israel that set off a devastating war in Gaza. He has also refused to take responsibility for any failures that led to the attack, angering many Israelis.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生长期以来一直拒绝成立独立调查委员会，调查 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击，这场袭击在加沙引发了一场毁灭性的战争。他还拒绝对导致袭击的任何失误承担责任，这激怒了许多以色列人。

paras.en: But if the president taps Mr. Eisenkot, a former military chief whose son was killed in the war in Gaza and who has vowed to launch a state inquiry into the 2023 attack, there is no guarantee he will succeed in forming a government. The center-right opposition bloc would need to ally with the country’s Arab parties, which appear to have secured more parliamentary seats than ever before. The bloc’s leaders have not agreed to such an alliance, while Mr. Netanyahu has effectively ruled out including Arab parties in a governing coalition.
paras.zh: 但如果总统任命艾森科特先生为代表，他的儿子在加沙战争中丧生，并誓言要对 2023 年的袭击事件展开国家调查，那么并不能保证他能成功组建政府。中右翼反对派集团需要与该国的阿拉伯政党结盟，这些政党似乎获得了比以往更多的议会席位。该集团领导人尚未同意建立这样的联盟，而内塔尼亚胡先生实际上已经排除了将阿拉伯政党纳入执政联盟的可能性。

paras.en: Both the far-right and far-left blocs face obstacles to assembling a governing majority. They would need agreements with other parties and factions that may be politically unpalatable, or even impossible.
paras.zh: 极右翼和极左翼集团在组建执政多数方面都面临障碍。他们需要与其他政党和派系达成协议，而这在政治上可能令人不快，甚至是不可能的。

paras.en: One of the most striking results from the election in Israel on Tuesday was the unusually strong showing by two leading Arab parties, whose voters turned out in record numbers to express their opposition to the government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 周二以色列选举中最引人注目的结果之一是两个主要阿拉伯政党异常强劲的表现，这两个政党的选民数量创纪录地表达了对本雅明·内塔尼亚胡总理政府的反对。

paras.en: The final results have not been announced, but a range of exit polls conducted by Israeli broadcasters suggest that two of the parties — the socially conservative United Arab List, or Raam, and the left-wing Joint List — may have won a historically large number of seats in parliament and an important role in the formation of the country’s next government.
paras.zh: 最终结果尚未公布，但以色列广播公司进行的一系列出口民意调查显示，其中两个政党——社会保守的阿拉伯联合名单党（Raam）和左翼联合名单党——可能赢得了历史上数量最多的议会席位，并在该国下一届政府的组建中发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: Mansour Abbas, the leader of Raam, told a television interviewer that the turnout showed that Arab voters, who make up about 20 percent of Israel’s population, had channeled their “frustration and despair” into “hope.”
paras.zh: 拉姆领导人曼苏尔·阿巴斯对电视采访者表示，投票率表明，占以色列人口约 20% 的阿拉伯选民已将“沮丧和绝望”转化为“希望”。

paras.en: He said he wanted to replace Mr. Netanyahu’s government “in every possible way” and that his first priority was to “ensure that there is a chance of forming a government” that achieved that goal.
paras.zh: 他说，他希望“以一切可能的方式”取代内塔尼亚胡先生的政府，而他的首要任务是“确保有机会组建一个政府”来实现这一目标。

paras.en: The Arab parties’ strong showing may make them kingmakers. But building a governing coalition with Arab participation remains a fraught exercise in Israel. Many Israeli Jews believe that a parliamentary majority should not rely on the support of Arab lawmakers.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党的强劲表现可能会让他们成为国王的拥护者。但在以色列建立一个有阿拉伯人参与的执政联盟仍然是一项充满挑战的工作。许多以色列犹太人认为，议会多数不应依赖阿拉伯立法者的支持。

paras.en: Most Arab citizens are the descendants of Palestinians who remained in their homes during the 1948 Arab-Israel war at the time of Israel’s independence.
paras.zh: 大多数阿拉伯公民是巴勒斯坦人的后裔，他们在 1948 年阿以战争期间以色列独立时仍留在家乡。

paras.en: Today, they mostly live in separate towns from Jewish Israelis and face violence and discriminatory housing policies.
paras.zh: 如今，他们大多居住在与犹太以色列人不同的城镇，面临暴力和歧视性住房政策。

paras.en: Over the decades, disagreements, including over Israel’s nature as a Jewish state, have led many Arab voters to avoid the ballot box.
paras.zh: 几十年来，包括以色列作为犹太国家性质在内的分歧导致许多阿拉伯选民避开投票箱。

paras.en: This week, many Arab voters said they were furious at Mr. Netanyahu for his treatment of the Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza and for policies that they feel treat Palestinians in Israel as second-class citizens. Indeed, throughout the campaign, Mr. Netanyahu made overt appeals to anti-Arab prejudice.
paras.zh: 本周，许多阿拉伯选民表示，他们对内塔尼亚胡对待约旦河西岸和加沙巴勒斯坦人的方式以及他们认为将以色列境内的巴勒斯坦人视为二等公民的政策感到愤怒。事实上，在整个竞选过程中，内塔尼亚胡先生公开呼吁反阿拉伯偏见。

paras.en: “I’m very optimistic because people understand that this isn’t like ordinary elections — we want change,” said Kholoud Al-Zeinati, 39, an Arab Israeli voter who cast her ballot on Tuesday in the mixed Jewish-Arab city of Lod, where long lines formed at polling places. “Because we, as the Arab community, are the community that pays the biggest price across so many aspects of life, it’s important to come out and take part.”
paras.zh: “我非常乐观，因为人们知道这与普通选举不同，我们想要改变，”39 岁的阿拉伯裔以色列选民霍鲁德·阿尔泽纳蒂 (Kholoud Al-Zeinati) 说，她于周二在犹太裔阿拉伯人混居的罗德市投票，那里的投票点排起了长队。 “因为我们作为阿拉伯社区，是在生活的许多方面付出最大代价的社区，所以站出来参与进来很重要。”

paras.en: “I expect our votes to be truly decisive in shaping the next government and making things better for all of us,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“我希望我们的选票对于塑造下一届政府和让我们所有人的生活变得更好方面具有真正决定性的作用。”

paras.en: Of the two Arab parties that did well on Tuesday, only Raam has joined a coalition government in the past. That happened in 2021, when it joined the short-lived anti-Netanyahu coalition of Prime Minister Naftali Bennett.
paras.zh: 在周二表现出色的两个阿拉伯政党中，只有拉姆过去曾加入过联合政府。这发生在 2021 年，当时它加入了总理纳夫塔利·贝内特领导的短暂的反内塔尼亚胡联盟。

paras.en: Raam’s participation in that government outraged many right-wing Jewish voters, and when it collapsed after roughly one year, they backed Mr. Netanyahu, who went on to form the most hard-line government in Israel’s history.
paras.zh: 拉姆参与该政府激怒了许多右翼犹太选民，大约一年后该政府垮台时，他们支持了内塔尼亚胡，内塔尼亚胡后来组建了以色列历史上最强硬的政府。

paras.en: That government now faces the possibility that it may be brought down by an election result that has been deeply shaped by robust Arab turnout.
paras.zh: 该政府现在面临着一种可能性，即它可能会因阿拉伯人强劲投票率而深受影响的选举结果而垮台。

paras.en: Heedo Abu Laban contributed reporting from Lod, Israel.
paras.zh: Heedo Abu Laban 贡献了来自以色列罗德的报道。

paras.en: Days before Tuesday’s pivotal Israeli election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu shocked his country by offering a bleak economic forecast that critics said could make Israel more like Iran, Russia and North Korea.
paras.zh: 在周二关键的以色列选举前几天，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡提出了黯淡的经济预测，批评者称这可能会让以色列变得更像伊朗、俄罗斯和朝鲜，震惊了以色列。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu told an Israeli financial journalist on Friday that he was preparing for international sanctions against Israeli banks by drawing up plans for a “bypass economy” based on cryptocurrency. He also told Israelis to prepare for the end of billions of dollars of annual American assistance.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡周五对以色列财经记者表示，他正在准备制定基于加密货币的“旁路经济”计划，以应对国际社会对以色列银行的制裁。他还告诉以色列人为结束美国每年数十亿美元的援助做好准备。

paras.en: “It’s over,” he said. “It’s only a matter of time.”
paras.zh: “结束了，”他说。 “这只是时间问题。”

paras.en: The comments were a reflection of Israel’s deepening global isolation, with even once-staunch allies imposing or threatening economic sanctions and embargoes after years of war in Gaza and rampant violence by Jewish settlers against Palestinians in the occupied West Bank.
paras.zh: 这些言论反映了以色列日益加深的全球孤立，在加沙多年的战争以及犹太定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸针对巴勒斯坦人的猖獗暴力之后，甚至一度坚定的盟友也实施或威胁实施经济制裁和禁运。

paras.en: With settlers advancing into areas that were previously off limits, Britain last month decried what it called “ethnic cleansing” and announced trade sanctions on settlements that it said would also apply to entities that financed their construction. Though Israel’s banking system has not been directly targeted by sanctions, a dozen countries, including Canada, France and Spain, have said they support restrictions on trade with settlements, raising the prospect of further penalties that could affect Israeli financial institutions.
paras.zh: 随着定居者进入以前禁止进入的地区，英国上个月谴责了所谓的“种族清洗”，并宣布对定居点实施贸易制裁，称这也将适用于为其建设提供资金的实体。尽管以色列的银行系统并未直接成为制裁的目标，但包括加拿大、法国和西班牙在内的十几个国家已表示支持对定居点贸易的限制，这增加了可能影响以色列金融机构的进一步处罚的可能性。

paras.en: Opponents of Mr. Netanyahu’s government decried his pronouncements, which also drew a rebuke from the generally reserved central bank.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡政府的反对者谴责他的言论，这也招致了总体上持保留态度的央行的谴责。

paras.en: “Crypto currencies cannot serve as a route to bypass sanctions against Israel,” the Bank of Israel said in a statement. The bank added that the government would do better “to focus on preventing sanctions” and preserving Israel’s economic ties with its main trading partners.
paras.zh: 以色列央行在一份声明中表示：“加密货币不能成为绕过对以色列制裁的途径。”该银行补充说，政府将更好地“专注于防止制裁”并维护以色列与其主要贸易伙伴的经济联系。

paras.en: Commentators said that Mr. Netanyahu’s outlook sounded apocalyptic, and some said it was part of a scare campaign to improve his election prospects.
paras.zh: 评论人士表示，内塔尼亚胡先生的前景听起来像是世界末日，一些人表示，这是旨在改善他的选举前景的恐吓活动的一部分。

paras.en: Last year, amid growing global condemnation of the Israeli military’s conduct of the war against Hamas in Gaza, where it has been accused of war crimes, and the imposition of some arms embargoes, he warned that Israel would have to become a more self-sufficient “super-Sparta.” That reference to the ancient, insular Greek city-state that practiced militaristic self-reliance was, to critics, a frightening scenario for a small country whose economy is largely driven by a tech sector that is reliant on foreign investment.
paras.zh: 去年，全球越来越多地谴责以色列军队在加沙对哈马斯发动的战争，以色列被指控犯有战争罪，并实施了一些武器禁运，他警告说，以色列必须成为一个更加自给自足的“超级斯巴达”。在批评者看来，对于一个经济主要由依赖外国投资的科技行业驱动的小国来说，希腊这个实行军国主义自力更生的古希腊城邦是一个可怕的场景。

paras.en: Gadi Eisenkot, Mr. Netanyahu’s main rival in Tuesday’s election, said in a social media post that the prime minister’s “Bibi-coin vision,” a nod to cryptocurrency, would “dismantle the Israeli economy for generations.”
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在周二选举中的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特 (Gadi Eisenkot) 在社交媒体帖子中表示，总理的“Bibi-coin 愿景”（对加密货币的认可）将“摧毁以色列几代人的经济”。

paras.en: “No internet purchases, no high-tech investments, no national security,” he added.
paras.zh: “没有互联网购买，没有高科技投资，没有国家安全，”他补充道。

paras.en: Yair Lapid, the opposition leader who has served as prime minister and finance minister, wrote on social media that a vote for Mr. Netanyahu was a vote for “a ruined economy, sanctions that will lead to insane price hikes, and no military alliance with the United States.”
paras.zh: 曾担任总理和财政部长的反对党领袖亚伊尔·拉皮德在社交媒体上写道，投票给内塔尼亚胡先生就是投票给“被破坏的经济、将导致物价疯狂上涨的制裁以及不与美国建立军事联盟”。

paras.en: And a former governor of the Bank of Israel, Jacob Frenkel, told Israel’s Channel 12 on Sunday that moving away from the international financial system would turn Israel into “a leper.”
paras.zh: 以色列银行前行长雅各布·弗伦克尔 (Jacob Frenkel) 周日对以色列第 12 频道表示，脱离国际金融体系将使以色列变成“麻风病人”。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu later walked back his remarks slightly, saying that he had heard the criticism and that cryptocurrency was only one option to deal with potential financial sanctions.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡后来稍微收回了自己的言论，称他听到了批评，加密货币只是应对潜在金融制裁的一种选择。

paras.en: In a somewhat jarring contrast, Mr. Netanyahu’s campaign has argued that Israel’s economy overall is healthy despite years of war, helped by record export revenues, relatively low inflation and unemployment, and a strong shekel.
paras.zh: 与此形成鲜明对比的是，内塔尼亚胡的竞选团队辩称，尽管经历了多年的战争，但得益于创纪录的出口收入、相对较低的通胀和失业率以及坚挺的谢克尔，以色列的经济总体健康。

paras.en: But many Israelis are not feeling it. The State Comptroller, a government watchdog, warned last year that the cost of living was “skyrocketing” in part because of structural challenges in Israel’s consumer market and low competition levels.
paras.zh: 但许多以色列人并没有感觉到。政府监管机构国家审计长去年警告说，生活成本“飙升”，部分原因是以色列消费市场的结构性挑战和低竞争水平。

paras.en: While foreign affairs and national security have dominated the political conversation ahead of the election, a recent survey by the Israel Democracy Institute, a nonpartisan research group, found that the economy was the top issue for many voters heading into Tuesday.
paras.zh: 尽管外交事务和国家安全主导了选举前的政治对话，但无党派研究团体以色列民主研究所最近的一项调查发现，经济是许多选民进入周二的首要问题。

paras.en: The stakes of the Israeli elections are high for Palestinians in the West Bank, but they do not have the right to vote in them.
paras.zh: 对于西岸的巴勒斯坦人来说，以色列选举的赌注很高，但他们没有投票权。

paras.en: In interviews, some Palestinians voiced objections to not being allowed to vote, especially as they felt Israel’s occupation of the West Bank was becoming more permanent.
paras.zh: 在采访中，一些巴勒斯坦人对不被允许投票表示反对，特别是因为他们认为以色列对约旦河西岸的占领正在变得更加永久。

paras.en: “The Israeli government has enormous influence over our lives,” said Montaser Amro, 32, a supermarket owner in Majd, a village near the southern city of Hebron. “It chooses when roadblocks open and close, it controls the borders, and it decides on how much of our economy functions.”
paras.zh: “以色列政府对我们的生活有着巨大的影响力，”32 岁的蒙塔瑟·阿姆罗 (Montaser Amro) 说，他是南部城市希伯伦附近马吉德村的一家超市老板。 “它选择路障何时打开和关闭，它控制边界，并决定我们的经济发挥多少作用。”

paras.en: He added, “Why can’t we vote when settlers living hundreds of meters away can?”
paras.zh: 他补充道，“为什么我们不能投票，而住在数百米外的定居者可以投票？”

paras.en: Israel captured the West Bank in 1967 and reached an agreement with the Palestine Liberation Organization to establish the Palestinian Authority in the 1990s. The Palestinian Authority administers parts of the West Bank and has not held parliamentary or presidential elections for roughly 20 years.
paras.zh: 以色列于1967年占领约旦河西岸，并于20世纪90年代与巴勒斯坦解放组织达成协议建立巴勒斯坦权力机构。巴勒斯坦权力机构管理着约旦河西岸部分地区，大约 20 年没有举行议会或总统选举。

paras.en: Many Palestinians have long hoped the Palestinian Authority would transform into an independent Palestinian state. In recent years, those hopes have dwindled. The Israeli government promotes the expansion of settlements in the West Bank that are widely considered illegal under international law and rejects Palestinian self-determination there and in Gaza. Palestinian officials have also failed to unify their ranks and renew their leadership.
paras.zh: 许多巴勒斯坦人长期以来一直希望巴勒斯坦权力机构能够转变为一个独立的巴勒斯坦国。近年来，这些希望已经越来越渺茫。以色列政府推动在西岸扩建定居点，这些定居点根据国际法被广泛认为是非法的，并拒绝在那里和加沙的巴勒斯坦人自决。巴勒斯坦官员也未能团结他们的队伍并更新他们的领导层。

paras.en: Alaa al-Khabass, 40, a resident of Hebron, said it was unjust that Palestinians could not cast ballots.
paras.zh: 40 岁的希伯伦居民阿拉·哈巴斯 (Alaa al-Khabass) 表示，巴勒斯坦人无法投票是不公正的。

paras.en: “Israel controls just about everything related to us, and I don’t see that changing any time soon,” he said. “We should be able to vote, but we live in painful reality where we lack rights and sovereignty.”
paras.zh: “以色列几乎控制着与我们有关的一切，我认为这种情况不会很快改变，”他说。 “我们应该能够投票，但我们生活在缺乏权利和主权的痛苦现实中。”

articles.title: At Least 68 Killed in Train Crash in Spain, Officials Say
articles.author: The New York Times

paras.en: A high-speed passenger train rear-ended another in Spain on Wednesday morning near the central city of Toledo, killing at least 68 people and injuring dozens more, officials said, in one of the deadliest train crashes in Spanish history.
paras.zh: 官员称，周三上午，西班牙中部城市托莱多附近，一列高速客运列车与另一列高速客运列车相撞，造成至少 68 人死亡、数十人受伤，这是西班牙历史上最致命的火车事故之一。

paras.en: The accident happened after traffic control operators told a high-speed train to continue its journey when another train was stopped farther along the tracks, Spain’s transportation minister, Óscar Puente, said. He called the operators’ instruction “inexplicable.”
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 表示，事故发生前，交通管制人员告诉一列高速列车继续行驶，而另一列列车则停在了沿铁轨较远的地方。他称操作员的指令“令人费解”。

paras.en: The deadly crash was the second this year involving the same two rail operators; the first, in January, killed 46 people. The latest accident, and its timing months after the previous crash, was likely to deepen doubts about the security of Spain’s once-vaunted rail system.
paras.zh: 这起致命事故是今年发生的第二起事故，涉及同一两家铁路运营商。第一次发生在 1 月份，造成 46 人死亡。最近的事故，以及上次事故发生几个月后的时间，可能会加深人们对西班牙曾经引以为傲的铁路系统安全性的怀疑。

paras.en: In Spanish news reports, passengers described an awful impact that tossed people from a dining car, broke limbs and piled passengers atop one another. People crawled out of windows and others were carried by fellow passengers into a nearby field on makeshift stretchers. Local workers, who had heard the crash, rushed to help and guide survivors to safety.
paras.zh: 在西班牙新闻报道中，乘客们描述了一次可怕的撞击，人们从餐车中被抛下，四肢骨折，乘客们互相叠在一起。人们从窗户爬出，其他人则被其他乘客用临时担架抬到附近的田野里。听到坠机声的当地工作人员立即赶来帮助并引导幸存者前往安全地带。

paras.en: The crash came about a month ahead of national election in Spain, and it had the potential to become an issue in an already bitter campaign about the competence of the left-wing government of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.
paras.zh: 这次事故发生在西班牙全国大选前大约一个月，它有可能成为一场围绕总理佩德罗·桑切斯左翼政府能力的激烈竞选活动中的一个问题。

paras.en: Spain’s rail authority, the Adif, said the trains involved were a “Renfe train and another from the Iryo company,” both covering the route between Madrid, the capital, and the southern city of Seville. Renfe is the national rail provider.
paras.zh: 西班牙铁路局阿迪夫表示，涉事列车是“Renfe 列车和 Iryo 公司的另一列列车”，两列列车均覆盖首都马德里和南部城市塞维利亚之间的路线。 Renfe 是国家铁路提供商。

paras.en: Mr. Sánchez visited the scene of the crash, saying that Spanish rail’s security systems clearly needed to be reinforced. “If there has been negligence, it will come to light,” he said. “If there have been failures in the safety system, we will respond with the utmost firmness.” He declared three days of official mourning.
paras.zh: 桑切斯先生视察了事故现场，表示西班牙铁路的安全系统显然需要加强。 “如果存在疏忽，就会暴露出来，”他说。 “如果安全系统出现故障，我们将以最坚定的态度应对。”他宣布正式哀悼三天。

paras.en: The conservative opposition leader, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, voiced his own concern.
paras.zh: 保守派反对党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费乔表达了自己的担忧。

paras.en: “I am very concerned about the information we are receiving regarding another train accident,” he wrote on social media soon after the crash. “The priority now is to assist the victims and support their families. My full support goes to the emergency teams working on the ground.” His Popular Party canceled all its campaign events around the country.
paras.zh: “我非常担心我们收到的有关另一起火车事故的信息，”事故发生后不久，他在社交媒体上写道。 “现在的首要任务是援助受害者并支持他们的家人。我全力支持在现场工作的应急小组。”他的人民党取消了全国各地的所有竞选活动。

paras.en: - An earlier deadly crash: In January, a northbound Iryo train derailed, two of its cars falling onto the opposite track, and a southbound Renfe train slammed into the carriages seconds later. An official report on what caused that lethal accident has not been released, but preliminary investigations pointed to a broken rail as the likely cause.
paras.zh: - 早些时候发生的致命事故：一月份，一列北行的 Iryo 列车脱轨，两节车厢掉到对面的轨道上，几秒钟后，一列南行的 Renfe 列车撞上了车厢。关于造成这起致命事故的官方报告尚未发布，但初步调查表明，可能的原因是铁轨断裂。

paras.en: José Bautista contributed reporting from the scene of the crash.
paras.zh: 何塞·包蒂斯塔 (José Bautista) 提供了事故现场的报道。

paras.en: About half an hour after Fernando Seco’s train left Madrid on Wednesday morning, taking him home to Seville after a business trip, it stopped for a few minutes. A voice on the loudspeaker said there was heavy traffic.
paras.zh: 周三早上，费尔南多·塞科乘坐的火车从马德里出发，载着他结束商务旅行返回塞维利亚的家，大约半小时后，火车停了几分钟。扩音器里传来一个声音，说交通堵塞。

paras.en: The train then started to move again — and after a while, Mr. Seco said, there was a “very violent crash.” He would soon learn that his train, run by Renfe, Spain’s national rail provider, had rear-ended another one, leaving dozens of people dead. Mr. Seco, 62, felt the impact all the way at the back of the train, where he was sitting, he recalled in an interview. He said his carriage filled with screams and panic as people rushed to get off.
paras.zh: 然后火车又开始移动——塞科说，过了一会儿，发生了“非常猛烈的碰撞”。他很快就会得知，由西班牙国家铁路提供商 Renfe 运营的火车追尾了另一列火车，造成数十人死亡。 62 岁的塞科在接受采访时回忆道，他坐在火车后部，一路感受到了冲击力。他说，当人们争相下车时，他的车厢里充满了尖叫声和恐慌。

paras.en: He and other passengers climbed down an embankment. Farmhands working in a nearby field, he said, cut through a fence so the passengers could pass through.
paras.zh: 他和其他乘客爬下路堤。他说，在附近田地里干活的农场工人剪开了栅栏，以便乘客可以通过。

paras.en: That was when Mr. Seco saw, further ahead, train carriages that had been completely derailed.
paras.zh: 就在这时，塞科先生看到了前方更远的地方，火车车厢完全脱轨了。

paras.en: “A rail beam had pierced right through a carriage from bottom to top, like carving meat,” Mr. Seco said. He said he and others rushed to those carriages and found dead and injured people, “trapped in a twisted tangle of metal and wreckage.”
paras.zh: “一根铁轨梁从下到上贯穿了车厢，就像切肉一样，”塞科先生说。他说，他和其他人冲向那些车厢，发现死伤者“被困在金属和残骸的扭曲纠缠中”。

paras.en: It was quiet, said Mr. Seco, who believed it was because people were so hurt that they couldn’t speak. He and others began working to free passengers from the wreckage. That was when the screaming started, he said.
paras.zh: 塞科先生说，周围很安静，他相信这是因为人们受伤太深而无法说话。他和其他人开始努力将乘客从残骸中救出。他说，就在那时尖叫声开始了。

paras.en: He and the others moved at least a dozen people from the train, using parts of the wreckage as makeshift stretchers. Doctors who were among the passengers treated the wounded in what became a field hospital among a grove of almond trees.
paras.zh: 他和其他人用部分残骸作为临时担架，从火车上转移了至少十几个人。乘客中的医生在杏树林中的野战医院治疗伤员。

paras.en: When he finally left, Mr. Seco said, it was with the help of goatherds, who drove him to a sports pavilion in the nearby town of Urda. There, friends picked him up to drive him home to Seville.
paras.zh: 塞科说，当他最终离开时，是在牧羊人的帮助下，他们开车送他去了附近乌尔达镇的一个体育馆。在那里，朋友们接他开车送他回塞维利亚的家。

paras.en: The leader of Spain’s conservative opposition party, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, demanded “answers” and urged the national government on Wednesday to conduct an independent review of the entire railway network.
paras.zh: 西班牙保守反对党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍要求“答案”，并于周三敦促国家政府对整个铁路网进行独立审查。

paras.en: “Spain has the right to know what is happening with its infrastructure, what condition the tracks and safety systems are in, what warnings were received from Adamuz and what measures were taken,” he said, referring to the fatal January train crash near the city of Adamuz and what lessons, if any, the authorities had learned from it.
paras.zh: “西班牙有权了解其基础设施的状况、轨道和安全系统的状况、收到了阿达穆兹的哪些警告以及采取了哪些措施，”他说。他指的是一月份阿达穆兹市附近发生的致命火车事故，以及当局从中吸取了哪些教训（如果有的话）。

paras.en: Spain’s transportation minister said a train crash that killed dozens on Wednesday appeared to result from an “inexplicable” decision by traffic control operators to tell a high-speed train to continue its journey when another train was stopped farther along the tracks.
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部长表示，周三发生的导致数十人死亡的火车相撞事故似乎是由于交通管制人员做出“莫名其妙”的决定所致，当另一列火车停在铁轨上较远的地方时，他们要求一列高速列车继续行驶。

paras.en: The minister, Óscar Puente, said he spent the morning watching a reconstruction of the accident and listening to audio recordings of communications between the control center in Madrid and the trains that crashed near Toledo, and he gave a detailed account of what he said preceded the crash at a news conference.
paras.zh: 部长奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 表示，他整个上午都在观看事故重建，并收听马德里控制中心与托莱多附近坠毁列车之间的通信录音，他在新闻发布会上详细介绍了事故发生前的情况。

paras.en: At about 8:30 a.m. local time, an automatic train control system near the site of the crash went down because of a computer failure, Mr. Puente said.
paras.zh: 普恩特表示，当地时间上午 8 点 30 分左右，事故现场附近的一个自动列车控制系统因计算机故障而瘫痪。

paras.en: The system — known as the Linienzugbeeinflussung, or LZB — dates to the 1960s and uses external technologies, such as track circuits and axel counters, to monitor the speed and position of trains. This information allows the system to automatically calculate when and how quickly a train can safely move forward. It then changes railroad signals accordingly.
paras.zh: 该系统被称为 Linienzugbeeinflussung 或 LZB，其历史可以追溯到 20 世纪 60 年代，并使用轨道电路和轴计数器等外部技术来监控列车的速度和位置。这些信息使系统能够自动计算火车何时以及以多快的速度可以安全地前进。然后它会相应地改变铁路信号。

paras.en: On Wednesday, the safety system was inactive along a stretch of about 39 miles, or 63 kilometers, of tracks, so six trains traveling along that section were automatically stopped as a precaution. At that point, he said, the control center in Madrid took over.
paras.zh: 周三，一段约 39 英里（63 公里）的轨道上的安全系统处于非活动状态，因此作为预防措施，沿该路段行驶的六列火车自动停止。他说，此时，马德里的控制中心接管了工作。

paras.en: “The control center communicated with the trains that had stopped, and at 8:36 a.m., the decision was made to allow the train that eventually collided with the stationary Iryo train to resume its journey as normal,” Mr. Puente said, referring to the private rail operator of the stopped train.
paras.zh: “控制中心与停止运行的列车进行了沟通，并于上午 8 点 36 分做出决定，允许最终与静止的 Iryo 列车相撞的列车恢复正常行驶，”普恩特先生说，他指的是停止运行的列车的私营铁路运营商。

paras.en: Traffic controllers working for Adif, the state-owned company that manages Spain’s rail infrastructure, told the train that eventually rear-ended the other to restart its planned journey, Mr. Puente said, “despite there being another train ahead of it.”
paras.zh: 普恩特说，管理西班牙铁路基础设施的国有公司阿迪夫的交通管制员告诉这列火车，最终追尾了另一列火车，以重新开始其计划的旅程，“尽管前面还有另一列火车。”

paras.en: The train that was hit from behind was believed to have received instructions from traffic operators to continue, he said, but for unknown reasons it did not proceed.
paras.zh: 他说，被从后面撞到的火车据信已收到交通运营商的继续行驶指令，但由于未知原因，它没有继续行驶。

paras.en: The moving train then hit the stationary train.
paras.zh: 然后，移动的火车撞上了静止的火车。

paras.en: “And that is the origin of the accident that has taken place,” Mr. Puente said, adding that the moving train should have been stopped according to protocol.
paras.zh: 普恩特先生说：“这就是发生事故的根源。”他补充说，根据协议，行驶中的火车本应停止。

paras.en: The Madrid-Seville route is currently undergoing a modernization program that will replace the LZB system with the more modern European Rail Traffic Management System. Infrastructure officials hope that the new system will cut down on human error in signaling.
paras.zh: 马德里-塞维利亚线路目前正在进行现代化改造计划，该计划将用更现代化的欧洲铁路交通管理系统取代 LZB 系统。基础设施官员希望新系统能够减少信号发送中的人为错误。

paras.en: Mr. Puente also said that the driver of an uninvolved train tried to warn the control center of the dangers when its operators greenlit the rear train’s resumption of its journey. That driver told the control center operator that trains should proceed at lower-than-normal speeds. The operator, Mr. Puente said, acknowledged his error. “Oh, yes,” the operator replied.
paras.zh: 普恩特还表示，当操作人员为后面的列车恢复行驶开绿灯时，一列未受影响的列车的司机试图警告控制中心存在危险。该司机告诉控制中心操作员，火车应该以低于正常的速度行驶。普恩特先生说，接线员承认了自己的错误。 “哦，是的，”接线员回答道。

paras.en: When the crash happened, Yahadi Mohamed Maulud, 41, who lives in the nearby town of Yébenes, loaded his car with water bottles and rushed to help. “We found a massacre,” he said, describing torn limbs and a blood-covered woman searching for her brother. One of the first to arrive at the scene, he helped to move injured passengers and carry stretchers. Maulud said he often took the train himself to Madrid for business, but no more. “I’m never getting on that train again.”
paras.zh: 事故发生时，住在附近耶贝内斯镇的 41 岁的亚哈迪·穆罕默德·毛鲁德 (Yahdi Mohamed Maulud) 在车里装满了水瓶，赶忙前去帮忙。 “我们发现了一场大屠杀，”他说，描述了一名四肢撕裂和一名浑身是血的妇女在寻找她的兄弟。他是第一批到达现场的人之一，帮助搬运受伤乘客并搬运担架。莫鲁德说，他经常自己坐火车去马德里出差，但以后就不再这样了。 “我再也不会坐那趟火车了。”

paras.en: So many people showed up at Madrid hospitals on Wednesday to donate blood for victims of the train crash that the authorities are asking citizens to wait until Thursday or the following days, when more donations will be needed.
paras.zh: 周三，许多人出现在马德里的医院为火车事故的受害者献血，因此当局要求公民等到周四或接下来的几天，届时需要更多的献血。

paras.en: “The response from the people of Madrid to the call for blood donations is overwhelming,” said Isabel Díaz Ayuso, Madrid’s regional president. “Thank you, everyone.”
paras.zh: 马德里地区主席伊莎贝尔·迪亚兹·阿尤索表示：“马德里人民对献血的呼声反应热烈。” “谢谢大家。”

paras.en: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez spoke from the scene of the crash on Wednesday afternoon. “It’s not possible for a country like Spain to suffer two high-speed train accidents in one year,” he said, adding that while today’s accident and a fatal January crash on the same line seemed unrelated, Spanish rail’s security systems clearly needed to be reinforced.
paras.zh: 周三下午，总理佩德罗·桑切斯在事故现场发表讲话。他说：“像西班牙这样的国家不可能在一年内发生两起高铁事故。”他补充说，虽然今天的事故和一月份同一条线路上发生的致命事故似乎无关，但西班牙铁路的安全系统显然需要加强。

paras.en: “If there has been negligence, it will come to light,” he said. “If there have been failures in the safety system, we will respond with the utmost firmness.” Spain needs to understand “what is the origin of this tragedy,” he said.
paras.zh: “如果存在疏忽，就会暴露出来，”他说。 “如果安全系统出现故障，我们将以最坚定的态度应对。”他说，西班牙需要了解“这场悲剧的根源是什么”。

paras.en: Sánchez offered his condolences to the families of victims and thanked emergency workers. He also declared three days of official mourning, as he did after the January crash.
paras.zh: 桑切斯向遇难者家属表示哀悼，并向急救人员表示感谢。他还宣布正式哀悼三天，就像一月份事故发生后那样。

paras.en: Emiliano García-Page, the president of the Castilla-La Mancha region, said the death toll from the crash had risen to 68. Twenty-four of those killed were on the Renfe train and the others were on the Iryo train, he said.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区总统埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇表示，事故造成的死亡人数已上升至 68 人。他说，其中 24 人死在 Renfe 列车上，其他人则在 Iryo 列车上。

paras.en: “Firefighters, with the help of cranes, are still working to determine whether there are more fatalities,” he said, “possibly beneath some of the carriages or among the twisted wreckage they have become.”
paras.zh: “消防队员在起重机的帮助下，仍在努力确定是否还有更多人员死亡，”他说，“可能是在一些车厢下面，或者是在车厢扭曲的残骸中。”

paras.en: In the middle of fields of alfalfa and almond trees, a seemingly endless procession of ambulances, police cars and firetrucks drove in and out of the crash scene, as rescue helicopters flew low overhead. The trains seemed twisted together, a mass of mangled metal.
paras.zh: 在苜蓿和杏树的田野中，救护车、警车和消防车的队伍看似无穷无尽，进出坠机现场，救援直升机低空飞过。火车看起来扭曲在一起，就像一堆破碎的金属。

paras.en: Dozens of Civil Guard officers, some wearing the white protective suits used by forensic investigators, were inspecting the scene and gathering evidence. Broken cables and fallen utility poles were scattered all around.
paras.zh: 数十名国民警卫队官员正在检查现场并收集证据，其中一些人穿着法医调查人员使用的白色防护服。断裂的电缆和倒下的电线杆散落在各处。

paras.en: A group of Catholic priests walked out from the area where the trains were located. “We came to pray for the dead,” said the Rev. Luis Lucendo, 63, a vicar of Toledo and parish priest in Villacañas, a nearby town.
paras.zh: 一群天主教神父从火车所在区域走出。 “我们是来为死者祈祷的，”63 岁的路易斯·卢森多 (Luis Lucendo) 牧师说，他是托莱多的牧师，也是附近城镇维拉卡尼亚斯的教区牧师。

paras.en: “One man told us that his wife had died, and I was able to make the sign of the cross over her,” Father Lucendo said. “They were going to spend the day in Córdoba, but this is where their journey ended.”
paras.zh: “一个男人告诉我们，他的妻子去世了，我在她身上画了十字，”卢森多神父说。 “他们原本打算在科尔多瓦度过一天，但这就是他们旅程的终点​​。”

paras.en: At least 64 people were killed in the train crash, the emergency services of Castilla-La Mancha said on Wednesday afternoon. The toll makes the accident one of the deadliest in the country’s history.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰紧急服务部门周三下午表示，火车相撞事故至少造成 64 人死亡。伤亡人数使这起事故成为该国历史上最致命的事故之一。

paras.en: The president of Castilla-La Mancha region, Emiliano García-Page, confirmed that at least 30 people had been killed in the train crash, a number that may rise. About 80 people were injured, 50 of them, according to García-Page, with severe injuries.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区总统埃米利亚诺·加西亚-佩奇证实，至少有 30 人在火车事故中丧生，这一数字可能还会上升。据加西亚-佩奇称，大约 80 人受伤，其中 50 人伤势严重。

paras.en: Blood donation groups in the area of the train crash are urging donors to come to hospitals in Toledo and Ciudad Real to “urgently replenish the reserves. Blood of all types will be needed.”
paras.zh: 火车事故地区的献血组织正在敦促献血者前往托莱多和雷阿尔城的医院，“紧急补充储备。需要各种类型的血液。”

paras.en: The fatal train crash near Toledo on Wednesday comes months after a deadly collision in southern Spain that involved the same carriers. In that accident, in January, 46 people were killed when two high-speed trains collided near Adamuz, in the country’s worst rail disaster since 2013.
paras.zh: 周三托莱多附近发生的致命火车相撞事故发生在西班牙南部发生致命相撞事故几个月后。在那次事故中，两列高铁在 1 月阿达穆兹附近相撞，造成 46 人死亡，这是该国自 2013 年以来最严重的铁路灾难。

paras.en: The crash in January occurred when a train belonging to the private company Iryo derailed as it traveled toward Madrid. The train had been traveling north from Málaga when two of its rear cars fell into the opposite track. Seconds later, a southbound train operated by Spain’s national rail company, Renfe, slammed into the carriages.
paras.zh: 今年一月的事故发生时，一列私营公司 Iryo 旗下的火车在前往马德里的途中脱轨。这列火车当时正从马拉加向北行驶，后面的两节车厢掉进了对面的轨道。几秒钟后，一列由西班牙国家铁路公司 Renfe 运营的南行列车撞上了车厢。

paras.en: The two trains were carrying hundreds of people when the collision occurred. An official report on what caused that accident is not yet available, but preliminary investigations pointed to a broken rail as the likely cause.
paras.zh: 碰撞发生时，两列火车均载有数百人。目前还没有关于事故原因的官方报告，但初步调查表明，可能的原因是铁轨断裂。

paras.en: The accident shocked Spain and led to deep uncertainty about the safety of the country’s rail system, which contains the world’s second-longest high-speed rail network.
paras.zh: 这起事故震惊了西班牙，并导致对该国铁路系统安全性的极大不确定性，该国铁路系统拥有世界第二长的高铁网络。

paras.en: The deadly crash on Wednesday was the third in Spain this year. Days after the accident in January, a commuter train near Barcelona struck a collapsed retaining wall and derailed, killing one person.
paras.zh: 周三发生的致命车祸是西班牙今年发生的第三起事故。一月份事故发生几天后，巴塞罗那附近的一列通勤列车撞上倒塌的挡土墙并脱轨，造成一人死亡。

paras.en: Videos shot by passengers after the crash show parts of the derailed carriages pulverized, with charred wheels, and bags and seats strewn across an embankment. Emergency workers tend to the injured or hover over people covered in Mylar blankets. The arid field outside the small towns of Los Yébenes and Urda has become a parking lot of emergency vehicles and tents.
paras.zh: 事故发生后乘客拍摄的视频显示，脱轨车厢的部分部件被粉碎，车轮烧焦，袋子和座椅散落在路堤上。紧急救援人员对伤者进行救治，或者在覆盖着聚酯薄膜毯子的人身上盘旋。洛斯耶贝内斯和乌尔达小镇外的干旱田地已成为应急车辆和帐篷的停车场。

paras.en: Video filmed inside one of the trains and verified by The New York Times shows smoke rising from a charred, mangled carriage on the slope of the rail line. The footage was first shared by the Spanish radio station Capital Radio, which said an employee had been on one of the trains at the time of the crash.
paras.zh: 在其中一列火车内拍摄并经《纽约时报》证实的视频显示，铁路线斜坡上一辆烧焦、损毁的车厢冒出浓烟。这段视频首先由西班牙首都广播电台分享，该电台表示，事故发生时，一名员工正在其中一列火车上。

paras.en: The first eyewitness reports from the crash are beginning to trickle in on Spanish media. Passengers are describing an awful impact that tossed people from the dining car, broke limbs and piled passengers atop one another. Passengers crawled out of windows and lay in in a nearby field, where local workers, who heard the crash, rushed to help them with first aid kits and saw the first bodies.
paras.zh: 西班牙媒体开始陆续报道坠机事件的第一批目击者报告。乘客们描述了一次可怕的撞击，有人从餐车中被甩出，四肢骨折，乘客们互相叠在一起。乘客们从窗户爬出，躺在附近的田野里，当地工作人员听到坠机声后，赶紧拿着急救箱来帮助他们，并看到了第一批尸体。

paras.en: The crash comes months after a deadly collision in January in southern Spain that involved the same carriers. That accident, in which two high-speed trains collided, killing 46 people, was the country’s worst railway disaster since 2013.
paras.zh: 此次坠机事件发生在几个月前，西班牙南部一月份曾发生过同样涉及这家航空公司的致命碰撞事故。两列高铁相撞事故造成 46 人死亡，是该国自 2013 年以来最严重的铁路灾难。

paras.en: An official report on what caused the January crash is not yet available, but preliminary investigations pointed to a broken rail as the likely cause.
paras.zh: 目前还没有关于一月份事故原因的官方报告，但初步调查表明，铁轨断裂可能是造成事故的原因。

paras.en: Spain’s interior ministry said in a statement that it was deploying a military emergency unit and Civil Guard officers to the scene of the crash in the province of Toledo. Investigators from Spain’s Major Disaster Unit are also en route.
paras.zh: 西班牙内政部在一份声明中表示，正在向托莱多省的坠机现场部署军事紧急部队和国民警卫队官员。西班牙重大灾难部门的调查人员也在途中。

articles.title: Drake Gets Surprise 40th Birthday Roast From Jeff Ross in Houston: ‘The F–king General’
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: All Drake wanted for his 40th birthday was to be roasted by Jim Carrey, but he got the Roastmaster General, Jeff Ross, instead.
paras.zh: 德雷克 (Drake) 40 岁生日时只想得到金·凯瑞 (Jim Carrey) 的烘焙，但他却得到了烘焙大师杰夫·罗斯 (Jeff Ross)。

paras.en: Drizzy spent the weekend celebrating his birthday in New York City, and he continued the party in Houston on Tuesday (Oct. 27), which included a surprise birthday roast courtesy of the New Jersey-bred comic.
paras.zh: 崔兹在纽约度过了周末庆祝生日，周二（10 月 27 日）他在休斯顿继续举办派对，其中包括这位新泽西出生的喜剧演员提供的惊喜生日烤肉。

paras.en: “Drake enjoying his surprise birthday roast in Houston tonight,” Ross captioned a selfie with the 6 God in an Instagram Story Wednesday, which he soundtracked with ICEMAN‘s “National Treasures.”
paras.zh: “德雷克今晚在休斯敦享受他惊喜的生日烤肉，”罗斯周三在 Instagram 故事中为一张与 6 God 的自拍照添加了标题，他还为 ICEMAN 的“National Treasures”配乐。

paras.en: The 6 God reposted the photo with Ross to his own Instagram Story, calling him “The F–king General.” Clips from the roast king ribbing Drizzy haven’t yet surfaced on social media.
paras.zh: 6 神将与罗斯的照片转发到他自己的 Instagram Story 上，称他为“The F–king General”。烤王取笑 Drizzy 的片段尚未出现在社交媒体上。

paras.en: In September, Ross was put on the other side of his signature roasts as Jim Carrey ripped the comedian for his 61st birthday. “Canadian mountain man Jim Carrey sent me this for my birthday,” Ross wrote. “It made me so happy I had to share it with roast fans everywhere! EVERYONE PLEASE KEEP ROASTING ME IN THE COMMENTS BELOW ! ROASTING IS LOVE !”
paras.zh: 9 月，金·凯瑞 (Jim Carrey) 在这位喜剧演员 61 岁生日之际，将罗斯置于了他的标志性烤肉节目的另一边。 “加拿大山区男子金凯瑞送给我这个作为我的生日礼物，”罗斯写道。 “这让我很高兴，我不得不与各地的烘焙粉丝分享它！大家请在下面的评论中继续烘焙我！烘焙就是爱！”

paras.en: Drake saw the clip of Carrey jabbing Ross about how his mom had to sign an NDA when he was born because he was so ugly, and the rapper attempted to manifest having the legendary actor roast him for his own birthday.
paras.zh: 德雷克（Drake）看到凯瑞（Carrey）刺伤罗斯（Ross）的片段，称他的妈妈在他出生时必须签署一份保密协议（NDA），因为他太丑了，而这位说唱歌手试图表现出让这位传奇演员在自己的生日时烤他。

paras.en: “Wow this is now all I want for my birthday,” Drizzy commented on IG at the time.
paras.zh: “哇，这就是我想要的生日礼物了，”Drizzy 当时在 IG 上评论道。

paras.en: While he didn’t get Carrey, Ross made sure that the OVO rapper was properly roasted to kick off his 40s.
paras.zh: 虽然罗斯没有得到凯瑞，但他确保这位 OVO 说唱歌手得到了适当的锻炼，开始了他的 40 多岁。

paras.en: Drake’s birthday celebration began in Toronto and continued throughout the weekend in NYC. Drizzy rang in 40 with about 400 guests at Casa Cipriani in Manhattan, which included a surprise performance from the Backstreet Boys, as Drake joined the boy band on stage for its 1999 smash “I Want It That Way.”
paras.zh: 德雷克的生日庆祝活动从多伦多开始，并在纽约持续整个周末。 Drizzy 在曼哈顿的 Casa Cipriani 与大约 400 名客人一起参加了 40 场演出，其中包括后街男孩 (Backstreet Boys) 的一场惊喜表演，当时 Drake 与这支男孩乐队一起登台表演了 1999 年的热门单曲《I Want It That Way》。

paras.en: “Tonight isn’t about a tour, an album release, or a bunch of videos we shot,” Drake told the room. “It’s about being alive, staying alive.”
paras.zh: “今晚不是关于巡演、专辑发行或我们拍摄的一堆视频，”德雷克告诉房间。 “这就是活着，活下去。”

paras.en: Many guests didn’t leave empty-handed either, as designer gifts and cash prizes were raffled off.
paras.zh: 许多客人也没有空手而归，因为我们还抽出了设计师礼物和现金奖品。

paras.en: Drake has been busy throughout 2026, which included the release of his trifecta of albums in May. The 6 God made history as the first artist to occupy the top three slots of the Billboard 200 with ICEMAN, HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR simultaneously holding the No. 1, No. 2 and No. 3 spots on the chart.
paras.zh: Drake 整个 2026 年都很忙碌，其中包括 5 月份发行的三张专辑。 6 God创造了历史，成为第一位占据Billboard 200前三名的艺人，ICEMAN、HABIBTI和MAID OF HONOR同时占据排行榜第一、第二和第三位。

articles.title: The 10 Best Songs to Celebrate Día de Muertos 2026: Chavela Vargas, Carlos Rivera & More
articles.author: Sigal Ratner-Arias

paras.en: Music is an essential part of the Día de Muertos (Day of the Dead) celebration, a Mexican tradition that blends Indigenous roots with Christian customs from the Spanish colonial era and, according to historians, has evolved over time. It is one of the most beloved commemorations both within and beyond Mexico.
paras.zh: 音乐是 Día de Muertos（亡灵节）庆祝活动的重要组成部分，这是一种墨西哥传统，融合了土著根源与西班牙殖民时代的基督教习俗，并且根据历史学家的说法，随着时间的推移而不断演变。这是墨西哥国内外最受欢迎的纪念活动之一。

paras.en: Decorations like tissue paper with cut-out shapes, marigold flowers, sugar skulls, pan de muerto (Day of the Dead bread), water, candles and the favorite food and drinks of departed loved ones fill altars in homes and public spaces to honor and “welcome” them back for a few hours to the world of the living. According to this tradition, every Nov. 1st and 2nd — dedicated to children and adults, respectively —the living and the dead reunite as the latter return from Mictlán, the name given by ancient Mexicans to the underworld.
paras.zh: 家庭和公共场所的祭坛上摆满了剪纸形状的薄纸、万寿菊花、糖头骨、亡灵面包、水、蜡烛以及逝去亲人最喜欢的食物和饮料等装饰品，以纪念和“欢迎”他们回到生者世界几个小时。根据这一传统，每年的 11 月 1 日和 11 月 2 日（分别纪念儿童和成人）生者和死者会重聚，死者会从米克特兰（Mictlán）返回，米克特兰是古代墨西哥人对地下世界的称呼。

paras.en: In this celebration, death does not represent an absence but a living presence: a symbol of life that materializes in the altar, offered to those who are no longer with us. It is a colorful occasion with significant popular resonance, encompassing a wide range of meanings, from philosophical to material.
paras.zh: 在这场庆祝活动中，死亡并不代表缺席，而是一种活生生的存在：生命的象征在祭坛上实体化，献给那些不再与我们在一起的人。这是一个丰富多彩的场合，引起了广泛的共鸣，涵盖了从哲学到物质的广泛含义。

paras.en: From cumbia to rock, rancheras, huapango and pop, artists like Chavela Vargas, Natalia Lafourcade, Carlos Rivera, Vicente Fernández, Luis Ángel “El Flaco,” Roco Pachukote, Silvana Estrada, Son Rompepera, Pehuenche and Renee Mooi have recorded songs exploring themes like absence, memories, love and hope, all of which deeply resonate with this popular celebration.
paras.zh: 从坎比亚音乐到摇滚、牧场音乐、瓦潘戈和流行音乐，查韦拉·巴尔加斯、纳塔利娅·拉福卡德、卡洛斯·里维拉、文森特·费尔南德斯、路易斯·安赫尔“El Flaco”、罗科·帕丘科特、西尔瓦娜·埃斯特拉达、Son Rompepera、Pehuenche 和 Renee Mooi 等艺术家录制了探索缺席、记忆、爱和希望等主题的歌曲，所有这些都与这个流行的庆祝活动产生了深刻的共鸣。

paras.en: Here are 10 of the best songs, both old and new, to celebrate this Día de Muertos with.
paras.zh: 这里有 10 首最好的新老歌曲，用来庆祝亡灵节。

paras.en: - Chavela Vargas, “La Llorona” One of the most well-known songs from the traditional Mexican repertoire, it originates from the Isthmus of Tehuantepec region in Oaxaca. The most famous version is by the late singer of Costa Rican origin, Chavela Vargas. Other performers who have also lent their voices to this classic include Mexican artists Lila Downs, Aída Cuevas and Natalia Lafourcade. In recent years, the song has gained popularity among younger generations, thanks to Ángela Aguilar, who delivered a masterful rendition.
paras.zh: - Chavela Vargas，“La Llorona” 墨西哥传统曲目中最著名的歌曲之一，它起源于瓦哈卡州特万特佩克地区的地峡。最著名的版本是已故哥斯达黎加裔歌手查韦拉·巴尔加斯 (Chavela Vargas) 的版本。其他也为这部经典作品配音的表演者包括墨西哥艺术家 Lila Downs、Aída Cuevas 和 Natalia Lafourcade。近年来，这首歌在安吉拉·阿吉拉尔的精湛演绎下，在年轻一代中广受欢迎。

paras.en: - Carlos Rivera, “Recuérdame” It’s one of the main songs from Disney Pixar’s celebrated animated film Coco. Mexican singer Carlos Rivera recorded the Spanish version for Latin America, while American artist Miguel and Mexican singer Natalia Lafourcade performed it for English-speaking audiences as “Remember Me.” The song was also performed by Gael García Bernal in the film, and live during the Oscars ceremony, where it won the award for best original song in 2018.
paras.zh: - 卡洛斯·里维拉，《Recuérdame》 这是迪士尼皮克斯著名动画电影《寻梦环游记》中的主要歌曲之一。墨西哥歌手卡洛斯·里维拉（Carlos Rivera）为拉丁美洲录制了西班牙语版本，而美国艺术家米格尔（Miguel）和墨西哥歌手娜塔莉亚·拉福卡德（Natalia Lafourcade）为英语观众表演了《记住我》（Remember Me）。盖尔·加西亚·贝纳尔 (Gael García Bernal) 在电影中演唱了这首歌，并在奥斯卡颁奖典礼上进行了现场表演，并获得了 2018 年最佳原创歌曲奖。

paras.en: - Roco Pachukote, Maldita Vecindad y Los Hijos del 5to Patio, Legend Medicina Sónica & La India Colombia, “Piel de Obsidiana la Cumbia del Xoloitzcuintle” In his capacity as a solo artist, the frontman of the Mexican rock band Maldita Vecindad presents a celebratory tribute to the pre-Hispanic Xoloitzcuintli dog, joined by his bandmates from Maldita Vecindad, as well as La India Colombia and Legend Medicina Sónica. The track — which fuses bullerengue, cumbia, ska and funk — was released on Tuesday (Oct. 27), the national day dedicated to this ancient canine, whose presence in the ancestral Mexican imagination is deeply intertwined with life, death and spiritual companionship. According to pre-Hispanic mythology, the Xolo serves as a guide for souls on their journey to Mictlán.
paras.zh: - Roco Pachukote、Maldita Vecindad y Los Hijos del 5to Patio、Legend Medicina Sónica 和 La India Columbia、“Piel de Obsidiana la Cumbia del Xoloitzcuintle” 墨西哥摇滚乐队 Maldita Vecindad 的主唱以独奏艺术家的身份，与来自 Maldita 的乐队成员一起向前西班牙裔 Xoloitzcuintli 狗致敬Vecindad、La India Columbia 和 Legend Medicina Sónica。这首融合了 bullerengue、cumbia、ska 和 funk 的歌曲于周二（10 月 27 日）发行，这一天是纪念这种古老犬类的国庆节，它在墨西哥祖先的想象中与生、死和精神陪伴深深交织在一起。根据前西班牙神话，Xolo 是灵魂前往米克特兰之旅的向导。

paras.en: - Silvana Estrada, “Un Rayo de Luz” “How beautiful death must be, for no one has ever returned from there,” sings a melancholic Silvana Estrada on this track, featured on her acclaimed 2025 album Vendrán Suaves Lluvias. The Mexican singer-songwriter wrote this song in memory of her friends Jorge and Andrés Tirado, who were victims of homicide in Mexico City. Following months of creative block in the wake of her friends’ deaths, Estrada managed to find inspiration during a residency at the Home of Chavela Vargas in 2024, as she revealed in an interview with Billboard Español.
paras.zh: - Silvana Estrada，“Un Rayo de Luz” “死亡一定是多么美丽，因为没有人从那里回来，”在这首歌曲中，忧郁的 Silvana Estrada 唱道，这首歌收录在她广受好评的 2025 年专辑《Vendrán Suaves Lluvias》中。这位墨西哥歌手兼作曲家写这首歌是为了纪念她的朋友豪尔赫·蒂拉多和安德烈斯·蒂拉多，他们是墨西哥城凶杀案的受害者。埃斯特拉达 (Estrada) 在接受西班牙公告牌采访时透露，朋友去世后，经历了数月的创作停滞，2024 年，埃斯特拉达 (Estrada) 在 Chavela Vargas 之家驻场期间终于找到了灵感。

paras.en: - Lupita Infante, “Flores del Camposanto” The American singer — granddaughter of the iconic Mexican actor and singer Pedro Infante — delivers a majestic, mariachi-style rendition of this song, which was written by Luis Rosado Vega and performed in 1986 by the late Mexican singer-songwriter and musician Óscar Chávez. Infante recorded the piece as a tribute to those who have “departed” and to the place where they rest: the cemetery.
paras.zh: - Lupita Infante，“Flores del Camposanto” 这位美国歌手是墨西哥标志性演员和歌手 Pedro Infante 的孙女，以墨西哥流浪乐队风格演绎了这首歌曲，这首歌由 Luis Rosado Vega 创作，并于 1986 年由已故墨西哥歌手兼作曲家和音乐家 Óscar Chávez 演唱。因凡特录制这首曲子是为了向那些“离开”的人们以及他们安息的地方：墓地致敬。

paras.en: - Carlos Rivera, “Calavera” For this song, the Mexican artist chose to go beyond the usual satire, focusing instead on a deeper reflection on death — a “true calavera” (skull) — in which the rawness and beauty of death are intertwined. The song captures the opening of Mictlán — the underworld according to the Mexica worldview — and employs a diverse array of instrumentation, including rattles, teponaztli (slit drums), psalteries, guitars, guitarrón, vihuela, flutes, trumpets and a string quartet.
paras.zh: - 卡洛斯·里维拉（Carlos Rivera），“卡拉维拉” 对于这首歌，这位墨西哥艺术家选择超越通常的讽刺，而是专注于对死亡的更深层次反思——“真正的卡拉维拉”（头骨）——其中死亡的原始和美丽交织在一起。这首歌抓住了 Mictlán（墨西加世界观中的地下世界）的开头，并采用了多种乐器，包括拨浪鼓、teponaztli（狭缝鼓）、诗篇、吉他、吉他手、维韦拉、长笛、小号和弦乐四重奏。

paras.en: - Pehuenche & Renee Mooi, “El Vacío” Mexican musicians Pehuenche and Renee Mooi join forces on “El Vacío,” which arrives on digital platforms this Friday (Oct. 30). The song — featuring folk-inspired sounds presented in a contemporary style — explores the pain of losing a romantic partner, and the process of rebuilding oneself from a place of vulnerability. The track draws upon the Mexican musical roots that define Pehuenche’s work, transforming grief into a quest for identity and rebirth.
paras.zh: - Pehuenche 和 Renee Mooi，“El Vacío” 墨西哥音乐家 Pehuenche 和 Renee Mooi 联手制作“El Vacío”，该歌曲将于本周五（10 月 30 日）登陆数字平台。这首歌以现代风格呈现民谣风格的声音，探讨了失去浪漫伴侣的痛苦，以及从脆弱的地方重建自己的过程。这首歌借鉴了 Pehuenche 作品的墨西哥音乐根源，将悲伤转化为对身份和重生的追求。

paras.en: - Vicente Fernández & Luis Ángel “El Flaco,” “Cuando Yo Quería Ser Grande” A new version of a classic by ranchera icon Vicente Fernández, this track was re-released last September as part of the album Tributo al Rey con Banda (Grandes Duetos Vol. 2), featuring a special rendition alongside Luis Ángel “El Flaco.” The song explores themes of childhood, love for one’s parents and the memories that stay with us throughout our lives.
paras.zh: - Vicente Fernández 和 Luis Ángel “El Flaco”、“Cuando Yo Quería Ser Grande” 这首歌曲是牧场偶像 Vicente Fernández 经典作品的新版本，去年 9 月作为专辑 Tributo al Rey con Banda (Grandes Duetos Vol. 2) 的一部分重新发行，与 Luis Ángel “El Flaco” 一起进行了特别演绎。这首歌探讨了童年、对父母的爱以及伴随我们一生的记忆的主题。

paras.en: - Son Rompepera & La Pambelé, “José Dolores” In this song, the Gama brothers pay a posthumous tribute to their father, musician José Dolores Gama, from whom they inherited a passion for the marimba — an instrument that has become their signature, and which they have fused with punk, cumbia and garage music in their musical project. The track was included on their third and latest album, Marimbazos de Oro, released in September. “And it will be your marimba that carries on your legacy,” the band sings in honor of their mentor.
paras.zh: - Son Rompepera & La Pambelé，“José Dolores” 在这首歌中，伽马兄弟向他们的父亲、音乐家何塞·多洛雷斯·伽马（José Dolores Gama）致敬，他们从父亲那里继承了对马林巴琴的热情——这种乐器已成为他们的标志性乐器，并且他们在他们的音乐项目中将马林巴琴与朋克、坎比亚和车库音乐融合在一起。这首歌曲收录在他们九月份发行的第三张也是最新专辑《Marimbazos de Oro》中。 “这将是你的马林巴继承你的遗产，”乐队唱道纪念他们的导师。

paras.en: - Enrique Bunbury, “Creer Que Se Puede Creer” The opening track of Enrique Bunbury’s album De Un Siglo Anterior, released in April, embodies the hope and strength required to keep believing, even during difficult times. The song offers an intimate reflection on personal faith, the search for meaning and the need to move forward without compromising one’s own values — at a time when uncertainty seems to define the collective pulse.
paras.zh: - Enrique Bunbury，“Creer Que Se Puede Creer” Enrique Bunbury 于四月发行的专辑《De Un Siglo Anterior》的开场曲体现了即使在困难时期也能保持信念所需的希望和力量。这首歌深刻地反映了个人信仰、对意义的追求以及在不妥协自己价值观的情况下前进的需要——在这个不确定性似乎决定了集体脉搏的时代。

articles.title: Here’s When ‘Alan Jackson: The Last Show’ Is Coming to TV Screens & Streaming
articles.author: Jessica Nicholson

paras.en: On June 27, Country Music Hall of Famer Alan Jackson sold out Nashville’s Nissan Stadium, as tens of thousands of fans filled the venue and thousands more gathered on Broadway downtown to watch livestreams of Jackson’s final concert as he celebrated his decades of influence on country music. He had previously retired from the road, following a diagnosis of Charcot Marie Tooth Disease, but celebrated with that one final show at Nashville’s Nissan Stadium in June.
paras.zh: 6 月 27 日，乡村音乐名人堂成员艾伦·杰克逊 (Alan Jackson) 的纳什维尔日产体育场 (Nissan Stadium) 门票全部售罄，数以万计的歌迷挤满了场馆，还有数千人聚集在市中心百老汇观看杰克逊最后一场音乐会的直播，庆祝他对乡村音乐数十年的影响。此前，在诊断出患有腓骨肌萎缩症后，他已经退出了职业生涯，但他还是于六月在纳什维尔的日产体育场举行了最后一场演出来庆祝。

paras.en: On Dec. 8, fans who didn’t get to see the show will be able to take in the special event, when NBC airs Alan Jackson: The Last Show from 8 to 10 p.m. ET/PT. The special will also stream the following day on Peacock.
paras.zh: 12 月 8 日，没有观看该节目的粉丝将能够参加这项特别活动，届时 NBC 将在晚上 8 点至 10 点播出《艾伦·杰克逊：最后一场秀》。 ET/PT。该特别节目也将于第二天在 Peacock 上播出。

paras.en: The concert features Jackson offering a headlining set that includes his classic hits such as “Chattahoochee,” “Remember When” and “It’s Five O’Clock Somewhere.”
paras.zh: 杰克逊在这场音乐会上带来了一系列头条新闻，其中包括他的经典热门歌曲，如“Chattahoochee”、“Remember When”和“It’s Five O’Clock Somewhere”。

paras.en: Jackson will also be joined by fellow country stars including Luke Bryan, Eric Church, Luke Combs, Riley Green, Cody Johnson, Miranda Lambert, Little Big Town, Jake Owen, Jon Pardi, Thomas Rhett, Carrie Underwood, Lainey Wilson, Lee Ann Womack and Adam Wright. The upcoming concert telecast will also feature Jackson in a special collaboration with George Strait; during that June show, Strait had joined Jackson for performances of “Designated Drinker” and “Murder on Music Row.” Throughout that evening, the country music community and fans joined to celebrate Jackson’s nearly 40 years of making country music hits.
paras.zh: 杰克逊还将与其他乡村明星一起加入，包括卢克·布莱恩、埃里克·丘奇、卢克·库姆斯、莱利·格林、科迪·约翰逊、米兰达·兰伯特、Little Big Town、杰克·欧文、乔恩·帕迪、托马斯·瑞特、凯莉·安德伍德、莱尼·威尔逊、李·安·沃马克和亚当·赖特。即将到来的音乐会电视转播还将由杰克逊与乔治·斯特雷特进行特别合作；在那场六月的演出中，斯特雷特与杰克逊一起表演了《指定饮酒者》和《音乐街谋杀案》。整个晚上，乡村音乐界和歌迷齐聚一堂，庆祝杰克逊近 40 年来创作乡村音乐热门歌曲。

paras.en: “If anybody’s living a really good dream … I’m living it,” Jackson said during that show. “I just want to thank everybody, especially all of you fans … y’all have been so supportive of my music all of these years … y’all always treated me nice and respected the music.”
paras.zh: “如果有人实现了一个真正美好的梦想……我就实现了它，”杰克逊在那场演出中说道。 “我只想感谢所有人，尤其是所有歌迷……这些年来你们一直非常支持我的音乐……你们总是对我很好并尊重音乐。”

paras.en: The concert’s music will also be featured on Jackson’s upcoming live album, The Last Show: One More for the Road – The Finale (Live From Nashville), which will release via MCA just before the broadcast. Alan Jackson: The Last Show is produced by Joan of Arc StudioWorks and EverWonder Studio, and directed by Sam Wrench.
paras.zh: 这场音乐会的音乐也将出现在杰克逊即将推出的现场专辑《The Last Show: One More for the Road – The Finale (Live From Nashville)》中，该专辑将在播出前通过 MCA 发行。 《艾伦·杰克逊：最后一场》由 Joan of Arc StudioWorks 和 EverWonder Studio 制作，萨姆·扳手执导。

articles.title: Snoop Dogg’s ‘Doggyland’ Expanding Children’s Book Series (Exclusive First Look)
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: Snoop Dogg‘s Doggyland is expanding its children’s book offerings over the next few months, and The Hollywood Reporter has an exclusive first look at the new installments.
paras.zh: 史努比狗狗 (Snoop Dogg) 的狗狗乐园 (Doggyland) 将在未来几个月内扩大其儿童图书供应，《好莱坞报道》独家抢先报道了新的几期图书。

paras.en: The books are a tie-in with Snoop Dogg’s animated YouTube series Doggyland, which was co-created by Snoop Dogg, Emmy-nominated producer and creator Claude Brooks and Grammy-winning artist and producer October London. The show features a cast of dogs who sing, rap and dance to fun and educational songs that promote social-emotional and cognitive development in young children. Since its inception in 2022, Doggyland has produced a variety of educational songs about affirmations, letters, numbers, colors, animals, good habits and accepting others. The series focuses on delivering positive messages through music and storytelling, making learning an enjoyable experience for young viewers.
paras.zh: 这些书与史努比狗狗 (Snoop Dogg) 的 YouTube 动画系列《Doggyland》搭配，该系列由史努比狗狗 (Snoop Dogg)、艾美奖提名制作人兼创作者克劳德·布鲁克斯 (Claude Brooks) 以及格莱美获奖艺术家兼制作人 October London 共同创作。该节目的演员们会随着有趣且具有教育意义的歌曲唱歌、说唱和跳舞，促进幼儿的社交情感和认知发展。自 2022 年成立以来，Doggyland 制作了各种关于肯定、字母、数字、颜色、动物、良好习惯和接受他人的教育歌曲。该剧专注于通过音乐和讲故事传递积极的信息，让年轻观众享受学习的乐趣。

paras.en: Five Doggyland books will be published this year via Little Bee Books: Affirmations Song, Family Barbecue, The Counting Numbers Song Sound Book, Jingle Bells and The Ultimate Sticker and Activity Book. Jingle Bells also launches the board book series this fall, followed by Hello, Good Morning and I Am Me in the spring.
paras.zh: 今年将通过 Little Bee Books 出版五本 Doggyland 书籍：《肯定之歌》、《家庭烧烤》、《计数数字歌曲有声书》、《铃儿响叮当》以及《终极贴纸和活动书》。 《铃儿响叮当》还在今年秋季推出了纸板书系列，随后在春季推出了《你好，早安》和《我是我》。

paras.en: “I can’t wait for the world to be able to pick up our new set of Doggyland books,” Snoop Dogg tells THR exclusively. “We got Jingle Bells on deck to get everyone into that holiday vibe, you know the Doggyland puppies just love giving gifts. We also have The Ultimate Sticker and Activity Book which is just a whole bundle of fun and in the palm of your hands. Comes stacked with games you can play and stickers of all the Doggyland fam. And as if that wasn’t enough we also have two more amazing titles for you, Good Morning and I Am Me, which are both simmering with positive affirmations and good vibes to make sure all the kids out there know that they’re worthy and amazing.”
paras.zh: “我迫不及待地希望全世界都能买到我们的《狗狗乐园》新书，”史努比狗狗独家告诉 THR。 “我们准备了《铃儿响叮当》，让每个人都沉浸在节日氛围中，你知道，Doggyland 小狗们都喜欢送礼物。我们还有《终极贴纸》和活动书，这一切都在你的手掌中，充满乐趣。里面堆满了你可以玩的游戏和所有 Doggyland 家人的贴纸。似乎这还不够，我们还为你准备了另外两款令人惊叹的游戏，《早安》和《我是我》，这两款游戏都充满了积极的肯定和美好的感觉。确保所有孩子都知道他们是值得的和令人惊叹的。”

paras.en: Added Brooks: “We love getting families singing and dancing together and we’re excited to get them turning pages together, too. These four books carry the same joy and positive energy as our music with a message we want every child to hear: you matter, you belong and there’s something special about being you.”
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯补充道：“我们喜欢让家人一起唱歌跳舞，我们也很高兴让他们一起翻页。这四本书与我们的音乐一样承载着欢乐和积极的能量，传递着我们希望每个孩子都能听到的信息：你很重要，你有归属感，做你自己有一些特别的东西。”

paras.en: Of the new offerings, first up is The Ultimate Sticker and Activity Book, which is on sale as of Oct. 27. The book features coloring pages, puzzles, mazes, more than 500 stickers and other activities. Take a look inside the book below.
paras.zh: 在新产品中，首先推出的是《终极贴纸和活动书》，将于 10 月 27 日开始发售。这本书包含着色页、拼图、迷宫、超过 500 个贴纸和其他活动。看看下面这本书的内容。

paras.en: The Jingle Bells board book follows Bow Wizzle (Snoop Dogg’s character in the series) and the Doggyland pups as they cruise through town on a Christmas adventure filled with holiday cheer, gift giving, music and community spirit. The book, which is shaped like Doggyland leader Bow Wizzle’s lowrider sleigh, supports social emotional learning through themes of connection, generosity, and caring for others. Take a look below.
paras.zh: 《铃儿响叮当》纸板书讲述了 Bow Wizzle（史努比狗狗系列中的角色）和 Doggyland 小狗在小镇中巡游，踏上充满节日欢乐、送礼、音乐和社区精神的圣诞冒险之旅。这本书的形状像 Doggyland 领袖 Bow Wizzle 的低雪橇，通过联系、慷慨和关心他人等主题支持社交情感学习。看看下面。

paras.en: Hello, Good Morning follows the Doggyland pups as they start their day in a “paws-itive” way. Take a look below.
paras.zh: 《你好，早安》跟随 Doggyland 小狗们以“爪子式”的方式开始新的一天。看看下面。

paras.en: In I Am Me, Bow Wizzle and the pups practice being true to themselves and celebrate what makes them unique. Take a look below.
paras.zh: 在《我就是我》中，鲍威兹和小狗们练习忠于自己，并庆祝自己的独特之处。看看下面。

paras.en: The books will be available for purchase at book retailers throughout the U.S. and Canada and online.
paras.zh: 这些书籍可在美国和加拿大各地的图书零售商处以及网上购买。

paras.en: In addition, a holiday-themed Doggyland event is set for 3 p.m. Dec. 12 at B&N Americana at Brand in Glendale, California. The event will feature a storytime with Brooks and a performance/sing-along by Doggyland‘s cast of costumed characters (including Snoop Dogg’s lead character, Bow Wizzle). There will be photo-ops and stamped autographs by the characters following the show.
paras.zh: 此外，下午 3 点还将举办以假日为主题的 Doggyland 活动。 12 月 12 日，加利福尼亚州格伦代尔的 B&N Americana at Brand。该活动将以布鲁克斯的故事时间和 Doggyland 的服装角色演员（包括 Snoop Dogg 的主角 Bow Wizzle）表演/唱歌为特色。演出结束后，角色们将会合影留念并盖上亲笔签名。

articles.title: Jesse Sisgold Exits Skydance for Role at RedBird Capital Partners
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: Skydance is losing one of its longest-tenured executives.
paras.zh: Skydance 即将失去一位任职时间最长的高管。

paras.en: Jesse Sisgold, the former president and COO of Skydance Media, who most recently ran Paramount’s Paramount Sports Entertainment division, is exiting the company. He will join RedBird Capital Partners, a strategic partner of Skydance, as a senior C-suite advisor across the firm’s sports and entertainment portfolio.
paras.zh: Skydance Media 前总裁兼首席运营官、最近负责派拉蒙派拉蒙体育娱乐部门的杰西·西斯戈尔德 (Jesse Sisgold) 即将退出该公司。他将加入 Skydance 的战略合作伙伴 RedBird Capital Partners，担任该公司体育和娱乐投资组合的高级高管顾问。

paras.en: Skydance CEO David Ellison informed staff of Sisgold’s exit in a memo Wednesday, which was viewed by The Hollywood Reporter.
paras.zh: Skydance 首席执行官大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 在周三的一份备忘录中向员工通报了西斯戈尔德的退出，《好莱坞报道》看到了该备忘录。

paras.en: “I simply could not have built Skydance without him,” Ellison wrote in the note. “From the earliest days, he helped define our strategy and then did the hard work of making it real. He was integral to building our interactive business, raised the capital that fueled our growth and forged relationships that fundamentally changed the trajectory of the company – with Tencent, RedBird, CJ ENM and KKR. He helped us establish Skydance Animation Madrid and ultimately helped lead us through the merger with Paramount. There are very few parts of Skydance that Jesse hasn’t touched, shaped or made better.”
paras.zh: “没有他，我根本不可能建立 Skydance，”埃里森在笔记中写道。 “从一开始，他就帮助我们制定了战略，然后为实现这一战略付出了艰辛的努力。他是我们互动业务建设中不可或缺的一部分，筹集了资金，推动了我们的发展，并与腾讯、红鸟、CJ ENM 和 KKR 建立了从根本上改变公司发展轨迹的关系。他帮助我们建立了 Skydance 动画马德里公司，并最终帮助我们完成了与派拉蒙的合并。Skydance 的几乎所有部分都是 Jesse 没有触及、塑造或改进的。”

paras.en: Sisgold joined Skydance in 2014 to lead strategy and business affairs, and was elevated to COO later that year. He also led Skydance Sports, until the creation of Paramount Sports Entertainment when Skydance acquired Paramount last year.
paras.zh: Sisgold 于 2014 年加入 Skydance 负责战略和业务事务，并于当年晚些时候晋升为首席运营官。他还领导过 Skydance Sports，直到去年 Skydance 收购派拉蒙，派拉蒙体育娱乐公司 (Paramount Sports Entertainment) 成立。

paras.en: I wanted to share some news with you about someone who has been by my side for much of what we’ve built at Skydance – my longtime colleague and close friend, Jesse Sisgold. After more than a decade helping build Skydance from the ground up, Jesse has made the decision to step away from his official role at the company. But thankfully, he’s not going far.
paras.zh: 我想与大家分享一些关于 Skydance 的大部分工作中一直陪伴在我身边的人的消息，他就是我的长期同事和亲密朋友 Jesse Sisgold。在帮助 Skydance 从头开始​​创建十多年后，杰西决定辞去他在公司的正式职务。但值得庆幸的是，他并没有走得太远。

paras.en: You can’t tell the story of Skydance without Jesse. He helped start this company with me. When we were 14 people working out of a bungalow on the Paramount Lot, Jesse was there – helping imagine, build and shape the future we’re living today.
paras.zh: 如果没有杰西，你就无法讲述 Skydance 的故事。他和我一起创办了这家公司。当我们 14 个人在派拉蒙地段的一间平房里工作时，杰西就在那里 - 帮助想象、建设和塑造我们今天生活的未来。

paras.en: He also joined Skydance at a time when it was, in every sense of the word, a family business. His father-in-law, Skip Brittenham, was one of my earliest advisors in Hollywood and someone who had an enormous impact on me. When we lost Skip last year, it was a powerful reminder of how much those early relationships matter – and how fortunate I’ve been to have people like Jesse beside me through so much of it.
paras.zh: 他加入 Skydance 的时候，从任何意义上来说，Skydance 都是一家家族企业。他的岳父斯基普·布里特纳姆 (Skip Brittenham) 是我在好莱坞最早的顾问之一，也是对我产生了巨大影响的人。去年我们失去了斯基普，这有力地提醒我们，那些早期的关系有多么重要——以及我是多么幸运，有像杰西这样的人在我身边度过了这么多的时光。

paras.en: I simply could not have built Skydance without him. From the earliest days, he helped define our strategy and then did the hard work of making it real. He was integral to building our interactive business, raised the capital that fueled our growth and forged relationships that fundamentally changed the trajectory of the company – with Tencent, RedBird, CJ ENM and KKR. He helped us establish Skydance Animation Madrid and ultimately helped lead us through the merger with Paramount. There are very few parts of Skydance that Jesse hasn’t touched, shaped or made better.
paras.zh: 没有他，我根本不可能创建 Skydance。从一开始，他就帮助我们制定战略，然后努力将其变为现实。他在建立我们的互动业务方面发挥了重要作用，筹集了资金来推动我们的发展，并与腾讯、RedBird、CJ ENM 和 KKR 建立了从根本上改变公司发展轨迹的关系。他帮助我们建立了 Skydance 动画马德里，并最终帮助我们完成了与派拉蒙的合并。 Skydance 的几乎所有部分都是 Jesse 没有触及、塑造或改进的。

paras.en: And then, because Jesse is Jesse, he set out to do even more.
paras.zh: 然后，因为杰西就是杰西，他开始做更多的事情。

paras.en: Jesse was instrumental in creating Skydance Sports with the NFL, and following our merger with Paramount, he expanded that foundation into Paramount Sports Entertainment, building it into a unified platform spanning sports storytelling, gaming and fan engagement. Under his leadership, Skydance Sports renewed its partnership with the NFL, earned ten Sports Emmy nominations and delivered #1 releases across four platforms. He leaves the business with a clear strategy, an exceptional team and a slate that continues to raise the bar.
paras.zh: 杰西在与 NFL 共同创建 Skydance Sports 方面发挥了重要作用，在我们与派拉蒙合并后，他将该基础扩展到派拉蒙体育娱乐公司，将其打造成一个涵盖体育故事讲述、游戏和粉丝参与的统一平台。在他的领导下，Skydance Sports 续签了与 NFL 的合作伙伴关系，获得了十项体育艾美奖提名，并在四个平台上发布了排名第一的作品。 He leaves the business with a clear strategy, an exceptional team and a slate that continues to raise the bar.

paras.en: It’s the kind of work you’d expect from him, because if you know Jesse, you know he’s a builder and an entrepreneur at heart. He loves seeing around corners, finding the next opportunity and figuring out how to turn an idea into something real. After more than a decade of doing exactly that here, he wants the freedom to do it across a much broader landscape. I understand that, and I’m excited for him.
paras.zh: 这是你对他的期望，因为如果你了解杰西，你就会知道他本质上是一名建设者和企业家。他喜欢观察周围的情况，寻找下一个机会，并找出如何将想法变成现实的方法。在这里做了十多年之后，他希望能够在更广阔的领域自由地做到这一点。我理解这一点，我为他感到兴奋。

paras.en: And there’s something fitting about where Jesse is headed next.
paras.zh: 杰西下一步的发展方向也很合适。

paras.en: In 2019, Jesse, Gerry Cardinale and I sat down together. None of us knew exactly where it would lead, but what grew out of that meeting would help transform Skydance – and Gerry would become a great partner and friend along the way. Now Jesse will serve as a senior C-suite advisor to Gerry and the RedBird team across their sports and entertainment portfolio, based in Beverly Hills. And importantly for us, he’ll remain close to Skydance and continue working with us on sports and entertainment opportunities.
paras.zh: 2019 年，杰西、格里·卡迪纳尔和我坐在一起。我们谁也不知道它会走向何方，但那次会议的成果将有助于改造 Skydance——而 Gerry 将成为一路上伟大的合作伙伴和朋友。现在，杰西将担任格里和红鸟团队在比佛利山庄的体育和娱乐投资组合的高级首席顾问。对我们来说重要的是，他将与 Skydance 保持密切联系，并继续与我们在体育和娱乐机会方面合作。

paras.en: So while Jesse is stepping away from his official role, I don’t really think of this as Jesse leaving Skydance. He helped build this place. He is part of its DNA. And he will always be part of this family.
