The community’s first promise to voters, he said, was to prevent “this gang of criminals” from returning to power, naming Netanyahu and far-right ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Ben-Gvir. “So our first promise, we can keep it from now .”
paras.zh: “我们为以色列的阿拉伯巴勒斯坦少数民族感到非常自豪，他们的投票比例非常高，”他告诉半岛电视台。他说，该社区对选民的第一个承诺是防止“这帮犯罪团伙”重新掌权，并点名内塔尼亚胡和极右翼部长贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇和本·格维尔。 “所以我们的第一个承诺，从现在开始我们就可以兑现了。”

paras.en: Numbers point to Arab parties but opposition bloc resistant
paras.zh: 数字显示阿拉伯政党支持，但反对派集团抵制

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh, reporting from Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, said Netanyahu “has scared off everybody from talking to the Palestinian Israeli parties”, leaving him best placed to “call the shots”. She said that Eisenkot and his allies have indicated that they want a Zionist government and “do not want to form a government” with the Arab parties, leaving them few options.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者努尔·奥迪在被占领的约旦河西岸拉马拉报道称，内塔尼亚胡“吓跑了所有人，不敢与巴勒斯坦以色列各方对话”，让他最适合“发号施令”。她说，艾森科特和他的盟友已经表示，他们想要一个犹太复国主义政府，并且“不想与阿拉伯政党组建政府”，这让他们几乎没有选择。

paras.en: Danny Ayalon, a former Israeli ambassador to the United States, told Al Jazeera that turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel came in “really unprecedented numbers” and that the parties “are going to have some significant clout”.
paras.zh: 前以色列驻美国大使丹尼·阿亚隆告诉半岛电视台，以色列巴勒斯坦公民的投票率“确实是前所未有的”，而且各方“将拥有一些重大影响力”。

paras.en: Mathematically, he said, Eisenkot’s bloc could join forces with the two Arab parties and pass the threshold, though it would take “political wizardry”. Yousef Jabareen, who leads the Joint List, has said his alliance’s “hands are extended” to oust Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 他说，从数学上讲，艾森科特的集团可以与两个阿拉伯政党联手并跨过门槛，尽管这需要“政治魔法”。联合名单领导者优素福·贾巴林表示，他的联盟“已伸出双手”驱逐内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Abu Shehadeh set out what Palestinian citizens want from the next government.
paras.zh: 阿布·谢哈德阐述了巴勒斯坦公民对下一届政府的期望。

paras.en: “We are against genocide and we are against apartheid. We want to promote a different political alternative, one which is based on the values of freedom, justice and equality for both people who are living between the river and the sea.”
paras.zh: “我们反对种族灭绝，我们反对种族隔离。我们希望促进一种不同的政治选择，一种基于生活在河流和海洋之间的人们的自由、正义和平等价值观的政治选择。”

paras.en: Of Netanyahu, he said: “Our problem … is that he is a war criminal.”
paras.zh: 谈到内塔尼亚胡，他说：“我们的问题……是他是一名战犯。”

paras.en: A UN commission said in a report published on Monday that Israel has continued to commit genocide in Gaza after last October’s US-brokered ceasefire in the enclave.
paras.zh: 联合国一个委员会在周一发布的一份报告中表示，去年 10 月美国斡旋在加沙飞地停火后，以色列继续在加沙实施种族灭绝。

paras.en: The Hague-based International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu in 2024 for war crimes during the Gaza war.
paras.zh: 总部位于海牙的国际刑事法院于 2024 年对内塔尼亚胡发出逮捕令，罪名是在加沙战争期间犯下战争罪。

articles.title: Trump's relationship with Putin comes under fire ahead of the midterms
articles.author: Franco Ordoñez

paras.en: Trump's relationship with Putin comes under fire ahead of the midterms
paras.zh: 特朗普与普京的关系在中期选举前受到批评

paras.en: President Trump's relationship with Russia's Vladimir Putin is under scrutiny again as the president makes deals with Moscow ahead of the midterms.
paras.zh: 随着特朗普总统在中期选举前与莫斯科达成协议，他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的关系再次受到密切关注。

paras.en: President Trump's relationship with Russia's Vladimir Putin is in question again. So is Trump's political judgment with less than a week before Election Day. The administration argues Trump is striking deals with Russia on things such as diesel to bring economic relief to Americans, but it's also testing the limits of his party's loyalty. NPR White House correspondent Franco Ordoñez is following this. Franco, so how does a history between Trump and Putin inform where they've ended up?
paras.zh: 特朗普总统与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的关系再次受到质疑。距离选举日不到一周，特朗普的政治判断也是如此。政府认为，特朗普正在与俄罗斯就柴油等问题达成协议，为美国人带来经济救济，但这也在考验其政党忠诚度的极限。 NPR 白宫记者 Franco Ordoñez 正在追踪此事。佛朗哥，那么特朗普和普京之间的历史如何告诉我们他们的结局呢？

paras.en: FRANCO ORDOÑEZ, BYLINE: Yeah, A, the relationship really has run hot and cold for many, many years. And while it did cool a bit last year after Trump himself acknowledged the possibility that he was being played by Putin, it's really warmed more recently as Trump looks for help with the domestic economy. I mean, you mentioned the deal for Russian diesel. Trump also waved sanctions that target Russian officials and banks. At the same time, he's blasting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 弗兰科·奥尔多埃斯连线：是的，A，我们的关系确实时冷时热很多很多年了。去年，在特朗普本人承认自己可能被普京玩弄后，经济确实有所降温，但随着特朗普寻求国内经济方面的帮助，经济最近确实有所回暖。我的意思是，你提到了俄罗斯柴油交易。特朗普还取消了针对俄罗斯官员和银行的制裁。与此同时，他还抨击乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Now, you mentioned how Trump said there was a chance that Putin was playing him last year. What about now? How does it - feel about it now?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：现在，你提到特朗普去年说普京有可能在玩弄他。那现在呢？现在感觉怎么样？

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Well, I mean, it's a really important question because that's being asked by many people right now. I spoke to Richard Fontaine, who served in the George W. Bush White House and now runs the Center for a New American Security. He told me it's important to remember that before becoming president, Putin was a KGB officer, where he was basically trained to do this just thing.
paras.zh: 奥尔多内斯：嗯，我的意思是，这是一个非常重要的问题，因为现在很多人都在问这个问题。我采访了理查德·方丹（Richard Fontaine），他曾在乔治·W·布什（George W. Bush）白宫任职，现在负责新美国安全中心。他告诉我，重要的是要记住，在成为总统之前，普京是一名克格勃官员，他基本上接受了做这件事的训练。

paras.en: RICHARD FONTAINE: Certainly, the Russians are trying to take advantage of this moment. I think they see an opportunity here, one that may be relatively fleeting because the midterms are not too far away, to try to offer something to the president that would not only potentially help with his problem, but certainly help with theirs.
paras.zh: 理查德·方丹：当然，俄罗斯人正试图利用这个时机。我认为他们在这里看到了一个机会，这个机会可能相对短暂，因为中期选举已经不远了，试图向总统提供一些东西，不仅可能有助于解决他的问题，而且肯定有助于解决他们的问题。

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Now, the problem that Trump has, at least Fontaine says, is it doesn't look like the U.S. is getting much out of this diesel deal. The price of diesel hasn't really budged much since the deal was made. So not much relief for people at the gas tank.
paras.zh: 奥多内斯：至少方丹说，现在特朗普面临的问题是，美国似乎并没有从这项柴油交易中获得太多好处。自交易达成以来，柴油价格并没有太大变化。因此，油箱旁的人们并没有多少缓解。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: But politically, I mean, isn't there value in the president doing something?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：但是从政治上来说，我的意思是，总统做某事难道没有价值吗？

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Yeah. It's important for any president, not just Trump, to be seen taking action on the most important issues that voters are most concerned about, and that's certainly been the cost of living, and gas is a part of that. The question is whether voters will reward the effort, especially considering Americans' critical views of Putin.
paras.zh: 奥尔多内斯：是的。对于任何一位总统来说，不仅仅是特朗普，重要的是要让人们看到他们在选民最关心的最重要问题上采取行动，这当然是生活成本，而天然气是其中的一部分。问题是选民是否会奖励这一努力，特别是考虑到美国人对普京的批评观点。

paras.en: Jon McHenry, a Republican pollster, told me it also puts a number of GOP lawmakers in a difficult position.
paras.zh: 共和党民意调查专家乔恩·麦克亨利告诉我，这也让一些共和党议员陷入了困境。

paras.en: JON MCHENRY: Because on the one hand, they don't want to cross or seem to cross President Trump, who's really important to midterm turnout. But on the other hand, most of them are pretty well established as being against Russia's attacks on Ukraine, against Putin in general.
paras.zh: 乔恩·麦克亨利：因为一方面，他们不想或似乎与特朗普总统发生冲突，而特朗普总统对中期选举投票率非常重要。但另一方面，他们中的大多数人都反对俄罗斯对乌克兰的攻击，总体上反对普京。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Franco, long term, what could be some of the implications?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：佛朗哥，从长远来看，这可能会产生哪些影响？

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Yeah. I do think that's where it does get more interesting. Fontaine, who worked for Bush, was telling me that in terms of U.S. policy, all this should be looked at as one, basically, moment in time and not an irreversible policy or an indefinite shift in positions. And that's because as we've learned many times before - especially on these issues - that Trump often changes his mind.
paras.zh: 奥尔多内斯：是的。我确实认为这就是它变得更有趣的地方。为布什工作过的方丹告诉我，就美国政策而言，所有这一切基本上都应该被视为一个时间点，而不是一项不可逆转的政策或无限期的立场转变。这是因为正如我们之前多次了解到的那样——尤其是在这些问题上——特朗普经常改变主意。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: That's White House correspondent Franco Ordoñez. Franco, thanks.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：这是白宫记者弗朗哥·奥尔多涅斯。弗兰科，谢谢。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
paras.zh: 西班牙高速列车相撞事故已造成数十人死亡

paras.en: URDA, Spain — One high-speed Spanish train slammed into another that had stopped on the tracks Wednesday, killing at least 68 people and shredding carriages in the country's second deadly rail collision this year.
paras.zh: 西班牙乌尔达——周三，一列西班牙高速列车与另一列停在铁轨上的列车相撞，造成至少 68 人死亡，车厢被粉碎，这是该国今年第二起致命的铁路相撞事故。

paras.en: The regional government for Castilla La Mancha confirmed the death toll and said another 58 people needed medical treatment in hospital. Rescue workers continue to search in the wreckage for survivors and bodies.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚拉曼查地区政府证实了死亡人数，并表示另有 58 人需要在医院接受治疗。救援人员继续在废墟中搜寻幸存者和尸体。

paras.en: The accident comes with memories still fresh of another crash between high-speed trains in southern Spain in January involving trains from the same two companies.
paras.zh: 此次事故发生时，人们对一月份在西班牙南部发生的另一起高速列车相撞事故仍记忆犹新，事故涉及的是同一两家公司的列车。

paras.en: Spain's rail system operator ADIF said the crash occurred Wednesday morning in the province of Toledo, involving two high-speed trains carrying hundreds of passengers and heading in the same direction from the capital Madrid to Seville in southwestern Spain.
paras.zh: 西班牙铁路系统运营商ADIF表示，事故发生在周三早上，发生在托莱多省，两列载有数百名乘客的高速列车从首都马德里向同一方向开往西班牙西南部的塞维利亚。

paras.en: One train, run by the state-owned RENFE company, ran into the tail of the other train owned by private company IRYO that had stopped, knocking two of its cars off the track in a rural area between two villages.
paras.zh: 在两个村庄之间的农村地区，国有 RENFE 公司运营的一列火车撞上了另一辆私营公司 IRYO 所拥有的火车尾部，后者已停止运行，导致两节车厢脱离轨道。

paras.en: David Gómez, a construction worker, was working with his brother and another colleague nearby when they heard the crash and ran to help, he told the newspaper El País.
paras.zh: 建筑工人大卫·戈麦斯 (David Gómez) 告诉《国家报》(El País)，他当时正在与他的兄弟和另一位同事在附近工作，听到坠机声后，他们跑去帮忙。

paras.en: "People were trying to get out through the windows ... We cut through some fences to access the area and treated people with the first-aid kits we had brought," until emergency services arrived, he said. "As I was trying to pull a young woman out, there was a piece of a leg."
paras.zh: 他说：“人们试图从窗户逃出去……我们穿过一些栅栏进入该地区，并用我们带来的急救箱对人们进行治疗，”直到紧急服务人员到达。 “当我试图把一名年轻女子拉出来时，发现有一条腿断了。”

paras.en: Rail service was suspended between Madrid, Ciudad Real and Andalusia.
paras.zh: 马德里、雷阿尔城和安达卢西亚之间的铁路服务暂停。

paras.en: Until this year, there had been no fatal crash on Spain's dedicated high-speed lines since the network opened in 1992. It was a source of national pride.
paras.zh: 自 1992 年开通以来，西班牙专用高速线路至今尚未发生过致命事故。这是民族自豪感的源泉。

paras.en: Transport minister says crash was due to "inexplicable" decision
paras.zh: 交通部长表示事故是由于“莫名其妙”的决定造成的

paras.en: Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente said that the accident was caused by what he called the "inexplicable" order from a central command center for Spain's trains after a security system had failed. He said the train engineers were not to blame.
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特表示，这起事故是由于西班牙火车中央指挥中心在安全系统失效后发出的“莫名其妙”的命令造成的。他说火车工程师不应该受到责备。

paras.en: Puente said that at 8:30 a.m. the security system on a stretch of 63 kilometers (39 miles) stopped working due to a computer malfunction, causing all trains on that stretch to stop. But the central command told the RENFE train to start running again without any speed restrictions, and it ended up colliding with the stopped IRYO train at 8:53 a.m.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，上午8点30分，由于计算机故障，63公里（39英里）范围内的安全系统停止工作，导致该范围内的所有火车停止运行。但中央指挥部要求 RENFE 列车重新开始运行，不受任何速度限制，最终于上午 8 点 53 分与停止运行的 IRYO 列车相撞。

paras.en: Puente said that the train should never have been told to start moving again since there was still a "stop signal" active that line. And if it had, at least it should have been told to go at reduced speed.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，火车根本不应该被告知重新开始行驶，因为该线路仍然有“停止信号”。如果有的话，至少应该告诉它放慢速度。

paras.en: Puente said they were still studying information to see how fast the train was going, but it could have been at 200 kph (124 mph) for that stretch of the track.
paras.zh: Puente 表示，他们仍在研究信息以了解火车的行驶速度，但该路段的行驶速度可能为 200 公里/小时（124 英里/小时）。

paras.en: "I am not attributing responsibility to anyone, I am just stating the facts," Puente said.
paras.zh: “我不会将责任归咎于任何人，我只是陈述事实，”普恩特说。

paras.en: Everything went flying when the trains collided, a passenger said
paras.zh: 一名乘客说，火车相撞时一切都飞了起来

paras.en: The crash, which occurred in a flat stretch surrounded by olive fields in between the towns of Urda and Los Yébenes, left one car torn into bits of metal and other material, scattering debris down a gravel slope.
paras.zh: 事故发生在乌尔达镇和洛斯耶贝内斯镇之间一片橄榄田环绕的平坦地带，一辆汽车被撕成金属和其他材料的碎片，碎片散落到砾石斜坡上。

paras.en: Spanish Health Minister Mónica García said that emergency workers were focusing on rescuing survivors and bodies from the two most damaged train cars. She said that the injured are being sent to different hospitals in the area.
paras.zh: 西班牙卫生部长莫妮卡·加西亚表示，紧急救援人员正在集中精力从两节受损最严重的火车车厢中营救幸存者和尸体。她说，伤者正在被送往该地区的不同医院。

paras.en: "It was a high-speed impact, so we are expecting this to be a tragedy," García said.
paras.zh: 加西亚说：“这是一次高速撞击，因此我们预计这将是一场悲剧。”

paras.en: Passenger Ignacio Relaño was traveling on the RENFE train. He told state broadcaster TVE that the train had stopped momentarily on the line before it started again and then crashed into the IRYO.
paras.zh: 乘客 Ignacio Relaño 乘坐 RENFE 列车。他告诉国家电视台 TVE，火车在线路上短暂停留，然后再次启动，然后撞上了 IRYO。

paras.en: "We all felt the train abruptly slowing down and then the impact," he said. "The car leaned to one side like it was about to tip over. I hit my nose, everything went flying, luggage, cell phones. Everything shook."
paras.zh: “我们都感觉到火车突然减速，然后是撞击，”他说。 “汽车向一侧倾斜，就像要翻倒一样。我撞到了鼻子，所有东西都飞了起来，行李、手机。所有东西都摇晃起来。”

paras.en: Another passenger recounted to Cadena Ser radio how she felt the train slam on the brakes and was thrown forward in her seat, breaking the small table in front of her. She said she saw body parts and trapped people covered in blood.
paras.zh: 另一位乘客向 Cadena Ser 广播电台讲述了她如何感觉到火车猛踩刹车，她的座位被向前抛起，撞碎了她面前的小桌子。她说她看到尸体残骸和被困人员浑身是血。

paras.en: Padilla said that 397 passengers were in the RENFE train and 147 passengers in the IRYO train.
paras.zh: 帕迪拉说，RENFE列车上有397名乘客，IRYO列车上有147名乘客。

paras.en: IRYO, an Italian-owned company, said in a statement that it has "activated its security protocols and is closely working with authorities."
paras.zh: 意大利公司 IRYO 在一份声明中表示，该公司已“启动安全协议，并正在与当局密切合作”。

paras.en: The mayor of the nearby town of Urda, Manuel Galán, said civil protection authorities had asked his officials to prepare a sports pavilion to receive injured passengers.
paras.zh: 附近乌尔达镇的市长曼努埃尔·加兰表示，民防部门已要求其官员准备一个体育场馆来接收受伤乘客。

paras.en: A military emergency brigade was deployed to help emergency services, firefighters and police. Ambulances and medical helicopters made trips to and from the site, while unscathed survivors were put on buses.
paras.zh: 部署了一支军事紧急部队来帮助紧急服务人员、消防员和警察。救护车和医疗直升机往返于现场，而未受伤的幸存者则被送上巴士。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez canceled his agenda to focus on the crash. He wrote on X that he was "dismayed by the serious train accident in Toledo."
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯取消了议程，转而关注坠机事件。他在 X 上写道，他“对托莱多发生的严重火车事故感到沮丧”。

paras.en: "Emergency services are working on site to attend to the affected passengers," wrote Sánchez, who faces a national election next month. "All my thoughts are with the victims and their families."
paras.zh: “紧急服务部门正在现场处理受影响的乘客，”下个月面临全国大选的桑切斯写道。 “我所有的想法都与受害者及其家人同在。”

paras.en: Spain's King Felipe VI visited the crash site. He and Queen Letizia said in a short statement on X that they were following news of the accident.
paras.zh: 西班牙国王费利佩六世视察了坠机现场。他和莱蒂齐亚王后在 X 上发表的一份简短声明中表示，他们正在关注事故的消息。

paras.en: "We are deeply saddened and concerned by the train accident in Urda (Toledo)," the royal couple said. "We share in the grief of the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives, and we send our heartfelt support to the injured and all those affected."
paras.zh: 这对王室夫妇表示：“我们对乌尔达（托莱多）发生的火车事故深感悲痛和担忧。” “我们对遇难者的家人和亲人感到悲痛，并向伤者和所有受影响的人表示衷心的支持。”

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said "My heart goes out to the victims' families and loved ones. Today, Europe mourns with you."
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示：“我的心与遇难者家属和亲人同在。今天，欧洲与你们一起哀悼。”

paras.en: Spain's soccer federation postponed all 24 Copa del Rey games scheduled on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 西班牙足协推迟了原定于周三举行的全部 24 场国王杯比赛。

paras.en: Spain already suffered a devastating train crash this year
paras.zh: 西班牙今年已经遭受了毁灭性的火车相撞事故

paras.en: The wreckage of Wednesday's crash reminded many of the aftermath of another train collision in January, when 46 people died in southern Spain when a IRYO train jumped the track and hit an oncoming RENFE train. That sent the first two cars of the impacted train plummeting down a four-meter (13-foot) slope.
paras.zh: 周三事故的残骸让许多人想起一月份另一次火车相撞事故的后果，当时西班牙南部的一列 IRYO 火车冲出铁轨并撞上了迎面驶来的 RENFE 火车，造成 46 人死亡。这导致受影响列车的前两节车厢从 4 米（13 英尺）高的斜坡上垂直坠落。

paras.en: That crash was the deadliest in Spain since a 2013 crash that killed 80 people.
paras.zh: 那次事故是自 2013 年造成 80 人死亡的事故以来西班牙最严重的一次事故。

paras.en: The January incident shook confidence in the European country's extensive high-speed rail service.
paras.zh: 一月份的事件动摇了人们对这个欧洲国家广泛的高铁服务的信心。

paras.en: Over recent decades, Spain has invested heavily in high-speed rail — which the country's railway union defines as rails for trains going 250 kph (155 mph) and over — turning it into a world leader.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，西班牙大力投资高铁——该国铁路联盟将其定义为时速 250 公里（155 英里/小时）及以上的火车轨道——使其成为世界领先者。

paras.en: Spain has laid some 3,900 kilometers (2,400 miles) of such tracks over more than three decades for its 49 million residents. Only China, with 45,000 kilometers (28,000 miles) for its 1.4 billion people, has more high-speed track, according to the International Union of Railways.
paras.zh: 三十多年来，西班牙已为其 4,900 万居民铺设了约 3,900 公里（2,400 英里）的此类轨道。根据国际铁路联盟的数据，只有中国拥有更多的高速铁路，其总里程为 45,000 公里（28,000 英里），拥有 14 亿人口。

paras.en: Only recently did Spain open its rail network to private companies to compete against RENFE. IRYO started operating in Spain in 2022.
paras.zh: 直到最近，西班牙才向私营公司开放其铁路网络，以与 RENFE 竞争。 IRYO 于 2022 年开始在西班牙运营。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Spain's train workers' union, Joan Rodríguez, said that the increased traffic brought by privatization has put extra strain on rail infrastructure.
paras.zh: 西班牙火车工人工会发言人琼·罗德里格斯表示，私有化带来的交通量增加给铁路基础设施带来了额外的压力。

paras.en: "We are not convinced that the liberalization of the high-speed passenger rail service was matched by the necessary upkeep of the lines," Rodríguez told TVE. "I am not saying it was a determining factor (in the crashes), but yes, the increase in use of the network is a factor to keep in mind."
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯告诉 TVE：“我们不相信高速客运铁路服务的自由化会与线路的必要维护相匹配。” “我并不是说这是（崩溃）的决定性因素，但是，网络使用的增加是一个需要牢记的因素。”

articles.title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
paras.zh: 以色列大选结果势均力敌。而且，埃博拉疫情爆发达到了严峻的里程碑

paras.en: Midterm ad spending has surpassed a record $11 billion, according to Ad Impact. An NPR analysis found that candidates in four major Senate races spent more than $15 million on fundraising ads in the 2025-26 election cycle. Meanwhile, President Trump has been campaigning in tight races across states like Texas, Mississippi, and Kansas.
paras.zh: 根据 Ad Impact 的数据，中期广告支出已超过创纪录的 110 亿美元。 NPR 分析发现，在 2025-26 年选举周期中，四场主要参议院竞选的候选人在筹款广告上花费了超过 1500 万美元。与此同时，特朗普总统一直在德克萨斯州、密西西比州和堪萨斯州等州进行激烈的竞选活动。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump has not been sticking with his standard midterm pitch, which includes touting GOP tax cuts and attacking Democrats, NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben tells Up First. His jokes, including comments about Ohio Sen. Jon Husted's physique, entertain rally crowds but distract from the key issues the median voter cares about, like the economy and gas prices. Midterm turnout is usually low, but the GOP base still supports him, suggesting many MAGA votes are available, Kurtzleben says. But Trump needing to rally votes in very red states indicates a potential problem for his party.
paras.zh: - NPR 的丹妮尔·库茨勒本 (Danielle Kurtzleben) 告诉 Up First，特朗普并没有坚持他的标准中期宣传，其中包括宣传共和党减税和攻击民主党。他的笑话，包括对俄亥俄州参议员乔恩·赫斯特德体格的评论，娱乐了集会人群，但分散了中间选民关心的关键问题的注意力，比如经济和汽油价格。库尔茨莱本说，中期选举投票率通常较低，但共和党基础仍然支持他，这表明有许多“让MAGA”选票可用。但特朗普需要在非常红的州拉票，这表明他的政党存在潜在问题。

paras.en: The election in Israel is too close to call after voters turned out in record numbers to decide whether to keep Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in office or oust him for an alternative. Netanyahu was in a tight race with his top rival Gadi Eisenkot, a center-right former military chief of staff. Final vote tallies may take time, and if no bloc secures a majority, it could take days or weeks for party leaders to form a governing coalition and determine the next prime minister.
paras.zh: 以色列的选举结果势均力敌，投票人数创历史新高，以决定是继续留任总理内塔尼亚胡还是罢免他以寻求替代方案。内塔尼亚胡与他的头号竞争对手、中右翼前军事参谋长加迪·艾森科特展开了激烈的竞争。最终计票结果可能需要时间，如果没有哪个集团获得多数席位，政党领导人可能需要数天或数周的时间才能组建执政联盟并确定下一任总理。

paras.en: - 🎧 Israelis went to bed thinking Eisenkot had the advantage, but by morning, Netanyahu pulled ahead, making the election too close to call, NPR's Daniel Estrin says. Election officials tell NPR that they expect to finish counting votes by tomorrow afternoon. The leading candidate will have six weeks to form a governing coalition, likely competing for support from defectors in each other's camps. Eisenkot could gain the majority of lawmakers' support in parliament, thanks to a strong showing from Arab-led parties eager to see him as prime minister. Eisenkot's camp is hesitant to form a coalition with Arab parties due to mistrust and demonization of Arab political leaders after the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks, Estrin says. He adds that both candidates don't have a clear path to a majority coalition.
paras.zh: - NPR 的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 表示，以色列人上床睡觉时认为艾森科特占据优势，但到了早上，内塔尼亚胡领先，使得选举结果势均力敌。选举官员告诉 NPR，他们预计将于明天下午完成计票。领先的候选人将有六周的时间组建执政联盟，可能会争夺彼此阵营中叛逃者的支持。由于阿拉伯领导的政党渴望看到他担任总理，艾森科特可能会在议会中获得大多数议员的支持。埃斯特林表示，由于 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击事件后对阿拉伯政治领导人的不信任和妖魔化，艾森科特阵营对于与阿拉伯政党组建联盟犹豫不决。他补充说，两位候选人都没有明确的通往多数联盟的道路。

paras.en: The Federal Reserve typically combats inflation by raising interest rates. While prices are currently rising faster than average wages, investors don't expect a rate hike at today's meeting.
paras.zh: 美联储通常通过提高利率来对抗通货膨胀。尽管目前物价上涨速度快于平均工资，但投资者预计今天的会议上不会加息。

paras.en: - 🎧 The Labor Department's latest cost-of-living report shows consumer prices rose 3.7% in September compared to last year. NPR's Scott Horsley says that marks a larger annual increase than the previous month. Fed policymakers raised interest rates in September, but investors believe the central bank will remain low-key ahead of Election Day and may increase rates again in December.
paras.zh: - 🎧 劳工部最新生活成本报告显示，9月份消费者价格较去年上涨3.7%。 NPR 的斯科特·霍斯利 (Scott Horsley) 表示，这标志着年度增幅比上个月更大。美联储政策制定者在 9 月份加息，但投资者认为央行将在选举日之前保持低调，并可能在 12 月份再次加息。

paras.en: The Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 people infected since its declaration in May, according to the latest figures from the Democratic Republic of Congo. This outbreak has spread faster than any in history. It is also the largest in geographic scope, spanning from Nigeria to Kenya, and is second in death toll with nearly 5,000 deaths. Around one-third of those who have died have been children.
paras.zh: 根据刚果民主共和国的最新数据，自 5 月份宣布埃博拉疫情爆发以来，感染人数已超过 10,000 人。这次疫情的传播速度比历史上任何一次都要快。它的地理范围也是最大的，从尼日利亚到肯尼亚，死亡人数排名第二，有近 5,000 人死亡。死亡者中约有三分之一是儿童。

paras.en: The results of the 2026 midterm elections will shape the final two years of President Trump's second term and serve as a precursor to the 2028 general election. This month, Morning Edition is reporting from six states that could change the balance of power in Washington.
paras.zh: 2026年中期选举的结果将决定特朗普总统第二任期的最后两年，并成为2028年大选的前兆。本月，《晨报》报道了六个可能改变华盛顿权力平衡的州。

paras.en: With Election Day less than a week away, Morning Edition's Michel Martin went to the Midwest to hear from voters about what is important to them this midterm cycle. In Springfield, Ohio, the Trump administration has conducted an aggressive campaign to deport Haitian residents who have been living legally in the country with Temporary Protected Status. The administration revoked TPS for Haitians during Trump's second term. And in Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed has narrowly won the Democratic Senate nomination, a victory for the party's progressive wing. The swing state is important to both parties, which is why Trump and former President Barack Obama campaigned for their party's Senate candidate over the weekend.
paras.zh: 距离选举日还有不到一周的时间，晨间版的米歇尔·马丁 (Michel Martin) 前往中西部，听取选民的意见，了解本次中期选举对他们来说最重要的事情。在俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德，特朗普政府开展了一场积极的运动，驱逐在该国合法居住且具有临时保护身份的海地居民。在特朗普第二任期内，政府取消了海地人的 TPS。在密歇根州，阿卜杜勒·赛义德以微弱优势赢得了民主党参议院提名，这是该党进步派的胜利。这个摇摆州对两党都很重要，这就是特朗普和前总统巴拉克·奥巴马周末竞选本党参议员候选人的原因。

paras.en: Hear what voters in these two states had to say:
paras.zh: 听听这两个州的选民怎么说：

paras.en: - 🎧 In Michigan, many voters expressed burnout as they worry about gas prices and healthcare.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在密歇根州，许多选民因担心汽油价格和医疗保健而表示精疲力竭。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's tariffs are hitting Michigan households harder than any other state because many people depend on cross-border trade. But voters affected said the issue isn't so clear-cut.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普的关税对密歇根州家庭的打击比任何其他州都严重，因为许多人依赖跨境贸易。但受影响的选民表示，这个问题并不那么明确。

paras.en: - 🎧 Winning a statewide office in Michigan without Detroit is challenging, and El-Sayed didn't perform well there in the primary. Some Black Detroiters said they remain skeptical of him.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在没有底特律的情况下赢得密歇根州的全州办公室具有挑战性，埃尔赛义德在初选中表现不佳。一些底特律黑人表示，他们仍然对他持怀疑态度。

paras.en: - 🎧 Some Springfield, Ohio voters said they are voting early because they are angry about the administration's treatment of Haitians.
paras.zh: - 🎧 俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德的一些选民表示，他们提前投票是因为他们对政府对待海地人的方式感到愤怒。

paras.en: The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中于一处 — 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: As the holidays approach and appointments and commitments begin to pile up, author Caroline Sylge recommends a "say no" retreat — a day dedicated to figuring out which obligations you want to decline in the coming weeks and months. While it may seem unconventional to devote an entire day to saying no, this approach can help create space for what truly matters to you. Sylge shared with Life Kit her suggested schedule for a "say no" retreat:
paras.zh: 随着假期的临近，约会和承诺开始堆积起来，作者卡罗琳·西尔吉（Caroline Sylge）建议进行一次“说不”静修——这一天专门用于弄清楚您在未来几周和几个月内想要拒绝哪些义务。虽然花一整天时间说“不”似乎不合常规，但这种方法可以帮助为对您真正重要的事情创造空间。 Sylge 与 Life Kit 分享了她建议的“说不”静修时间表：

paras.en: - 🙅 As soon as you wake up, list things you want to say no to. Identify the obvious tasks you want to avoid.
paras.zh: - 🙅 当你醒来时，列出你想要拒绝的事情。确定您想要避免的明显任务。

paras.en: - 🙅 Take a break, then return to your retreat space and expand your "say no" list. Review requests, appointments, volunteer work and commitments for the coming days, weeks and months. Note the tasks you want to decline, and why.
paras.zh: - 🙅 休息一下，然后返回您的休息空间并扩大您的“说不”清单。审查未来几天、几周和几个月的请求、约会、志愿者工作和承诺。记下您想要拒绝的任务以及原因。

paras.en: - 🙅 After another break, review your list and start saying no. Start with a small win, like crossing off a demanding task. Next, focus on the tougher rejections that may involve saying no to someone you care about or work with.
paras.zh: - 🙅 再次休息后，检查你的清单并开始说“不”。从一个小小的胜利开始，比如完成一项艰巨的任务。接下来，重点关注更严厉的拒绝，这可能涉及对你关心或共事的人说不。

paras.en: - The latest installment of Sarah J. Maas' A Court of Thorns and Roses came out on Tuesday, prompting thousands of fans to attend midnight release parties at bookstores nationwide.
paras.zh: - 莎拉·J·马斯 (Sarah J. Maas) 的《荆棘与玫瑰法庭》的最新一期于周二出版，促使成千上万的粉丝参加全国书店的午夜发行派对。

paras.en: - A federal judge has temporarily blocked the Trump administration's plans to further change East Potomac Park, the municipal D.C. golf course that the president wants to turn into a championship-level venue.
paras.zh: - 一名联邦法官暂时阻止了特朗普政府进一步改造东波托马克公园的计划，总统希望将东波托马克公园改造成锦标赛级场地。

paras.en: - Harvard astrophysicists have found what they believe is a previously undiscovered dwarf planet in our solar system. (via WGBH)
paras.zh: - 哈佛大学的天体物理学家在我们的太阳系中发现了他们认为以前未被发现的矮行星。 （来自 WGBH）

articles.title: It's official: now avoid credit card interest into 2024

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: If you're carrying credit card debt — or expecting upcoming expenses — interest can make it harder to get ahead.
paras.zh: 如果你背负着信用卡债务——或者预计即将发生的开支——利息可能会让你更难取得成功。

paras.en: The Citi Simplicity® Card gives you a clear window to reset.
paras.zh: Citi Simplicity® 卡为您提供了清晰的重置窗口。

paras.en: With no interest for 18 months on both balance transfers and purchases, you can focus on paying down what you owe or covering new expenses without interest piling up.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均无需支付 18 个月的利息，因此您可以专注于偿还欠款或支付新费用，而不会产生利息累积。

paras.en: 0% intro APR for 18 months on Balance Transfers is one of the longest interest-free periods available today.
paras.zh: 余额转账 18 个月的 0% 年利率是当今最长的免息期之一。

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0%, 18 months on Balance Transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：0%，余额转账 18 个月

paras.en: Applicants with a good to excellent credit score (670+) typically have the best odds of approval.
paras.zh: 信用评分良好至优秀（670+）的申请人通常获得批准的几率最高。

paras.en: There is an intro balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, your fee will be 5% of each transfer (minimum $5)
paras.zh: 开户后 4 个月内完成的每笔转账（最低 5 美元）需缴纳 3% 的介绍性余额转账费。此后，您的费用将为每次转账的 5%（最低 5 美元）

paras.en: That lower 3% intro fee can reduce your upfront cost compared to cards that charge 5% from the start.
paras.zh: 与从一开始就收取 5% 费用的信用卡相比，3% 的较低介绍费可以降低您的前期成本。

paras.en: If you want flexibility — whether that’s paying down debt, managing new expenses, or both — this card gives you a defined window to do it without interest.
paras.zh: 如果您想要灵活性——无论是偿还债务、管理新开支，还是两者兼而有之——这张卡为您提供了一个明确的窗口，让您可以无利息地做到这一点。

paras.en: With 18 months of 0% intro APR on both balance transfers and purchases, you can choose how to use it based on what you need most right now.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均可享受 18 个月的 0% 年利率，您可以根据当前最需要的情况选择使用方式。

paras.en: You won’t even pay an annual fee to hold the card, and applying takes just a few minutes from your phone or computer.
paras.zh: 您甚至不需要支付年费来持有该卡，并且只需几分钟即可通过手机或计算机进行申请。

paras.en: But don’t wait too long — we often see 0% intro APR periods get cut without notice, so it’s smart to act while this one’s still available.
paras.zh: 但不要等待太久——我们经常看到 0% 的年利率优惠期在没有通知的情况下被削减，所以趁这个优惠仍然可用时采取行动是明智之举。

Motley Fool Money does not cover all offers on the market. Motley Fool Money is 100% owned and operated by The Motley Fool. Our knowledgeable team of personal finance editors and analysts are employed by The Motley Fool and held to the same set of publishing standards and editorial integrity while maintaining professional separation from the analysts and editors on other Motley Fool brands.
paras.zh: 我们是黄金法则的坚定信徒，这就是为什么编辑意见仅属于我们，并且之前没有经过所包含的广告商的审查、批准或认可。 Motley Fool Money 并不涵盖市场上的所有优惠。 Motley Fool Money 由 The Motley Fool 100% 拥有和经营。我们知识渊博的个人理财编辑和分析师团队受聘于 The Motley Fool，并遵守相同的出版标准和编辑诚信，同时与其他 Motley Fool 品牌的分析师和编辑保持专业分离。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它具有市场上最长的 0% 年利率之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳整体信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的形状而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰凉拌面，都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然充满活力的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租车或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子到达老牛湾 - 这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。
